  // Application views / tabs / roles: 'portal' (Unified Selection Portal), 'parent' (Beneficiary / Parent Survey Form), or 'admin' (Admission Officer / System Admin)
  // Maintains login session across inactivity, page reload, and browser restarts
  const [userRole, setUserRoleState] = useState<'portal' | 'parent' | 'admin'>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      if (window.location.search.includes('print-report=true')) {
        return 'admin';
      }
      const officerSess = getPersistedOfficerSession();
      if (officerSess.isAuthenticated) {
        return 'admin';
      }
    }
    return 'portal';
  });

  // Portal view state & Modal state
  const [portalView, setPortalViewState] = useState<'selection' | 'parent-choices' | 'parent-track' | 'principal-login' | 'principal-dashboard' | 'admin-login'>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const persistedPrincipal = getPersistedPrincipalSession();
      if (persistedPrincipal) {
        return 'principal-dashboard';
      }
      const savedView = localStorage.getItem('portal_view_v1');
      if (savedView === 'parent-choices' || savedView === 'parent-track') {
        return savedView;
      }
    }
    return 'selection';
  });

  const [showAgeModal, setShowAgeModalState] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Principal session maintained permanently across inactivity
  const [principalSession, setPrincipalSession] = useState<{
    schoolCode: string;
    schoolName: string;
    principalName: string;
    mobile?: string;
  } | null>(() => {
    return getPersistedPrincipalSession();
  });

  // Session Activity Keep-Alive: keeps user continuously logged in during inactivity
  useEffect(() => {
    const cleanupKeepAlive = initSessionKeepAlive();
    return () => {
      cleanupKeepAlive();
    };
  }, []);

  // Navigation History Stack
  type NavState = {
    userRole: 'portal' | 'parent' | 'admin';
    portalView: 'selection' | 'parent-choices' | 'parent-track' | 'principal-login' | 'principal-dashboard' | 'admin-login';
    showAgeModal: boolean;
  };
  const historyStackRef = useRef<NavState[]>([]);

  const pushNavState = (
    newRole: 'portal' | 'parent' | 'admin',
    newPortalView: 'selection' | 'parent-choices' | 'parent-track' | 'principal-login' | 'principal-dashboard' | 'admin-login' = portalView,
    newAgeModal: boolean = false
  ) => {
    const currentState: NavState = { userRole, portalView, showAgeModal };
    if (
      currentState.userRole !== newRole ||
      currentState.portalView !== newPortalView ||
      currentState.showAgeModal !== newAgeModal
    ) {
      historyStackRef.current.push(currentState);
    }
    setUserRoleState(newRole);
    setPortalViewState(newPortalView);
    setShowAgeModalState(newAgeModal);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' });
    }
  };

  const setUserRole = (role: 'portal' | 'parent' | 'admin', officerId?: string) => {
    if (role === 'admin') {
      const activeId = officerId || (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('active_officer_id_v1') : null) || 'emp_1';
      persistOfficerSession(activeId);
    }
    pushNavState(role, role === 'portal' ? 'selection' : portalView, false);
  };

  const handlePrincipalSessionChange = (session: { schoolCode: string; schoolName: string; principalName: string; mobile?: string } | null) => {
    setPrincipalSession(session);
    persistPrincipalSession(session);
    if (!session && portalView === 'principal-dashboard') {
      setPortalViewState('selection');
    }
  };

  // Explicit Officer Logout (only logged out when user explicitly clicks logout)
  const handleAdminLogout = () => {
    clearOfficerSession();
    historyStackRef.current = [];
    setUserRoleState('portal');
    setPortalViewState('selection');
    setAlertToast({ message: 'تم تسجيل الخروج بنجاح. أهلاً بك دائماً!', type: 'info' });
  };

  // Explicit School Principal Logout
  const handlePrincipalLogout = () => {
    persistPrincipalSession(null);
    setPrincipalSession(null);
    setPortalViewState('selection');
    setAlertToast({ message: 'تم تسجيل خروج حساب المدرسة بنجاح.', type: 'info' });
  };

  const handlePortalViewChange = (newView: 'selection' | 'parent-choices' | 'parent-track' | 'principal-login' | 'principal-dashboard' | 'admin-login') => {
    pushNavState('portal', newView, false);
  };

  const handleAgeModalChange = (show: boolean) => {
    pushNavState('portal', portalView, show);
  };

  const handleGoBack = () => {
    if (showAgeModal) {
      setShowAgeModalState(false);
      return;
    }
    if (historyStackRef.current.length > 0) {
      const previous = historyStackRef.current.pop()!;
      setUserRoleState(previous.userRole);
      setPortalViewState(previous.portalView);
      setShowAgeModalState(previous.showAgeModal);
    } else {
      // Fallback if stack is empty
      if (userRole === 'parent' || userRole === 'admin') {
        setUserRoleState('portal');
        setPortalViewState('parent-choices');
      } else if (portalView !== 'selection') {
        setPortalViewState('selection');
      }
    }
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' });
    }
  };

  const handleReturnToMainGateway = () => {
    historyStackRef.current = [];
    setUserRoleState('portal');
    setPortalViewState('selection');
    setShowAgeModalState(false);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' });
    }
  };

  // Compatibility helper for legacy references
  const activeTab: 'survey' | 'dashboard' = userRole === 'admin' ? 'dashboard' : 'survey';
  const setActiveTab = (tab: 'survey' | 'dashboard') => {
    setUserRole(tab === 'dashboard' ? 'admin' : 'parent');
  };

  // Network State Simulator (Simulates Offline vs Cloud status)
  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // App Configurations
  const [config, setConfig] = useState<AppConfig>(INITIAL_CONFIG);

  // Core Databases (Backed up in localStorage)
  const [surveys, setSurveys] = useState<SurveyResponse[]>(() => {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem('beneficiary_surveys');
    if (cached) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
    return [];
  });

  const [emailLogs, setEmailLogs] = useState<EmailLog[]>([]);

  const [principalReports, setPrincipalReports] = useState<PrincipalReport[]>(() => {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem('principal_reports');
    if (cached) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
    return [];
  });

  const [integrationLogs, setIntegrationLogs] = useState<SystemIntegrationLog[]>(() => {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem('beneficiary_integrations');
    if (cached) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
    return INITIAL_INTEGRATION_LOGS;
  });

  const [beneficiaryFeedbacks, setBeneficiaryFeedbacks] = useState<BeneficiaryFeedback[]>(() => {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem('beneficiary_feedbacks_v1');
    if (cached) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
    return [
      {
        id: 'fb-101',
        senderName: 'محمد بن علي العمري',
        senderPhone: '0551234567',
        message: 'نظام ممتاز وميسر لرعاية المستفيدين والتسكين بالمدارس. شكراً لجهودكم في إدارة التعليم.',
        createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000 * 4).toISOString(),
        status: 'new'
      }
    ];
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem('beneficiary_feedbacks_v1', JSON.stringify(beneficiaryFeedbacks));
  }, [beneficiaryFeedbacks]);

  const [isFeedbackModalOpen, setIsFeedbackModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleSendFeedback = (newFb: Omit<BeneficiaryFeedback, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'status'>) => {
    const item: BeneficiaryFeedback = {
      ...newFb,
      id: `fb-${Date.now()}`,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      status: 'new'
    };
    setBeneficiaryFeedbacks(prev => [item, ...prev]);
    setAlertToast({ message: 'تم إرسال ملاحظتك بنجاح للأدمن!', type: 'success' });
  };

  const [isInquiriesModalOpen, setIsInquiriesModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [inquiries, setInquiries] = useState<BeneficiaryInquiry[]>(() => {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem('beneficiary_inquiries_v1');
    if (cached) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
    return [
      {
        id: 'inq-101',
        senderName: 'عبدالله بن سعد الحربي',
        senderPhone: '0554433221',
        inquiryText: 'السلام عليكم، أود الاستفسار عن إمكانية نقل ابني في الصف الثالث الابتدائي إلى مدرسة قريبة من حي العزيزية، وهل الشواغر متاحة حالياً؟',
        createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000 * 5).toISOString(),
        status: 'answered',
        answeredByOfficerId: 'emp_followup',
        answeredByOfficerName: 'عبدالرحيم الأحمدي (مشرف القبول والتسجيل)',
        officerReply: 'وعليكم السلام ورحمة الله وبركاته. مرحباً بك أخي الكريم، نعم تم التحقق من المدارس المجاورة بحي العزيزية وتوجد شواغر متاحة بمدرسة ابن كثير الابتدائية، يمكنك تقديم طلب النقل وسيتم التسكين مباشرة بإذن الله.',
        answeredAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000 * 2).toISOString(),
        beneficiaryRating: 5,
        beneficiaryFeedbackNotes: 'خدمة ممتازة وسريعة جداً، شكراً جزيلاً للأستاذ عبدالرحيم الأحمدي على تجاوبه السريع والوافي.',
        ratedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000 * 1).toISOString()
      },
      {
        id: 'inq-102',
        senderName: 'فاطمة بنت أحمد الزهراني',
        senderPhone: '0501239874',
        inquiryText: 'أرغب بالاستفسار عن موعد انتهاء فترة معادلة الشهادات الصادرة من خارج المملكة للمرحلة المتوسطة، وما هي المستندات المطلوبة مسبقاً؟',
        createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000 * 2.5).toISOString(),
        status: 'new'
      }
    ];
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    saveInquiriesToStorage(inquiries);
  }, [inquiries]);

  const handleAddInquiry = (newInq: Omit<BeneficiaryInquiry, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'status'>) => {
    const item: BeneficiaryInquiry = {
      ...newInq,
      id: `inq-${Date.now()}`,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      status: 'new'
    };
    setInquiries(prev => {
      const exists = prev.some(i => i.id === item.id);
      const next = exists ? prev : [item, ...prev];
      saveInquiriesToStorage(next);
      return next;
    });

    // Immediate dispatch to server without any delay
    submitInquiryRealtime(item).catch(() => {});

    setAlertToast({ message: 'تم إرسال استفسارك بنجاح وفوراً لمسؤولي القبول!', type: 'success' });
  };

  const handleRateInquiry = (inquiryId: string, rating: number, notes?: string) => {
    const ratedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    setInquiries(prev => {
      const next = prev.map(inq => {
        if (inq.id === inquiryId) {
          return {
            ...inq,
            beneficiaryRating: rating,
            beneficiaryFeedbackNotes: notes || inq.beneficiaryFeedbackNotes,
            ratedAt
          };
        }
        return inq;
      });
      saveInquiriesToStorage(next);
      return next;
    });

    // Immediate update to server
    updateInquiryRealtime(inquiryId, {
      beneficiaryRating: rating,
      beneficiaryFeedbackNotes: notes,
      ratedAt
    }).catch(() => {});

    setAlertToast({ message: 'تم حفظ تقييمك للخدمة بنجاح ⭐', type: 'success' });
  };

  const [schoolsList, setSchoolsList] = useState<SchoolItem[]>(() => {
    return INITIAL_SCHOOLS;
  });

  const [isInitialLoaded, setIsInitialLoaded] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleUpdateSchools = (newList: SchoolItem[], isExplicitAdminClear?: boolean) => {
    if (!newList || !Array.isArray(newList)) return;
    if (isExplicitAdminClear) {
      setSchoolsList(newList);
      if (newList.length === 0) {
        localStorage.setItem('app_schools_cleared', 'true');
      } else {
        localStorage.removeItem('app_schools_cleared');
      }
      saveSchoolsToStorage(newList, { isConfirmedAdminClear: true });
      return;
    }
    localStorage.removeItem('app_schools_cleared');
    // دمج وتحديث المدارس والارقام الوزارية وبيانات المديرين مع الحفاظ على البيانات السابقة
    setSchoolsList(prev => {
      const mergedMap = new Map<string, SchoolItem>();
      (prev || []).forEach(s => {
        const key = s.ministryCode || s.code || s.id || s.nameAr;
        if (key) mergedMap.set(String(key).trim(), s);
      });
      newList.forEach(s => {
        const key = s.ministryCode || s.code || s.id || s.nameAr;
        if (key) {
          const existing = mergedMap.get(String(key).trim());
          mergedMap.set(String(key).trim(), existing ? { ...existing, ...s } : s);
        } else if (s.id) {
          mergedMap.set(s.id, s);
        }
      });
      const merged = Array.from(mergedMap.values());
      saveSchoolsToStorage(merged, { isConfirmedAdminClear: true });
      return merged;
    });
  };

  const [alertToast, setAlertToast] = useState<{ message: string; type: 'success' | 'info' | 'warning' } | null>(null);

  // Auto-dismiss alert toast after 3.5 seconds
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!alertToast) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setAlertToast(null);
    }, 3500);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [alertToast]);

  const [isProcessingBatch, setIsProcessingBatch] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [batchProgress, setBatchProgress] = useState<number>(0);
  const [batchDetails, setBatchDetails] = useState<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([
      loadSurveysFromStorage(),
      loadPrincipalReportsFromStorage(),
      loadSchoolsFromStorage(),
      fetchAllSurveysFromCloud(),
      fetchAllInquiriesFromCloud(),
      fetchAllPrincipalReportsFromCloud(),
      fetchServerSyncedData()
    ]).then(([surveysData, reportsData, schoolsData, cloudSurveys, cloudInquiries, cloudReports, serverData]) => {
      // 1. Surveys: Merge local + cloud Firestore + server data strictly without dropping any transactions
      setSurveys(prev => {
        const merged = new Map<string, SurveyResponse>();
        // Add existing state
        prev.forEach(s => { if (s && s.id) merged.set(s.id, s); });
        // Merge IndexedDB data
        (surveysData || []).forEach(s => { if (s && s.id) merged.set(s.id, s); });
        // Merge Cloud Firestore data (authoritative cross-device source)
        (cloudSurveys || []).forEach(s => { if (s && s.id) merged.set(s.id, s); });
        // Merge Server synced data
        if (serverData?.surveys && Array.isArray(serverData.surveys)) {
          serverData.surveys.forEach((s: SurveyResponse) => { if (s && s.id) merged.set(s.id, s); });
        }
        return Array.from(merged.values());
      });

      // 2. Principal Reports: Merge local + cloud + server
      setPrincipalReports(prev => {
        const merged = new Map<string, PrincipalReport>();
        prev.forEach(r => { if (r && r.id) merged.set(r.id, r); });
        (reportsData || []).forEach(r => { if (r && r.id) merged.set(r.id, r); });
        (cloudReports || []).forEach(r => { if (r && r.id) merged.set(r.id, r); });
        if (serverData?.principalReports && Array.isArray(serverData.principalReports)) {
          serverData.principalReports.forEach((r: PrincipalReport) => { if (r && r.id) merged.set(r.id, r); });
        }
        return Array.from(merged.values());
      });

      // 3. Schools & Principals: Strict protection of authentic 2940 records
      const schMap = new Map<string, SchoolItem>();
      // Always seed with INITIAL_SCHOOLS (master 2940 schools)
      INITIAL_SCHOOLS.forEach(s => {
        const k = s.ministryCode || s.code || s.id || s.nameAr;
        if (k) schMap.set(String(k).trim(), s);
      });
      // Merge IndexedDB schools if any
      (schoolsData || []).forEach(s => {
        const k = s.ministryCode || s.code || s.id || s.nameAr;
        if (k) {
          const ex = schMap.get(String(k).trim());
          schMap.set(String(k).trim(), ex ? { ...ex, ...s } : s);
        }
      });
      // Merge server schools
      if (serverData?.schools && Array.isArray(serverData.schools) && serverData.schools.length > 0) {
        serverData.schools.forEach((s: SchoolItem) => {
          const k = s.ministryCode || s.code || s.id || s.nameAr;
          if (k) {
            const ex = schMap.get(String(k).trim());
            schMap.set(String(k).trim(), ex ? { ...ex, ...s } : s);
          }
        });
      }
      const resolvedSchools = Array.from(schMap.values());
      setSchoolsList(resolvedSchools);

      // 4. Inquiries: Merge local + cloud Firestore + server inquiries
      setInquiries(prev => {
        const inqMap = new Map<string, BeneficiaryInquiry>();
        prev.forEach(i => { if (i && i.id) inqMap.set(i.id, i); });
        (cloudInquiries || []).forEach(i => { if (i && i.id) inqMap.set(i.id, i); });
        if (serverData?.inquiries && Array.isArray(serverData.inquiries)) {
          serverData.inquiries.forEach((i: BeneficiaryInquiry) => { if (i && i.id) inqMap.set(i.id, i); });
        }
        return Array.from(inqMap.values());
      });

      // 5. Config: Merge custom settings if available on server
      if (serverData?.config && typeof serverData.config === 'object') {
        setConfig(prev => ({ ...prev, ...serverData.config }));
      }

      setIsInitialLoaded(true);
    }).catch(err => {
      console.warn('Initial storage load fallback:', err);
      setIsInitialLoaded(true);
    });
  }, []);

  // Initialize Real-time synchronization (SSE stream + BroadcastChannel + high-frequency sync)
  useEffect(() => {
    const cleanup = initRealtimeSync({
      onNewInquiry: (newInq) => {
        setInquiries(prev => {
          if (prev.some(i => i.id === newInq.id)) return prev;
          const next = [newInq, ...prev];
          saveInquiriesToStorage(next);
          return next;
        });
      },
      onUpdateInquiry: (updatedInq) => {
        setInquiries(prev => {
          const next = prev.map(i => i.id === updatedInq.id ? { ...i, ...updatedInq } : i);
          saveInquiriesToStorage(next);
          return next;
        });
      },
      onNewSurvey: (newSurvey) => {
        setSurveys(prev => {
          if (prev.some(s => s.id === newSurvey.id)) return prev;
          const next = [newSurvey, ...prev];
          saveSurveysToStorage(next);
          return next;
        });
      },
      onUpdateSurvey: (updatedSurvey) => {
        setSurveys(prev => {
          const next = prev.map(s => s.id === updatedSurvey.id ? { ...s, ...updatedSurvey } : s);
          saveSurveysToStorage(next);
          return next;
        });
      },
      onNotification: (notif) => {
        setRealtimeNotification(notif);
        setTimeout(() => setRealtimeNotification(null), 6000);
      }
    });

    return () => {
      cleanup();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isInitialLoaded) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      saveSurveysToStorage(surveys);
      syncDataWithServer({ surveys });
    }, 2000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [surveys, isInitialLoaded]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isInitialLoaded) return;
    if (schoolsList.length < 2940) return; // Strict Anti-Downgrade: never sync truncated list!
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      saveSchoolsToStorage(schoolsList);
      syncDataWithServer({ 
        schools: schoolsList, 
        isExplicitAdminClear: false 
      });
    }, 2000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [schoolsList, isInitialLoaded]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isInitialLoaded) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      savePrincipalReportsToStorage(principalReports);
      syncDataWithServer({ principalReports });
    }, 2000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [principalReports, isInitialLoaded]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isInitialLoaded) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      syncDataWithServer({ inquiries, config });
    }, 2500);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [inquiries, config, isInitialLoaded]);

  const handleAddSurvey = (newSurveyData: Omit<SurveyResponse, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'isSynced'>): SurveyResponse => {
    const surveyId = `SURV-${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}`;
    const nowStr = new Date().toISOString();

    const newResponse: SurveyResponse = {
      ...newSurveyData,
      id: surveyId,
      createdAt: nowStr,
      lastUpdatedAt: nowStr,
      isSynced: isOnline
    };

    setSurveys((prev) => {
      const next = [newResponse, ...prev];
      saveSurveysToStorage(next);
      return next;
    });

    // Immediate dispatch to server without any delay
    submitSurveyRealtime(newResponse).catch(() => {});

    const ratedStaff = newResponse.staffSatisfaction && newResponse.staffSatisfaction > 0;
    const ratedReception = newResponse.receptionSatisfaction && newResponse.receptionSatisfaction > 0;
    const isNegativeFeedback = (ratedStaff && newResponse.staffSatisfaction < 3) || (ratedReception && newResponse.receptionSatisfaction < 3);

    if (isNegativeFeedback) {
      const emailId = `EML-${Math.floor(200 + Math.random() * 800)}`;
      const targetEmails = (config?.adminEmails || 'qabulmadinah@gmail.com').split(',').map((e) => e.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      
      const newEmailLogs: EmailLog[] = targetEmails.map((email, idx) => ({
        id: `${emailId}-${idx}`,
        surveyId,
        beneficiaryName: newResponse.beneficiaryName,
        recipientEmail: email,
        subject: `⚠️ تنبيه فوري: تقييم سلبي من مستفيد (${newResponse.beneficiaryName})`,
        sentAt: nowStr,
        status: isOnline ? 'sent' : 'pending',
        triggerReason: `Negative Feedback Alert`
      }));

      setEmailLogs((prev) => [...newEmailLogs, ...prev]);

      sendOfficialEmail({
        to: targetEmails,
        subject: `⚠️ تنبيه فوري: تقييم سلبي من مستفيد (${newResponse.beneficiaryName})`,
        bodyText: `تم استلام تقييم سلبي جديد...`,
        triggerReason: 'Negative Feedback Alert'
      });

      triggerToast(currentLang === 'ar' ? '⚠️ تم رصد تقييم سلبي!' : '⚠️ Negative feedback detected!', 'warning');
    } else {
      triggerToast(currentLang === 'ar' ? 'تم ارسال الطلب بنجاح' : 'Request sent successfully!', 'success');
    }

    return newResponse;
  };

  const handleDeleteSurvey = (id: string) => {
    setSurveys((prev) => {
      const next = prev.filter((s) => s.id !== id);
      saveSurveysToStorage(next, { isConfirmedAdminClear: next.length === 0 });
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleUpdateSurvey = (updatedSurvey: SurveyResponse) => {
    setSurveys((prev) => {
      const exists = prev.some((s) => s.id === updatedSurvey.id);
      const next = exists
        ? prev.map((s) => (s.id === updatedSurvey.id ? updatedSurvey : s))
        : [updatedSurvey, ...prev];
      saveSurveysToStorage(next);
      return next;
    });
    // Immediate dispatch to server in real time
    updateSurveyRealtime(updatedSurvey.id, updatedSurvey).catch(() => {});
  };

  const handleDeleteReport = (id: string) => {
    setPrincipalReports((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.id !== id));
  };

  const handleDeleteEmailLog = (id: string) => {
    setEmailLogs((prev) => prev.filter((log) => log.id !== id));
  };

  const handleClearAllSurveys = () => {
    setSurveys([]);
    setPrincipalReports([]);
    setEmailLogs([]);
    setIntegrationLogs([]);
    clearAllSurveysFromStorage('admin');
  };

  const handleImportSurveys = async (newSurveys: SurveyResponse[], overwrite: boolean = false) => {
    if (!newSurveys || newSurveys.length === 0) return;
    setIsProcessingBatch(true);
    try {
      const result = await processSurveysInBatchAsync({
        newItems: newSurveys,
        existingSurveys: overwrite ? [] : surveys,
        adminEmails: config.adminEmails,
        isOnline,
        onProgress: (percent) => setBatchProgress(percent)
      });
      const { deduplicatedItems, negativeEmailLogs } = result;
      setSurveys((prev) => overwrite ? deduplicatedItems : [...deduplicatedItems, ...prev]);
      if (negativeEmailLogs) setEmailLogs((prev) => [...negativeEmailLogs, ...prev]);
    } finally {
      setIsProcessingBatch(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddPrincipalReport = (newRep: Omit<PrincipalReport, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'isResolved'>) => {
    const report: PrincipalReport = {
      ...newRep,
      id: `REP-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      isResolved: false
    };
    setPrincipalReports(prev => [report, ...prev]);
  };

  const handleToggleReportResolved = (id: string) => {
    setPrincipalReports(prev => prev.map(rep => rep.id === id ? { ...rep, isResolved: !rep.isResolved } : rep));
  };

  const handleUpdateReportStatus = (id: string, updates: Partial<PrincipalReport>) => {
    setPrincipalReports(prev => prev.map(rep => rep.id === id ? { ...rep, ...updates } : rep));
  };

  const handleToggleResolved = (id: string) => {
    setSurveys((prev) => prev.map((s) => s.id === id ? { ...s, isResolved: !s.isResolved } : s));
  };

  const handleSyncNow = () => {
    if (!isOnline) return;
    setSurveys((prev) => prev.map((s) => ({ ...s, isSynced: true })));
    setEmailLogs((prev) => prev.map((l) => ({ ...l, status: 'sent' })));
  };

  const handleTriggerManualBackup = () => {
    const dataStr = JSON.stringify({ surveys, emailLogs, integrationLogs, config }, null, 2);
    const blob = new Blob([dataStr], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `Backup_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
    link.click();
  };

  const triggerToast = (message: string, type: 'success' | 'info' | 'warning') => {
    setAlertToast({ message, type });
    setTimeout(() => setAlertToast(null), 4000);
  };

  const unsyncedCount = surveys.filter((s) => !s.isSynced).length;
  const isDark = theme === 'dark';

  const handleUpdateConfig = (newConfig: AppConfig) => setConfig(newConfig);

  return (
    <div
      className={`min-h-screen flex flex-col font-sans select-none antialiased transition-colors duration-300 ${
        isDark ? 'bg-[#0b1f2e] text-slate-100' : 'bg-[#f2f9fd] text-slate-900'
      }`}
      dir={currentLang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
    >
      <Header
        currentLang={currentLang}
        onLanguageChange={setCurrentLang}
        activeTab={activeTab}
        onTabChange={setActiveTab}
        isOnline={isOnline}
        onToggleOnline={() => setIsOnline(!isOnline)}
        config={config}
        unsyncedCount={unsyncedCount}
        userRole={userRole}
        onBackToPortal={handleReturnToMainGateway}
        onGoBack={handleGoBack}
        showHome={userRole !== 'portal' || portalView !== 'selection'}
        canGoBack={historyStackRef.current.length > 0}
        theme={theme}
        onToggleTheme={() => setTheme(theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark')}
        onLogout={handleAdminLogout}
        onPrincipalLogout={handlePrincipalLogout}
        principalSession={principalSession}
      />

      <main className={`flex-1 flex flex-col relative min-h-0 ${userRole === 'portal' ? 'pb-12' : 'pb-32'}`}>
        {!isOnline && (
          <div className="w-full bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold text-xs py-2 px-4 text-center z-40">
            <Wifi className="w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-2" />
            <span>{currentLang === 'ar' ? 'أنت تعمل دون اتصال' : 'You are offline'}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col relative">
          {userRole === 'portal' ? (
            <div key="portal-view" className="animate-fade-in flex-1 flex flex-col h-full">
              <ErrorBoundary fallbackTitleAr="خطأ في تحميل البوابة الموحدة">
                <Portal
                  currentLang={currentLang}
                  surveys={surveys}
                  schools={schoolsList}
                  onToggleResolved={handleToggleResolved}
                  onUpdateSurvey={handleUpdateSurvey}
                  config={config}
                  onSelectRole={setUserRole}
                  principalReports={principalReports}
                  onAddPrincipalReport={handleAddPrincipalReport}
                  onToggleReportResolved={handleToggleReportResolved}
                  theme={theme}
                  portalView={portalView}
                  onPortalViewChange={handlePortalViewChange}
                  showAgeModal={showAgeModal}
                  onAgeModalChange={handleAgeModalChange}
                  principalSession={principalSession}
                  onPrincipalSessionChange={handlePrincipalSessionChange}
                  onOpenInquiries={() => setIsInquiriesModalOpen(true)}
                />
              </ErrorBoundary>
            </div>
          ) : userRole === 'parent' ? (
            <div key="survey-view" className="animate-fade-in p-4 max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full">
              <ErrorBoundary fallbackTitleAr="خطأ في تحميل نموذج الطلب">
                <SurveyForm
                  currentLang={currentLang}
                  onSubmit={handleAddSurvey}
                  schools={schoolsList}
                  onUpdateSurvey={handleUpdateSurvey}
                  config={config}
                  isOnline={isOnline}
                  onBackToPortal={() => setUserRole('portal')}
                  theme={theme}
                />
              </ErrorBoundary>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div key="dashboard-view" className="animate-fade-in flex-1">
              <ErrorBoundary fallbackTitleAr="خطأ في تحميل لوحة تحكم المسؤول">
                <Suspense fallback={<div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]"><Loader2 className="w-12 h-12 text-teal-600 animate-spin" /></div>}>
                  <Dashboard
                    currentLang={currentLang}
                    surveys={surveys}
                    schools={schoolsList}
                    onImportSchools={handleUpdateSchools}
                    onDeleteSchool={(id) => handleUpdateSchools(schoolsList.filter(s => s.id !== id))}
                    onDeleteSurvey={handleDeleteSurvey}
                    onClearAllSurveys={handleClearAllSurveys}
                    onToggleResolved={handleToggleResolved}
                    onImportSurveys={handleImportSurveys}
                    onAddSurvey={handleAddSurvey}
                    onUpdateSurvey={handleUpdateSurvey}
                    config={config}
                    onUpdateConfig={handleUpdateConfig}
                    emailLogs={emailLogs}
                    integrationLogs={integrationLogs}
                    onTriggerManualBackup={handleTriggerManualBackup}
                    onSyncNow={handleSyncNow}
                    unsyncedCount={unsyncedCount}
                    isOnline={isOnline}
                    onBackToPortal={() => setUserRole('portal')}
                    principalReports={principalReports}
                    onToggleReportResolved={handleToggleReportResolved}
                    onUpdateReportStatus={handleUpdateReportStatus}
                    onDeleteReport={handleDeleteReport}
                    onDeleteEmailLog={handleDeleteEmailLog}
                    onAssignSurvey={(id, officerId, officerName, notes, role) => {
                      setSurveys(prev => prev.map(s => s.id === id ? { ...s, assignedOfficerId: officerId, serviceEmployee: officerName, referredBy: role, referralNotes: notes } : s));
                    }}
                    onAssignPrincipalReport={(id, officerId, notes, role) => {
                      setPrincipalReports(prev => prev.map(rep => rep.id === id ? { ...rep, assignedOfficerId: officerId, referredBy: role, referralNotes: notes } : rep));
                    }}
                    theme={theme}
                    beneficiaryFeedbacks={beneficiaryFeedbacks}
                    onUpdateBeneficiaryFeedbacks={setBeneficiaryFeedbacks}
                    inquiries={inquiries}
                    onUpdateInquiries={setInquiries}
                  />
                </Suspense>
              </ErrorBoundary>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </main>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {isProcessingBatch && (
          <div className="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 w-11/12 max-w-xl bg-slate-900 text-white p-5 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl">
             <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold">Processing Batch...</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold">{batchProgress}%</span>
             </div>
             <div className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                <div className="bg-teal-500 h-full" style={{ width: `${batchProgress}%` }} />
             </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Real-time Officer Alert Toast (Instant popup when beneficiary sends inquiry or request) */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {realtimeNotification && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -40, scale: 0.95 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -30, scale: 0.95 }}
            className="fixed top-20 right-4 sm:right-6 z-[120] max-w-sm sm:max-w-md w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-700 text-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border-2 border-emerald-300/60 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center gap-3.5 select-none"
            dir="rtl"
          >
            <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-white/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border border-white/30 shadow-xs">
              <Zap className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-300 animate-bounce" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-ping shrink-0" />
                <h4 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-amber-200">{realtimeNotification.title}</h4>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-white/95 mt-0.5 truncate">{realtimeNotification.message}</p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setRealtimeNotification(null)}
              className="p-1 hover:bg-white/20 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-white/80 hover:text-white shrink-0"
              title="إغلاق التنبيه"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {alertToast && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 50 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            onClick={() => setAlertToast(null)}
            className={`fixed bottom-10 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[100] px-6 py-3 rounded-full shadow-2xl border flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer select-none transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 ${
              alertToast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-400 text-white' :
              alertToast.type === 'warning' ? 'bg-amber-600 border-amber-400 text-white' :
              'bg-blue-600 border-blue-400 text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <span className="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm">{alertToast.message}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                setAlertToast(null);
              }}
              className="p-1 hover:bg-white/20 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-white/80 hover:text-white"
              title="إغلاق الإشعار"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <ContactFeedbackModal
        isOpen={isFeedbackModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsFeedbackModalOpen(false)}
        onSendFeedback={handleSendFeedback}
        isDark={isDark}
      />

      {/* Inquiries & Communication Modal (الاستفسارات والتواصل) */}
      <InquiriesModal
        isOpen={isInquiriesModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsInquiriesModalOpen(false)}
        inquiries={inquiries}
        onAddInquiry={handleAddInquiry}
        onRateInquiry={handleRateInquiry}
        isDark={isDark}
        isRtl={currentLang === 'ar'}
      />
      
      {/* شريط الأزرار والتنقل المتجاوب - تم تصميمه ليناسب الجوال وشاشات الكمبيوتر دون أن يحجب المحتوى */}
      {/* 1. شريط الجوال المنظم بأسفل الشاشة (Mobile Bottom Dock) */}
      <div className="sm:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#081e2b]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-slate-200/90 dark:border-teal-800/40 px-3 py-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 shadow-2xl">
        {/* زر تواصل مع المبرمج للجوال */}
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsFeedbackModalOpen(true)}
          className="bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-white font-black text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer select-none shrink-0"
          title={currentLang === 'ar' ? 'تواصل مع المبرمج' : 'Contact Developer'}
          id="mobile-contact-btn"
        >
          <Code2 className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 shrink-0" />
          <span className="text-[11px]">{currentLang === 'ar' ? 'تواصل مع المبرمج' : 'Developer'}</span>
        </button>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {/* زر الرجوع للخلف للجوال */}
          {(userRole !== 'portal' || portalView !== 'selection' || historyStackRef.current.length > 0) && (
            <button
              onClick={handleGoBack}
              className="bg-[#16222f] hover:bg-[#1f2f42] text-white font-black text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl shadow-xs border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer select-none"
              title={currentLang === 'ar' ? 'الرجوع للخلف' : 'Go Back'}
              id="mobile-back-btn"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-300" />
              <span className="text-[11px]">{currentLang === 'ar' ? 'الخلف' : 'Back'}</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {/* زر الرئيسية للجوال */}
          {(userRole !== 'portal' || portalView !== 'selection') && (
            <button
              onClick={handleReturnToMainGateway}
              className="bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-700 text-white font-black text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer select-none"
              title={currentLang === 'ar' ? 'الشاشة الرئيسية' : 'Home Page'}
              id="mobile-home-btn"
            >
              <Home className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-200" />
              <span className="text-[11px]">{currentLang === 'ar' ? 'الرئيسية' : 'Home'}</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. أزرار سطح المكتب المثبتة بالزوايا دون حجب المحتوى (Desktop Floating Buttons) */}
      <div className="hidden sm:block">
        {/* زر تواصل مع المبرمج لسطح المكتب */}
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsFeedbackModalOpen(true)}
          className="fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-50 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-800 dark:text-white font-black text-xs px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-lg border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none"
          style={{ transform: 'none', transition: 'none' }}
          title={currentLang === 'ar' ? 'تواصل مع المبرمج' : 'Contact Developer'}
          id="floating-contact-btn"
        >
          <Code2 className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>{currentLang === 'ar' ? 'تواصل مع المبرمج' : 'Contact Developer'}</span>
        </button>

        {/* زر الرجوع للخلف لسطح المكتب */}
        {(userRole !== 'portal' || portalView !== 'selection' || historyStackRef.current.length > 0) && (
          <button
            onClick={handleGoBack}
            className="fixed bottom-4 left-[175px] z-40 bg-[#16222f]/95 hover:bg-[#1f2f42] text-white font-black text-xs sm:text-sm px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-700/80 flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer backdrop-blur-md select-none"
            title={currentLang === 'ar' ? 'الرجوع للخلف' : 'Go Back'}
            id="floating-back-btn"
          >
            <span>{currentLang === 'ar' ? 'الخلف' : 'Back'}</span>
            <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300 stroke-[2.2]" />
          </button>
        )}

        {/* زر الرئيسية لسطح المكتب */}
        {(userRole !== 'portal' || portalView !== 'selection') && (
          <button
            onClick={handleReturnToMainGateway}
            className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-40 bg-[#16222f]/95 hover:bg-[#1f2f42] text-white font-black text-sm sm:text-base px-4.5 py-3 sm:px-5 sm:py-3.5 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-700/80 flex items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer backdrop-blur-md"
            title={currentLang === 'ar' ? 'الشاشة الرئيسية' : 'Home Page'}
            id="floating-home-btn"
          >
            <span>{currentLang === 'ar' ? 'الرئيسية' : 'Home'}</span>
            <Home className="w-5.5 h-5.5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6 text-emerald-400 stroke-[2.2]" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  // Multiple school choices & parent pledge

  // Vacancy request pipeline fields
  isVacancyRequest?: boolean;

  vacancyApprovedAt?: string;
  submittedAt?: string;
  sentToSchoolPrincipal?: boolean;

  vacancyRequestNotes?: string;
  assignedRegistrationSchool?: string;
  assignedRegistrationSchoolCode?: string;
  assignedRegistrationSchoolNotes?: string;
  assignedRegistrationSchoolAt?: string;
  assignedBySupervisorName?: string;
  principalTaskType?: 'add_student_file' | string;
  returnedAt?: string;
  principalReturnedAt?: string;
  planningReResolvedAt?: string;
  finalStaffingConfirmedAt?: string;
  principalReturnCount?: number;
  isSecondReturnByPrincipal?: boolean;

  // Appointment Scheduling fields for Equivalency Review
  hasReviewAppointment?: boolean;
  appointmentDate?: string;

  appointmentSetBy?: string;
  appointmentConfirmedByBeneficiary?: boolean;

  // Equivalency doc attachment and notes

  beneficiaryName: string;
  recipientEmail: string;

  sentAt: string;
  status: 'sent' | 'pending' | 'failed';
  triggerReason: string; // "Negative Feedback Alert"
}

export interface SystemIntegrationLog {
  id: string;
  systemName: string;

export const ADMIN_CREDENTIALS = {

/**
 * التحقق الصارم من صلاحية الأدمن (مدير النظام):
 * مقتصرة حصرياً على الأستاذ سالم محمد الترجمي
 * السجل المدني: 1068575628
 * رقم الجوال: 0553512200
 * بقية المستخدمين لا يملكون صلاحية الأدمن نهائياً.
 */
export const isSystemAdmin = (user?: { nationalId?: string; id?: string; role?: string; mobile?: string } | null): boolean => {
  if (!user) return false;
  const nid = (user.nationalId || '').trim();
  const uid = (user.id || '').trim();
  const isSalem = nid === '1068575628' || uid === 'emp_1';
  return isSalem || user.role === 'admin';
};

FILE: src/firebase.ts (918 bytes)

import { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } from 'firebase/app';
import { getFirestore, doc, getDocFromServer, collection } from 'firebase/firestore';
import firebaseConfig from '../firebase-applet-config.json';

const app = !getApps().length ? initializeApp(firebaseConfig) : getApp();

export const db = firebaseConfig.firestoreDatabaseId 
  ? getFirestore(app, firebaseConfig.firestoreDatabaseId)
  : getFirestore(app);

export async function validateFirestoreConnection(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await getDocFromServer(doc(db, 'system_config', 'health_check'));
    return true;
  } catch (error: any) {
    // If permission or document not found, it still proves connection is reachable
    if (error?.code === 'unavailable' || error?.message?.includes('the client is offline')) {
      console.warn('Firestore connection offline:', error);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
}

export { app };

/**
 * Central Cloud Persistence & Realtime Synchronization Engine
 * Powered by Firebase Firestore with automatic offline resilience and local fallback.
 * Ensures data is 100% persistent across devices, deployments, and restarts.
 */

import {
  collection,
  doc,
  setDoc,
  updateDoc,
  getDocs,
  onSnapshot,
  query,
  orderBy,
  limit,
  serverTimestamp
} from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from '../firebase';
import { SurveyResponse, BeneficiaryInquiry, PrincipalReport } from '../types';

const COLLECTION_SURVEYS = 'surveys';
const COLLECTION_INQUIRIES = 'inquiries';
const COLLECTION_REPORTS = 'principal_reports';

/**
 * Clean data object by removing undefined values and circular references before Firestore write
 */
function sanitizeForFirestore<T extends Record<string, any>>(obj: T): Record<string, any> {
  const clean: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (val !== undefined && typeof val !== 'function') {
      clean[key] = val;
    }
  }
  return clean;
}

// =========================================================================
// 1. INQUIRIES CLOUD PERSISTENCE (الاستفسارات والتواصل)
// =========================================================================

export async function saveInquiryToCloud(inquiry: BeneficiaryInquiry): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const clean = sanitizeForFirestore({
      ...inquiry,
      updatedAtServer: serverTimestamp()
    });
    const docRef = doc(db, COLLECTION_INQUIRIES, inquiry.id);
    await setDoc(docRef, clean, { merge: true });
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Firestore saveInquiry failed, falling back to server/local:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

export async function updateInquiryInCloud(
  inquiryId: string,
  updates: Partial<BeneficiaryInquiry>
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const clean = sanitizeForFirestore({
      ...updates,
      updatedAtServer: serverTimestamp()
    });
    const docRef = doc(db, COLLECTION_INQUIRIES, inquiryId);
    await updateDoc(docRef, clean);
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Firestore updateInquiry failed:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

export async function fetchAllInquiriesFromCloud(): Promise<BeneficiaryInquiry[]> {
  try {
    const colRef = collection(db, COLLECTION_INQUIRIES);
    const snap = await getDocs(colRef);
    const list: BeneficiaryInquiry[] = [];
    snap.forEach((d) => {
      list.push(d.data() as BeneficiaryInquiry);
    });
    // Sort descending by createdAt
    return list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt || 0).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt || 0).getTime());
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to fetch inquiries from Firestore:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

export function subscribeToInquiriesCloud(
  onUpdate: (inquiries: BeneficiaryInquiry[], newArrival?: BeneficiaryInquiry) => void
): () => void {
  try {
    const colRef = collection(db, COLLECTION_INQUIRIES);
    return onSnapshot(
      colRef,
      (snapshot) => {
        const list: BeneficiaryInquiry[] = [];
        let newestItem: BeneficiaryInquiry | undefined;

        snapshot.docChanges().forEach((change) => {
          if (change.type === 'added') {
            const item = change.doc.data() as BeneficiaryInquiry;
            if (!newestItem || new Date(item.createdAt || 0) > new Date(newestItem.createdAt || 0)) {
              newestItem = item;
            }
          }
        });

        snapshot.forEach((d) => {
          list.push(d.data() as BeneficiaryInquiry);
        });

        list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt || 0).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt || 0).getTime());
        onUpdate(list, newestItem);
      },
      (error) => {
        console.warn('Inquiries Firestore onSnapshot error:', error);
      }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('subscribeToInquiriesCloud error:', err);
    return () => {};
  }
}

import { BeneficiaryInquiry, SurveyResponse } from '../types';
import { saveInquiriesToStorage, saveSurveysToStorage } from './storageEngine';
import {
  saveInquiryToCloud,
  updateInquiryInCloud,
  saveSurveyToCloud,
  updateSurveyInCloud,
  subscribeToInquiriesCloud,
  subscribeToSurveysCloud
} from './cloudSync';

// =========================================================================
// REAL-TIME AUDIO NOTIFICATION ENGINE (Web Audio API Synthesizer)
// =========================================================================
export function playNotificationChime(type: 'inquiry' | 'survey' | 'success' = 'inquiry') {
  try {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioContextClass) return;
    const ctx = new AudioContextClass();
    
    // Resume context if suspended
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') {
      ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
    }

    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();

    if (type === 'inquiry') {
      // Pleasant high double chime (E5 -> A5)
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659.25, ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(880, ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.45);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.5);
    } else if (type === 'survey') {
      // Deep reassuring chime (C5 -> G5)
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523.25, ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(783.99, ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.55);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.6);
    } else {
      // Quick gentle blip
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(800, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.25);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.3);
    }
  } catch (_) {
    // Audio synthesis is non-critical
  }
}

// =========================================================================
// BROADCAST CHANNEL SETUP (Zero-latency instant cross-tab communication)
// =========================================================================
let broadcastChannel: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
try {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'BroadcastChannel' in window) {
    broadcastChannel = new BroadcastChannel('moe_admissions_realtime_bus');
  }
} catch (_) {
  broadcastChannel = null;
}

export function broadcastLocalEvent(type: string, data: any) {
  if (broadcastChannel) {
    try {
      broadcastChannel.postMessage({ type, data, timestamp: Date.now() });
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

// =========================================================================
// REAL-TIME API DISPATCH METHODS (INSTANT CLOUD + SERVER DUAL PERSISTENCE)
// =========================================================================

/**
 * Submit inquiry instantly to cloud Firestore and local server
 */
export async function submitInquiryRealtime(
  inquiryData: Omit<BeneficiaryInquiry, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'status'> & { id?: string }
): Promise<BeneficiaryInquiry> {
  const localId = inquiryData.id || `inq-${Date.now()}`;
  const nowStr = new Date().toISOString();
  const fallbackInquiry: BeneficiaryInquiry = {
    ...inquiryData,
    id: localId,
    createdAt: nowStr,
    status: 'new'
  };

  // 1. Instant Cloud Firestore save (guarantees cross-device arrival across all deployed instances)
  saveInquiryToCloud(fallbackInquiry).catch((err) => {
    console.warn('Direct Firestore saveInquiry error:', err);
  });

  // 2. Local Tab Broadcast
  broadcastLocalEvent('NEW_INQUIRY', fallbackInquiry);

  // 3. Server HTTP API Dispatch
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/inquiries', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(fallbackInquiry)
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      const json = await res.json();
      if (json && json.inquiry) {
        return json.inquiry;
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Real-time API inquiry submission fallback to cloud/local:', err);
  }

  return fallbackInquiry;
}

/**
 * Update inquiry in cloud Firestore and server immediately (claim, unclaim, reply, rating)
 */
export async function updateInquiryRealtime(
  inquiryId: string,
  updates: Partial<BeneficiaryInquiry>
): Promise<boolean> {
  // 1. Cloud Firestore Update
  updateInquiryInCloud(inquiryId, updates).catch((err) => {
    console.warn('Direct Firestore updateInquiry error:', err);
  });

  // 2. Local Tab Broadcast
  broadcastLocalEvent('UPDATE_INQUIRY', { ...updates, id: inquiryId });

  // 3. Server HTTP API Dispatch
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/inquiries/${inquiryId}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(updates)
    });
    return res.ok;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Real-time API inquiry update fallback to cloud:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Submit survey/request instantly to cloud Firestore and server
 */
export async function submitSurveyRealtime(survey: SurveyResponse): Promise<SurveyResponse> {
  // 1. Cloud Firestore Save
  saveSurveyToCloud(survey).catch((err) => {
    console.warn('Direct Firestore saveSurvey error:', err);
  });

  // 2. Local Tab Broadcast
  broadcastLocalEvent('NEW_SURVEY', survey);

  // 3. Server HTTP API Dispatch
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/surveys', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(survey)
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      const json = await res.json();
      if (json && json.survey) {
        return json.survey;
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Real-time API survey submission fallback to cloud:', err);
  }

  return survey;
}

/**
 * Update survey in cloud Firestore and server immediately (status, assign, resolve)
 */
export async function updateSurveyRealtime(
  surveyId: string,
  updates: Partial<SurveyResponse>
): Promise<boolean> {
  // 1. Cloud Firestore Update
  updateSurveyInCloud(surveyId, updates).catch((err) => {
    console.warn('Direct Firestore updateSurvey error:', err);
  });

  // 2. Local Tab Broadcast
  broadcastLocalEvent('UPDATE_SURVEY', { ...updates, id: surveyId });

  // 3. Server HTTP API Dispatch
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/surveys/${surveyId}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(updates)
    });
    return res.ok;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Real-time API survey update fallback to cloud:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

// =========================================================================
// REAL-TIME SYNC ENGINE (Firestore Realtime + SSE + BroadcastChannel + Polling)
// =========================================================================

export interface RealtimeCallbacks {
  onNewInquiry?: (inquiry: BeneficiaryInquiry) => void;
  onUpdateInquiry?: (inquiry: Partial<BeneficiaryInquiry> & { id: string }) => void;
  onNewSurvey?: (survey: SurveyResponse) => void;
  onUpdateSurvey?: (survey: Partial<SurveyResponse> & { id: string }) => void;
  onDataSync?: (data: any) => void;
  onNotification?: (alert: { title: string; message: string; type: 'inquiry' | 'survey' }) => void;
}

export function initRealtimeSync(callbacks: RealtimeCallbacks): () => void {
  let isCleanedUp = false;
  let eventSource: EventSource | null = null;
  let reconnectTimeout: any = null;
  let pollingInterval: any = null;
  let reconnectAttempts = 0;

  // Track known IDs to avoid re-triggering notifications for existing items
  const knownInquiryIds = new Set<string>();
  const knownSurveyIds = new Set<string>();

  // Initialize known IDs from local caches
  try {
    const cachedInq = localStorage.getItem('beneficiary_inquiries_v1');
    if (cachedInq) {
      const arr = JSON.parse(cachedInq);
      if (Array.isArray(arr)) arr.forEach((i) => { if (i && i.id) knownInquiryIds.add(i.id); });
    }
    const cachedSurv = localStorage.getItem('beneficiary_surveys');
    if (cachedSurv) {
      const arr = JSON.parse(cachedSurv);
      if (Array.isArray(arr)) arr.forEach((s) => { if (s && s.id) knownSurveyIds.add(s.id); });
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  // 1. Process New Inquiry Event
  function handleNewInquiry(inquiry: BeneficiaryInquiry, suppressChime = false) {
    if (!inquiry || !inquiry.id) return;
    const isNew = !knownInquiryIds.has(inquiry.id);
    knownInquiryIds.add(inquiry.id);

    if (callbacks.onNewInquiry) {
      callbacks.onNewInquiry(inquiry);
    }

    if (isNew && !suppressChime) {
      playNotificationChime('inquiry');
      if (callbacks.onNotification) {
        callbacks.onNotification({
          title: 'استفسار جديد وصل الآن!',
          message: `ورد استفسار جديد من المستفيد: [${inquiry.senderName}]`,
          type: 'inquiry'
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. Process Update Inquiry Event
  function handleUpdateInquiry(inquiry: Partial<BeneficiaryInquiry> & { id: string }) {
    if (!inquiry || !inquiry.id) return;
    knownInquiryIds.add(inquiry.id);
    if (callbacks.onUpdateInquiry) {
      callbacks.onUpdateInquiry(inquiry);
    }
  }

  // 3. Process New Survey Event
  function handleNewSurvey(survey: SurveyResponse, suppressChime = false) {
    if (!survey || !survey.id) return;
    const isNew = !knownSurveyIds.has(survey.id);
    knownSurveyIds.add(survey.id);

    if (callbacks.onNewSurvey) {
      callbacks.onNewSurvey(survey);
    }

    if (isNew && !suppressChime) {
      playNotificationChime('survey');
      if (callbacks.onNotification) {
        callbacks.onNotification({
          title: 'طلب جديد وصل الآن!',
          message: `ورد طلب جديد من ولي الأمر / المستفيد: [${survey.beneficiaryName}]`,
          type: 'survey'
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // 4. Process Update Survey Event
  function handleUpdateSurvey(survey: Partial<SurveyResponse> & { id: string }) {
    if (!survey || !survey.id) return;
    knownSurveyIds.add(survey.id);
    if (callbacks.onUpdateSurvey) {
      callbacks.onUpdateSurvey(survey);
    }
  }

  // 5. Connect Cloud Firestore Realtime Push Subscriptions
  let unsubscribeInquiries: (() => void) | null = null;
  let unsubscribeSurveys: (() => void) | null = null;

  try {
    unsubscribeInquiries = subscribeToInquiriesCloud((inquiries, newArrival) => {
      if (isCleanedUp) return;
      if (newArrival && !knownInquiryIds.has(newArrival.id)) {
        handleNewInquiry(newArrival);
      }
      inquiries.forEach((inq) => {
        if (!knownInquiryIds.has(inq.id)) {
          handleNewInquiry(inq, true);
        } else {
          handleUpdateInquiry(inq);
        }
      });
    });

    unsubscribeSurveys = subscribeToSurveysCloud((surveys, newArrival) => {
      if (isCleanedUp) return;
      if (newArrival && !knownSurveyIds.has(newArrival.id)) {
        handleNewSurvey(newArrival);
      }
      surveys.forEach((s) => {
        if (!knownSurveyIds.has(s.id)) {
          handleNewSurvey(s, true);
        } else {
          handleUpdateSurvey(s);
        }
      });
    });
  } catch (cloudErr) {
    console.warn('Cloud sync listeners init error:', cloudErr);
  }

  // 6. Connect Server SSE Stream (Second redundancy layer)
  function connectSSE() {
    if (isCleanedUp || typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    try {
      if (eventSource) {
        eventSource.close();
      }

      eventSource = new EventSource('/api/events');

      eventSource.onopen = () => {
        reconnectAttempts = 0;
      };

      eventSource.onmessage = (e) => {
        if (!e.data) return;
        try {
          const event = JSON.parse(e.data);
          if (event.type === 'NEW_INQUIRY' && event.data) {
            handleNewInquiry(event.data);
          } else if (event.type === 'UPDATE_INQUIRY' && event.data) {
            handleUpdateInquiry(event.data);
          } else if (event.type === 'NEW_SURVEY' && event.data) {
            handleNewSurvey(event.data);
          } else if (event.type === 'UPDATE_SURVEY' && event.data) {
            handleUpdateSurvey(event.data);
          } else if (event.type === 'DATA_SYNC' && callbacks.onDataSync) {
            callbacks.onDataSync(event.data);
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      };

      eventSource.onerror = () => {
        if (eventSource) {
          eventSource.close();
          eventSource = null;
        }
        if (!isCleanedUp) {
          reconnectAttempts++;
          const delay = Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(1.5, reconnectAttempts), 10000);
          reconnectTimeout = setTimeout(connectSSE, delay);
        }
      };
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('SSE connection init error:', err);
    }
  }

  connectSSE();

  // 7. Cross-Tab BroadcastChannel Listener (Third redundancy layer)
  const handleBroadcastMessage = (e: MessageEvent) => {
    if (!e.data || typeof e.data !== 'object') return;
    const { type, data } = e.data;
    if (type === 'NEW_INQUIRY' && data) {
      handleNewInquiry(data);
    } else if (type === 'UPDATE_INQUIRY' && data) {
      handleUpdateInquiry(data);
    } else if (type === 'NEW_SURVEY' && data) {
      handleNewSurvey(data);
    } else if (type === 'UPDATE_SURVEY' && data) {
      handleUpdateSurvey(data);
    }
  };

  if (broadcastChannel) {
    broadcastChannel.addEventListener('message', handleBroadcastMessage);
  }

  // 8. Resilient Smart Background Polling (Fourth redundancy layer every 3.5s)
  async function pollServerUpdates() {
    if (isCleanedUp) return;

    // Fast check inquiries
    try {
      const inqRes = await fetch('/api/inquiries');
      if (inqRes.ok) {
        const json = await inqRes.json();
        if (json && Array.isArray(json.data)) {
          const incoming: BeneficiaryInquiry[] = json.data;
          incoming.forEach((inq) => {
            if (inq && inq.id) {
              if (!knownInquiryIds.has(inq.id)) {
                handleNewInquiry(inq);
              } else {
                handleUpdateInquiry(inq);
              }
            }
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // Fast check surveys
    try {
      const survRes = await fetch('/api/surveys');
      if (survRes.ok) {
        const json = await survRes.json();
        if (json && Array.isArray(json.data)) {
          const incoming: SurveyResponse[] = json.data;
          incoming.forEach((s) => {
            if (s && s.id) {
              if (!knownSurveyIds.has(s.id)) {
                handleNewSurvey(s);
              } else {
                handleUpdateSurvey(s);
              }
            }
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  const initialPollTimer = setTimeout(pollServerUpdates, 1000);
  pollingInterval = setInterval(pollServerUpdates, 3500);

  // Return Master Cleanup Function
  return () => {
    isCleanedUp = true;
    clearTimeout(initialPollTimer);
    clearTimeout(reconnectTimeout);
    clearInterval(pollingInterval);
    if (unsubscribeInquiries) unsubscribeInquiries();
    if (unsubscribeSurveys) unsubscribeSurveys();
    if (eventSource) {
      eventSource.close();
      eventSource = null;
    }
    if (broadcastChannel) {
      broadcastChannel.removeEventListener('message', handleBroadcastMessage);
    }
  };
}

import * as XLSX from 'xlsx';
import { SurveyResponse, PrincipalReport, SchoolItem, OfficerUser, BeneficiaryFeedback, BeneficiaryInquiry, ProblemType } from '../types';
import masterSchoolsData from '../data/masterSchoolsData.json';
import masterOfficersData from '../data/masterOfficersData.json';

const DB_NAME = 'MoeSmartSystemDB_v2';
const DB_VERSION = 2;
const STORE_SURVEYS = 'surveys';
const STORE_REPORTS = 'principal_reports';
const STORE_SCHOOLS = 'schools';
const STORE_OFFICERS = 'officers';
const STORE_FEEDBACKS = 'feedbacks';
const STORE_SNAPSHOTS = 'snapshots';
const STORE_INQUIRIES = 'inquiries';

// مفتاح تشفير محلي ثابت مخصص للمتصفح لحماية الهويات والجوالات محلياً
const ENCRYPTION_SALT = 'MoeSmartSecureSalt_2026';

let dbInstance: IDBDatabase | null = null;

// دالة أمنية لتشفير النصوص الحساسة قبل تخزينها محلياً لحماية خصوصية المستفيدين
// ملاحظة أمنية: هذا التشفير يعتمد على التعمية (Obfuscation) لحماية البيانات من المتطفلين العاديين في المتصفح.
// في بيئة الإنتاج الفعلية، يجب استخدام نظام تشفير متقدم أو نقل البيانات للخادم مباشرة.
function encryptField(text: string | undefined | null): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  try {
    // محاكاة تشفير آمن سريع متوافق مع المتصفح للبيانات الحساسة كالهوية والجوال
    const b64 = btoa(encodeURIComponent(text));
    return `SEC_${b64.split('').reverse().join('')}`;
  } catch {
    return text || '';
  }
}

// دالة فك التشفير التلقائي عند استدعاء البيانات لعرضها في لوحة التحكم
function decryptField(cipher: string | undefined | null): string {
  if (!cipher || !cipher.startsWith('SEC_')) return cipher || '';
  try {
    const cleanCipher = cipher.replace('SEC_', '').split('').reverse().join('');
    return decodeURIComponent(atob(cleanCipher));
  } catch {
    return cipher || '';
  }
}

// تطهير وتأمين حقول المعاملة بالكامل
function secureSurveyData(survey: SurveyResponse): SurveyResponse {
  return {
    ...survey,
    nationalId: encryptField(survey.nationalId),
    phoneNumber: encryptField(survey.phoneNumber),
    parentName: encryptField(survey.parentName),
    beneficiaryName: encryptField(survey.beneficiaryName)
  };
}

// فك تأمين حقول المعاملة لعرضها برمجياً بالإكسل واللوحة
function unsecureSurveyData(survey: SurveyResponse): SurveyResponse {
  return {
    ...survey,
    nationalId: decryptField(survey.nationalId),
    phoneNumber: decryptField(survey.phoneNumber),
    parentName: decryptField(survey.parentName),
    beneficiaryName: decryptField(survey.beneficiaryName)
  };
}

function openDB(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  if (dbInstance) {
    return Promise.resolve(dbInstance);
  }
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.indexedDB) {
      reject(new Error('IndexedDB not supported in current environment'));
      return;
    }
    const request = window.indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
    request.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {
      const db = (event.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_SURVEYS)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_SURVEYS, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_REPORTS)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_REPORTS, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_SCHOOLS)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_SCHOOLS, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_OFFICERS)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_OFFICERS, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_FEEDBACKS)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_FEEDBACKS, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_SNAPSHOTS)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_SNAPSHOTS, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
    };
    request.onsuccess = () => {
      dbInstance = request.result;
      resolve(dbInstance);
    };
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
  });
}

// 1. SURVEYS PERSISTENCE (طلبات المستفيدين)
// ----------------------------------------------------
export async function saveSurveysToStorage(surveys: SurveyResponse[], options?: { isConfirmedAdminClear?: boolean }): Promise<void> {
  if (!surveys || (!Array.isArray(surveys))) return;
  if (surveys.length === 0 && !options?.isConfirmedAdminClear) {
    const existing = await loadSurveysFromStorage();
    if (existing && existing.length > 0) {
      console.warn('Blocked blank overwrite to protect existing requests.');
      return;
    }
  }

  // تشفير البيانات الحساسة قبل التخزين الفيزيائي بالمتصفح حماية للمستندات
  const securedSurveys = surveys.map(s => secureSurveyData(s));

  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_SURVEYS, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_SURVEYS);
    store.clear();
    for (let i = 0; i < securedSurveys.length; i++) {
      store.put(securedSurveys[i]);
    }
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
      tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('IndexedDB saveSurveys failed, falling back to LocalStorage:', err);
  }

  try {
    if (securedSurveys.length <= 2000) {
      localStorage.setItem('beneficiary_surveys', JSON.stringify(securedSurveys));
    } else {
      localStorage.setItem('beneficiary_surveys', JSON.stringify(securedSurveys.slice(0, 1000)));
    }
  } catch (quotaErr) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('beneficiary_surveys', JSON.stringify(securedSurveys.slice(0, 300)));
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }
}

export async function loadSurveysFromStorage(): Promise<SurveyResponse[]> {
  let dbItems: SurveyResponse[] = [];
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_SURVEYS, 'readonly');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_SURVEYS);
    dbItems = await new Promise<SurveyResponse[]>((resolve, reject) => {
      const getAllReq = store.getAll();
      getAllReq.onsuccess = () => resolve(getAllReq.result || []);
      getAllReq.onerror = () => reject(getAllReq.error);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('IndexedDB loadSurveys failed, checking localStorage fallback:', err);
  }

  let lsItems: SurveyResponse[] = [];
  try {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem('beneficiary_surveys');
    if (cached) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) lsItems = parsed;
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  const mergedMap = new Map<string, SurveyResponse>();
  dbItems.forEach(item => { if (item && item.id) mergedMap.set(item.id, item); });
  lsItems.forEach(item => { if (item && item.id && !mergedMap.has(item.id)) mergedMap.set(item.id, item); });
  
  // فك تشفير السجلات تلقائياً عند القراءة والدمج لتخرج نظيفة للبرنامج والإكسل
  const finalRecords = Array.from(mergedMap.values());
  return finalRecords.map(r => unsecureSurveyData(r));
}

export async function saveSchoolsToStorage(schools: SchoolItem[], options?: { isConfirmedAdminClear?: boolean }): Promise<void> {
  if (!schools || !Array.isArray(schools)) return;
  const masterCount = (masterSchoolsData as any[]).length;
  // STRICT ANTI-DATA-LOSS: Never allow saving empty or truncated list over the master records
  if (schools.length < masterCount && !options?.isConfirmedAdminClear) {
    console.warn(`[StorageEngine] Blocked truncated schools list save (${schools.length} < ${masterCount}) to protect authentic records.`);
    return;
  }
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_SCHOOLS, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_SCHOOLS);
    store.clear();
    for (let i = 0; i < schools.length; i++) {
      if (schools[i]) {
        store.put(schools[i]);
      }
    }
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
      tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('IndexedDB saveSchools failed:', err);
  }
}

export async function loadSchoolsFromStorage(): Promise<SchoolItem[]> {
  const masterList = (masterSchoolsData as SchoolItem[]) || [];
  let dbSchools: SchoolItem[] = [];
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_SCHOOLS, 'readonly');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_SCHOOLS);
    dbSchools = await new Promise<SchoolItem[]>((resolve, reject) => {
      const getAllReq = store.getAll();
      getAllReq.onsuccess = () => resolve(getAllReq.result || []);
      getAllReq.onerror = () => reject(getAllReq.error);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('IndexedDB loadSchools failed:', err);
  }

  if (dbSchools && dbSchools.length >= masterList.length) {
    return dbSchools;
  }
  return masterList;
}

export async function savePrincipalReportsToStorage(reports: PrincipalReport[], options?: { isConfirmedAdminClear?: boolean }): Promise<void> {

    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_REPORTS, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_REPORTS);
    store.clear();
    for (let i = 0; i < reports.length; i++) {
      store.put(reports[i]);
    }
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
      tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('IndexedDB save reports failed:', err);
  }
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('principal_reports', JSON.stringify(reports.slice(0, 1000)));
  } catch {

  }
}

export async function loadPrincipalReportsFromStorage(): Promise<PrincipalReport[]> {
  let dbReports: PrincipalReport[] = [];
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_REPORTS, 'readonly');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_REPORTS);
    dbReports = await new Promise<PrincipalReport[]>((resolve, reject) => {
      const getAllReq = store.getAll();
      getAllReq.onsuccess = () => resolve(getAllReq.result || []);
      getAllReq.onerror = () => reject(getAllReq.error);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('IndexedDB load reports failed:', err);
  }

  let lsReports: PrincipalReport[] = [];
  try {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem('principal_reports');
    if (cached) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) lsReports = parsed;
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  const merged = new Map<string, PrincipalReport>();
  dbReports.forEach(r => { if (r && r.id) merged.set(r.id, r); });
  lsReports.forEach(r => { if (r && r.id && !merged.has(r.id)) merged.set(r.id, r); });

  return Array.from(merged.values());
}

export async function saveOfficersToStorage(officers: OfficerUser[]): Promise<void> {
  if (!officers || !Array.isArray(officers) || officers.length === 0) return;
  
  // Guarantee Primary Super Admin is included and never deleted, and NO other user has admin role
  const listToSave: OfficerUser[] = officers.map((o): OfficerUser => {
    if (o.nationalId === '1068575628' || o.id === 'emp_1') {
      return {
        ...o,
        ...PRIMARY_SUPER_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        role: 'admin'
      };
    }
    if (o.role === 'admin') {
      return {
        ...o,
        role: 'supervisor',
        canGrantRoles: false,
        canDeleteUsers: false,
        canAddUsers: false
      };
    }
    return {
      ...o,
      canGrantRoles: false,
      canDeleteUsers: false
    };
  });

  const adminIdx = listToSave.findIndex(o => o.nationalId === '1068575628' || o.id === 'emp_1');
  if (adminIdx === -1) {
    listToSave.unshift(PRIMARY_SUPER_ADMIN);
  } else {
    listToSave[adminIdx] = {
      ...listToSave[adminIdx],
      ...PRIMARY_SUPER_ADMIN,
      isActive: true
    };
  }

  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_OFFICERS, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_OFFICERS);
    store.clear();
    for (const off of listToSave) store.put(off);
  } catch (e) {
    /* ignore */
  }
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('officer_users_v4', JSON.stringify(listToSave));
    localStorage.setItem('officer_users_v3', JSON.stringify(listToSave));
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

export async function loadOfficersFromStorage(): Promise<OfficerUser[]> {
  let list: OfficerUser[] = [];
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_OFFICERS, 'readonly');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_OFFICERS);
    const dbItems = await new Promise<OfficerUser[]>((res) => {
      const req = store.getAll();
      req.onsuccess = () => res(req.result || []);
      req.onerror = () => res([]);
    });
    if (dbItems && dbItems.length > 0) list = dbItems;
  } catch (e) {
    /* ignore */
  }

  if (list.length === 0) {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem('officer_users_v4') || localStorage.getItem('officer_users_v3');
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) list = parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

  // Ensure Demo Officers are always present for testing as requested
  DEMO_OFFICERS.forEach(demo => {
    if (!list.some(o => o.id === demo.id || o.nationalId === demo.nationalId)) {
      list.push(demo);
    }
  });

  // Ensure Primary Super Admin is always active and has correct data, and ONLY Salem has admin permissions
  list = list.map(o => {
    if (o.nationalId === '1068575628' || o.id === 'emp_1') {
      return {
        ...o,
        ...PRIMARY_SUPER_ADMIN,
        isActive: true,
        role: 'admin' as const
      };
    }
    // Strict enforcement: all other users cannot have admin permissions under any circumstances
    if (o.role === 'admin') {
      return {
        ...o,
        role: 'supervisor' as const,
        canGrantRoles: false,
        canDeleteUsers: false,
        canAddUsers: false
      };
    }
    return {
      ...o,
      canGrantRoles: false,
      canDeleteUsers: false
    };
  });

  return list;
}
