export async function clearAllSurveysFromStorage(actorRole?: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (actorRole !== 'admin') {
    console.error('Unauthorized deletion attempt. Only Admin can clear database.');
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const tx = db.transaction([STORE_SURVEYS, STORE_REPORTS], 'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(STORE_SURVEYS).clear();
    tx.objectStore(STORE_REPORTS).clear();
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('IndexedDB clear error:', err);
  }

  try {
    localStorage.removeItem('beneficiary_surveys');
    localStorage.removeItem('principal_reports');
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  return true;
}

export async function clearSchoolsFromStorage(actorRole?: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (actorRole !== 'admin') {
    console.error('Unauthorized schools clear attempt. Only Admin can clear schools.');
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_SCHOOLS, 'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(STORE_SCHOOLS).clear();
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    /* ignore */
  }

  try {
    localStorage.setItem('app_schools_list_v1', '[]');
    localStorage.setItem('app_schools_saved_v1', 'true');
    localStorage.setItem('app_schools_last_saved_at', new Date().toISOString());
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  return true;
}

export interface BackupFilterOptions {
  year?: string | number;
  month?: string | number;
  day?: string | number;
  problemType?: string;
  stage?: string;
  gender?: string;
  status?: string;
}

export function filterSurveysByDateAndType(surveys: SurveyResponse[], filters: BackupFilterOptions): SurveyResponse[] {
  if (!surveys || !Array.isArray(surveys)) return [];

  return surveys.filter((item) => {
    if (!item) return false;

    const d = item.createdAt ? new Date(item.createdAt) : new Date();
    const itemYear = d.getFullYear().toString();
    const itemMonth = (d.getMonth() + 1).toString();
    const itemDay = d.getDate().toString();

    if (filters.year && filters.year !== 'all' && filters.year.toString() !== itemYear) return false;
    if (filters.month && filters.month !== 'all' && filters.month.toString() !== itemMonth) return false;
    if (filters.day && filters.day !== 'all' && filters.day.toString() !== itemDay) return false;

    if (filters.problemType && filters.problemType !== 'all') {
      if (filters.problemType === 'equalizations') {
        if (!isSurveyEqualizationRequest(item)) return false;
      } else if (filters.problemType === 'vacancies') {
        if (!isSurveyTransferRequest(item)) return false;
      } else if (item.problemType !== filters.problemType) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    if (filters.status && filters.status !== 'all') {
      if (filters.status === 'resolved' && !item.isResolved) return false;
      if (filters.status === 'pending' && item.isResolved) return false;
    }

    return true;
  });
}

export function exportRequestsBackupToExcel(
  surveys: SurveyResponse[],
  filters: BackupFilterOptions,
  officersList: OfficerUser[] = []
): { success: boolean; count: number; filename: string } {
  const filtered = filterSurveysByDateAndType(surveys, filters);

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    return { success: false, count: 0, filename: '' };
  }

  const officerMap = new Map<string, string>();
  officersList.forEach(o => officerMap.set(o.id, o.nameAr));

  const rows = filtered.map((s, index) => {
    const d = s.createdAt ? new Date(s.createdAt) : new Date();
    const dateStr = d.toLocaleDateString('ar-SA');
    const typeInfo = getRequestTypeInfo(s, true);

    return {
      'م': index + 1,
      'رقم المعاملة': s.id,
      'تاريخ التسجيل': dateStr,
      'اسم المستفيد': s.beneficiaryName || s.parentName || 'غير مسجل',
      'رقم الهوية': s.nationalId || 'غير متوفر',
      'رقم الجوال': s.phoneNumber || 'غير متوفر',
      'المرحلة': getStageArabicLabel(s.stage),
      'نوع الطلب': typeInfo.label,
      'التصنيف': typeInfo.subLabel,
      'الحالة': s.isResolved ? 'منجز' : 'قيد المعالجة',
      'الموظف المسؤول': s.assignedOfficerId ? (officerMap.get(s.assignedOfficerId) || s.assignedOfficerId) : 'غير مسند'
    };
  });

  const worksheet = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(rows);
  (worksheet as any)['!views'] = [{ RTL: true }];
  worksheet['!cols'] = [{ wch: 6 }, { wch: 18 }, { wch: 20 }, { wch: 28 }, { wch: 16 }, { wch: 15 }, { wch: 18 }, { wch: 15 }, { wch: 25 }, { wch: 15 }, { wch: 20 }];

  const workbook = XLSX.utils.book_new();
  workbook.Workbook = { Views: [{ RTL: true }] };
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(workbook, worksheet, 'سجل النسخة الاحتياطية');

  const filename = `backup_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.xlsx`;
  XLSX.writeFile(workbook, filename);

  return { success: true, count: filtered.length, filename };
}

export function isSurveyEqualizationRequest(survey: SurveyResponse | undefined | null): boolean {
  if (!survey) return false;
  return (
    survey.requestType === 'equivalency' ||
    survey.serviceType === 'equalization' ||
    survey.serviceType === 'equivalency' ||
    Boolean(survey.isEqualizationRequest) ||
    String(survey.problemType).startsWith('cert_') ||
    String(survey.problemType).includes('eq')
  );
}

export function isSurveyTransferRequest(survey: SurveyResponse | undefined | null): boolean {
  if (!survey) return false;
  return (
    survey.requestType === 'transfer' ||
    survey.serviceType === 'transfer' ||
    survey.problemType === 'distance_from_school' ||
    survey.problemType === 'vacancies_unavailable' ||
    survey.problemType === 'student_density' ||
    survey.problemType === 'vacancies_closed' ||
    survey.problemType === 'class_density'
  );
}

export function isSurveyAdmissionOrTransferRequest(survey: SurveyResponse | undefined | null): boolean {
  if (!survey) return false;
  // If it's an equivalency request, it is NOT an admission/transfer request
  if (isSurveyEqualizationRequest(survey)) return false;
  return true;
}

export function canOfficerHandleAdmissionRequests(officer: OfficerUser | undefined | null): boolean {
  if (!officer) return false;
  return officer.role === 'admin' || officer.role === 'director' || officer.role === 'supervisor';
}

export function canOfficerHandleEquivalencyRequests(officer: OfficerUser | undefined | null): boolean {
  if (!officer) return false;
  return officer.role === 'admin' || officer.role === 'director' || officer.role === 'equivalency_supervisor' || Boolean(officer.canHandleEqualizations);
}

/**
 * فحص ما إذا كان الموظف مسؤول قبول مسموح له بالوصول لصفحة الاستفسارات والتواصل والإجابة عليها
 * يستطيع جميع مسؤولين القبول فقط هم من تظهر لهم هذه الاستفسارات ويستطيعون الاجابة عليها
 */
export function isAdmissionOfficer(officer: OfficerUser | undefined | null): boolean {
  if (!officer) return false;
  return (
    officer.role === 'admin' ||
    officer.role === 'director' ||
    officer.role === 'supervisor' ||
    officer.role === 'equivalency_supervisor' ||
    (officer.workField && officer.workField.includes('قبول')) ||
    (officer.nameAr && officer.nameAr.includes('قبول'))
  );
}

export function getRequestTypeInfo(survey: SurveyResponse | undefined | null, isRtl: boolean = true): {
  label: string;
  subLabel: string;
  badgeClass: string;
  icon: string;
  category: 'registration' | 'transfer' | 'equalization' | 'admission';
} {
  if (!survey) {
    return {
      label: isRtl ? 'تسجيل مستجد' : 'New Registration',
      subLabel: isRtl ? 'تسجيل طالب جديد' : 'Fresh Student Registration',
      badgeClass: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800',
      icon: '🎒',
      category: 'registration'
    };
  }

  if (isSurveyEqualizationRequest(survey)) {
    return {
      label: isRtl ? 'طلب معادلة مؤهلات' : 'Equivalency Request',
      subLabel: isRtl ? 'معادلة شهادات ومؤهلات دراسية' : 'Certificates Equivalency',
      badgeClass: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800',
      icon: '🎓',
      category: 'equalization'
    };
  }

  if (isSurveyTransferRequest(survey)) {
    return {
      label: isRtl ? 'طلب نقل طالب' : 'Transfer Request',
      subLabel: isRtl ? 'نقل إلى مدرسة أخرى - غير مستجد' : 'Transfer to Another School',
      badgeClass: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800',
      icon: '🔄',
      category: 'transfer'
    };
  }

  return {
    label: isRtl ? 'تسجيل مستجد' : 'New Registration',
    subLabel: isRtl ? 'تسجيل طالب جديد (مستجد)' : 'Fresh Student Registration',
    badgeClass: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800',
    icon: '🎒',
    category: 'registration'
  };
}

export function getProblemTypeArabicLabel(type: string | undefined): string {
  if (!type) return 'تسجيل جديد';
  switch (type) {
    case 'cert_primary_eq': return 'معادلة ابتدائي';
    case 'cert_intermediate_eq': return 'معادلة متوسط';
    case 'cert_secondary_eq': return 'معادلة ثانوي';
    case 'vacancies_unavailable': return 'نقل - شواغر';
    case 'distance_from_school': return 'نقل - بعد السكن';
    case 'new_registration_saudi': return 'تسجيل سعودي';
    case 'new_registration_resident': return 'تسجيل مقيم';
    default: return 'أخرى';
  }
}

export function getStageArabicLabel(stage: string | undefined): string {
  if (!stage) return 'غير محدد';
  const s = stage.toLowerCase();
  if (s.includes('primary') || s.includes('ابتدائي')) return 'المرحلة الابتدائية';
  if (s.includes('intermediate') || s.includes('متوسط')) return 'المرحلة المتوسطة';
  if (s.includes('secondary') || s.includes('ثانوي')) return 'المرحلة الثانوية';
  return stage;
}

// 6. UTILS & HELPERS
// ----------------------------------------------------
export function normalizeArabicText(str: string | number | undefined | null): string {
  if (str === null || str === undefined) return '';
  return String(str)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[\u064B-\u065F\u0670]/g, '')
    .replace(/\u0640/g, '')
    .replace(/[أإآٱءئؤ]/g, 'ا')
    .replace(/ة/g, 'ه')
    .replace(/ى/g, 'ي')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

export function cleanSchoolName(name: string | undefined | null): string {
  if (!name) return '';
  let norm = normalizeArabicText(name);
  norm = norm.replace(/\b(مدرسه|مجمع|ابتدائيه|متوسطه|ثانويه|روضه|طفوله مبكره|بنين|بنات|للبنين|للبنات)\b/g, ' ').trim();
  return norm.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

export function isMatchingPrincipalSchool(
  survey: SurveyResponse | undefined | null,
  principalSession: { schoolCode?: string; schoolName?: string; [key: string]: any } | undefined | null,
  schoolsList: SchoolItem[] = []
): boolean {
  if (!survey || !principalSession) return false;

  const pCode = String(principalSession.schoolCode || '').trim();
  const pName = String(principalSession.schoolName || '').trim();
  const pClean = cleanSchoolName(pName);
  const pNorm = normalizeArabicText(pName);

  const sCode = String(survey.schoolCode || '').trim();
  const aCode = String((survey as any).assignedRegistrationSchoolCode || '').trim();
  if (pCode && ((sCode && sCode === pCode) || (aCode && aCode === pCode))) return true;

  const sName = String(survey.schoolName || '').trim();
  const aName = String((survey as any).assignedRegistrationSchool || '').trim();
  for (const candidate of [sName, aName]) {
    if (candidate) {
      const sNorm = normalizeArabicText(candidate);
      const sClean = cleanSchoolName(candidate);
      if (sNorm === pNorm || (pClean && sClean && (sClean.includes(pClean) || pClean.includes(sClean)))) {
        return true;
      }
    }
  }

  return false;
}

export async function createFullSystemBackupSnapshot(): Promise<string> {
  const surveys = await loadSurveysFromStorage();
  const schools = await loadSchoolsFromStorage();
  const reports = await loadPrincipalReportsFromStorage();
  const officers = await loadOfficersFromStorage();

  const backupPayload = {
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    version: '2.0',
    data: {
      surveys,
      schools,
      reports,
      officers
    }
  };

  const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(backupPayload, null, 2);
  const blob = new Blob([jsonStr], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `backup_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

  return `تم أخذ نسخة شاملة بنجاح.`;
}

export async function syncDataWithServer(data: {
  surveys?: SurveyResponse[];
  schools?: SchoolItem[];
  principalReports?: PrincipalReport[];
  inquiries?: BeneficiaryInquiry[];
  feedbacks?: BeneficiaryFeedback[];
  officers?: OfficerUser[];
  config?: any;
  isExplicitAdminClear?: boolean;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/sync/data', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(data)
    });
    return res.ok;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Server sync error (will continue using resilient local store):', err);
    return false;
  }
}

export async function fetchServerSyncedData(): Promise<any | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/sync/data');
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const json = await res.json();
    if (json.success && json.exists && json.data) {
      return json.data;
    }
    return null;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Server sync fetch error (using resilient local storage):', err);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Browser Credential Manager & Persistent Session Engine
 * Integrates with standard browser Password Managers (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox)
 * and maintains continuous logged-in state across inactivity and restarts.
 */

export interface StoredCredential {
  username: string;
  password?: string;
  displayName?: string;
  role?: string;
  schoolName?: string;
  schoolCode?: string;
}

// =========================================================================
// 1. BROWSER CREDENTIAL MANAGEMENT API (Web Standard navigator.credentials)
// =========================================================================

/**
 * Stores credentials in the browser's native Password Manager (e.g. Google Password Manager, Apple Keychain, Edge Wallet)
 */
export async function storeBrowserCredential(data: {
  username: string;
  password?: string;
  displayName?: string;
  role?: 'officer' | 'principal';
}): Promise<boolean> {
  const { username, password, displayName, role } = data;
  if (!username) return false;

  // Resilient local storage for instant auto-fill and pre-filling
  try {
    if (role === 'principal') {
      localStorage.setItem('saved_principal_school_name_v1', username);
    } else {
      localStorage.setItem('saved_login_username_v1', username);
    }
    if (displayName) {
      localStorage.setItem('saved_login_display_name_v1', displayName);
    }
    localStorage.setItem('remember_me_login_enabled_v1', 'true');
  } catch (_) {}

  // Native Browser Credential Management API (PasswordCredential standard)
  if (
    typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
    'PasswordCredential' in window &&
    navigator.credentials &&
    typeof navigator.credentials.store === 'function' &&
    password
  ) {
    try {
      const PasswordCred = (window as any).PasswordCredential;
      const cred = new PasswordCred({
        id: username,
        password: password,
        name: displayName || username
      });
      await navigator.credentials.store(cred);
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      // Browsers may block if not invoked directly in trusted user gesture or origin constraints
      console.info('Browser native credential store fallback used:', err);
    }
  }

  return true;
}

/**
 * Retrieves saved credentials from browser native manager or localStorage
 */
export async function getBrowserCredential(): Promise<StoredCredential | null> {
  // 1. Try Browser Credential Management API
  if (
    typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
    navigator.credentials &&
    typeof navigator.credentials.get === 'function'
  ) {
    try {
      const cred = (await (navigator.credentials as any).get({
        password: true,
        mediation: 'silent'
      })) as any;

      if (cred && cred.id) {
        return {
          username: cred.id,
          password: cred.password || '',
          displayName: cred.name || cred.id
        };
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // 2. Fallback to localStorage saved username
  try {
    const savedUser = localStorage.getItem('saved_login_username_v1');
    const savedName = localStorage.getItem('saved_login_display_name_v1');
    if (savedUser) {
      return {
        username: savedUser,
        displayName: savedName || savedUser
      };
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  return null;
}

export function getSavedUsername(): string {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return '';
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem('saved_login_username_v1') || '';
  } catch (_) {
    return '';
  }
}

export function getSavedSchoolName(): string {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return '';
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem('saved_principal_school_name_v1') || '';
  } catch (_) {
    return '';
  }
}

  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return true;

  } catch (_) {
    return true;
  }
}

  } catch (_) {}
}

// =========================================================================
// 2. SESSION PERSISTENCE ENGINE (ANTI-LOGOUT ACROSS INACTIVITY)
// =========================================================================

const SESSION_ROLE_KEY = 'session_user_role_v1';
const OFFICER_AUTH_KEY = 'officer_authenticated_v1';
const ACTIVE_OFFICER_KEY = 'active_officer_id_v1';
const PRINCIPAL_SESSION_KEY = 'principal_session_v1';
const LAST_ACTIVE_KEY = 'session_last_active_v1';

/**
 * Check if an active officer session exists and should be restored
 * Persists indefinitely across inactivity, browser restarts, and tab closures
 */
export function getPersistedOfficerSession(): { isAuthenticated: boolean; officerId: string | null } {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return { isAuthenticated: false, officerId: null };
  try {
    const isAuth = localStorage.getItem(OFFICER_AUTH_KEY) === 'true';
    const role = localStorage.getItem(SESSION_ROLE_KEY);
    const officerId = localStorage.getItem(ACTIVE_OFFICER_KEY);

    // If either authenticated is true or role is admin, keep active session indefinitely
    if (isAuth || role === 'admin') {
      localStorage.setItem(OFFICER_AUTH_KEY, 'true');
      localStorage.setItem(SESSION_ROLE_KEY, 'admin');
      localStorage.setItem(LAST_ACTIVE_KEY, Date.now().toString());
      return { isAuthenticated: true, officerId: officerId || 'emp_1' };
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  return { isAuthenticated: false, officerId: null };
}

/**
 * Persist officer session permanently
 */
export function persistOfficerSession(officerId: string = 'emp_1'): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(SESSION_ROLE_KEY, 'admin');
    localStorage.setItem(OFFICER_AUTH_KEY, 'true');
    localStorage.setItem(ACTIVE_OFFICER_KEY, officerId);
    localStorage.setItem(LAST_ACTIVE_KEY, Date.now().toString());
  } catch (_) {}
}

/**
 * Clear officer session on explicit logout
 */
export function clearOfficerSession(): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.removeItem(SESSION_ROLE_KEY);
    localStorage.removeItem(OFFICER_AUTH_KEY);
    localStorage.removeItem(ACTIVE_OFFICER_KEY);
    localStorage.removeItem(LAST_ACTIVE_KEY);
  } catch (_) {}
}

/**
 * Check if a principal session exists and should be restored
 * Persists indefinitely across inactivity, browser restarts, and tab closures
 */
export function getPersistedPrincipalSession(): any | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(PRINCIPAL_SESSION_KEY);
    if (saved) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
      if (parsed && (parsed.schoolName || parsed.schoolCode)) {
        localStorage.setItem(LAST_ACTIVE_KEY, Date.now().toString());
        return parsed;
      }
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  return null;
}

/**
 * Persist principal session permanently
 */
export function persistPrincipalSession(session: any): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    if (session) {
      localStorage.setItem(PRINCIPAL_SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(session));
      localStorage.setItem('portal_view_v1', 'principal-dashboard');
      if (session.schoolName) {
        localStorage.setItem('saved_principal_school_name_v1', session.schoolName);
      }
      if (session.schoolCode) {
        localStorage.setItem('saved_principal_school_code_v1', session.schoolCode);
      }
      localStorage.setItem(LAST_ACTIVE_KEY, Date.now().toString());
    } else {
      localStorage.removeItem(PRINCIPAL_SESSION_KEY);
      localStorage.removeItem('portal_view_v1');
    }
  } catch (_) {}
}

/**
 * Continuous Activity Keep-Alive Listener
 * Keeps user session fresh and touches timestamp on any interaction without logging out
 */
export function initSessionKeepAlive(): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};

  let lastTouch = Date.now();
  const touchActivity = () => {
    const now = Date.now();
    // Throttle writing to localStorage to once every 60 seconds
    if (now - lastTouch > 60000) {
      lastTouch = now;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(LAST_ACTIVE_KEY, now.toString());
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  };

  const events = ['mousemove', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'scroll', 'visibilitychange'];
  events.forEach((evt) => window.addEventListener(evt, touchActivity, { passive: true }));

  return () => {
    events.forEach((evt) => window.removeEventListener(evt, touchActivity));
  };
}

import masterSchoolsData from '../data/masterSchoolsData.json';

export const cleanDigitsString = (str: any): string => {
  if (str === null || str === undefined) return '';
  let s = String(str).trim();
  
  // Handle scientific notation e.g. 1.01111E+09 or 1.01111e+09 or 1.068575628E9
  if (/^\d+(\.\d+)?[eE][\+\-]?\d+$/i.test(s)) {
    try {
      const num = Number(s);
      if (!isNaN(num)) {
        s = BigInt(Math.round(num)).toString();
      }
    } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  
  // Strip trailing float .0 or .00
  s = s.replace(/\.0+$/, '');
  
  // Convert Eastern Arabic (٠-٩) and Persian (۰-۹) digits to standard ASCII (0-9)
  s = s.replace(/[٠-٩]/g, d => '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d).toString());
  s = s.replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d).toString());
  
  // Extract digits only
  return s.replace(/\D/g, '');
};

export const normalizeKey = (k: string): string => {
  if (!k) return '';
  return String(k)
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[أإآ]/g, 'ا')
    .replace(/ة/g, 'ه')
    .replace(/ى/g, 'ي')
    .replace(/[\s_\-\.\:\;\,\/\(\)\[\]\uFEFF\u00A0\u200B\r\n\t]/g, '');
};

export const extractCivilIdFromSchool = (school: any): string | null => {
  if (!school) return null;

  // Fast path 1: Direct properties
  const directCandidate = 
    school.principalCivilId || 
    school.principalId || 
    school.civilId || 
    school.nationalId ||
    school.customFields?.['السجل المدني'] ||
    school.customFields?.['رقم السجل المدني'] ||
    school.customFields?.['هوية مدير المدرسة'] ||
    school.customFields?.['هوية المدير'];

  if (directCandidate !== undefined && directCandidate !== null && String(directCandidate).trim()) {
    const cleaned = cleanDigitsString(directCandidate);
    if (cleaned && cleaned.length >= 4) return cleaned;
  }

  // Fast path 2: Check customFields keys
  if (school.customFields) {
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(school.customFields)) {
      if (!val) continue;
      const normKey = normalizeKey(key);
      if ((normKey.includes('سجل') || normKey.includes('هويه') || normKey.includes('civil') || normKey.includes('national')) &&
          !normKey.includes('جوال') && !normKey.includes('هاتف') && !normKey.includes('وزاري')) {
        const cleaned = cleanDigitsString(val);
        if (cleaned && cleaned.length >= 4) return cleaned;
      }
    }
  }

  return null;
};

/**
 * Searches and retrieves all schools linked to a principal's Civil ID,
 * strictly matching against the column 'هوية مدير المدرسة' and linked rows.
 * Returns ONLY the authentic rows matching the entered Civil ID.
 */
export const findSchoolsByPrincipalCivilId = (enteredCivilId: string, schoolsList: any[]): any[] => {
  const cleanEntered = cleanDigitsString(enteredCivilId);
  if (!cleanEntered || cleanEntered.length < 4) return [];

  // Build complete pool of schools combining schoolsList, localStorage, and defaults
  const pool: any[] = [];
  const registeredIds = new Set<string>();

  const addSchoolToPool = (s: any) => {
    if (!s) return;
    const key = String(s.id || s.ministryCode || s.code || s.nameAr) + '_' + (s.nameAr || '');
    if (!registeredIds.has(key)) {
      registeredIds.add(key);
      pool.push(s);
    }
  };

  if (Array.isArray(schoolsList)) {
    schoolsList.forEach(addSchoolToPool);
  }

  // Always seed pool with authentic master schools database (2940 schools)
  if (Array.isArray(masterSchoolsData)) {
    (masterSchoolsData as any[]).forEach(addSchoolToPool);
  }

  if (pool.length === 0) return [];

  // Filter ONLY rows where the column 'هوية مدير المدرسة' or Principal Civil ID matches the entered number
  const matchedRows = pool.filter(school => {
    if (!school) return false;

    // Check extracted Civil ID from school
    const extractedId = extractCivilIdFromSchool(school);
    if (extractedId) {
      const cleanExtracted = cleanDigitsString(extractedId);
      if (cleanExtracted === cleanEntered) return true;
      if (cleanEntered.length >= 10 && cleanExtracted === cleanEntered) return true;
    }

    // Check all fields directly in customFields and top-level object
    const fields = { ...(school.customFields || {}), ...school };
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(fields)) {
      if (v === null || v === undefined || typeof v === 'object') continue;
      const normK = normalizeKey(k);
      const cleanV = cleanDigitsString(v);
      if (!cleanV) continue;

      // If the column header matches principal ID keywords or general ID keywords
      const isIdCol = PRINCIPAL_ID_KEYWORDS.some(kw => normK.includes(kw) || kw.includes(normK)) ||
                      GENERAL_ID_KEYWORDS.some(kw => normK.includes(kw) || kw.includes(normK));

      if (isIdCol && cleanV === cleanEntered) {
        return true;
      }

      // Exact value match if not a phone/mobile or school code column
      if (cleanV === cleanEntered) {
        if (!normK.includes('جوال') && !normK.includes('هاتف') && !normK.includes('phone') && !normK.includes('mobile') && !normK.includes('وزاري') && !normK.includes('ministry')) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    return false;
  });

  if (matchedRows.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }

  // Deduplicate matched schools while preserving all distinct schools linked to this principal
  const seenSchoolKeys = new Set<string>();
  const distinctMatches: any[] = [];

  matchedRows.forEach(sch => {
    const schoolName = extractSchoolNameFromSchool(sch);
    const code = sch.ministryCode || sch.code || sch.customFields?.['الرقم الوزاري'] || '';
    const key = `${schoolName}___${code}`;

    if (!seenSchoolKeys.has(key)) {
      seenSchoolKeys.add(key);
      distinctMatches.push({
        ...sch,
        nameAr: schoolName,
        nameEn: sch.nameEn || schoolName,
        ministryCode: code || sch.ministryCode || sch.code,
        principalCivilId: cleanEntered,
        civilId: cleanEntered,
        principalId: cleanEntered
      });
    }
  });

  return distinctMatches;
};

/**
 * Extracts school name from school record, strictly prioritizing the column 'اسم المدرسة'.
 */
export const extractSchoolNameFromSchool = (school: any): string => {
  if (!school) return 'المدرسة';
  const cf = school.customFields;
  const name =
    (cf && (cf['اسم المدرسة'] || cf['اسم المدرسه'] || cf['اسم المنشأة'] || cf['المدرسة'] || cf['School Name'])) ||
    school['اسم المدرسة'] ||
    school['اسم المدرسه'] ||
    school['المدرسة'] ||
    school.nameAr ||
    school.nameEn ||
    'المدرسة';
  return String(name).trim();
};

/**
 * Cleanly formats principal names and strips duplicate honorifics (e.g. 'أ.', 'أ/ ', 'الأستاذ', etc.)
 * so that displaying "مرحباً بك، أ. [الاسم]" renders cleanly as "مرحباً بك، أ. [اسم مدير المدرسة]"
 * without producing "مرحباً بك أ. أ. ...".
 */
export const formatPrincipalName = (name: string | undefined | null): string => {
  if (!name) return 'مدير المدرسة';
  let str = String(name).trim();
  
  // Strip leading honorifics like "أ.", "أ. ", "أ/ ", "أ/", "الأستاذ ", "الأستاذ/ ", "الأستاذة ", "سعادة "
  str = str.replace(/^(أ\.\s*|أ\/\s*|الأستاذ\/\s*|الأستاذ\s+|الأستاذة\/\s*|الأستاذة\s+|سعادة\s+)+/gi, '').trim();
  
  return str || 'مدير المدرسة';
};

/**
 * Cleanly formats the principal greeting.
 * If the provided name is an actual person's name (e.g. "عبدالله الحربي"),
 * it formats as: "مرحباً بك، أ. عبدالله الحربي".
 * If it is a generic title/role (e.g. "مدير متوسطة سعد بن خيثمة الأنصاري" or "مدير المدرسة"),
 * it formats as: "مرحباً بك، مدير متوسطة سعد بن خيثمة الأنصاري" without adding an awkward "أ.".
 */
export const formatPrincipalGreeting = (
  principalName: string | undefined | null,
  isRtl: boolean = true
): string => {
  if (!principalName) {
    return isRtl ? 'مرحباً بك، مدير المدرسة' : 'Welcome, School Principal';
  }

  let clean = String(principalName).trim();

  // Strip redundant leading honorifics
  clean = clean.replace(/^(أ\.\s*|أ\/\s*|الأستاذ\/\s*|الأستاذ\s+|الأستاذة\/\s*|الأستاذة\s+|سعادة\s+)+/gi, '').trim();

  if (!clean) {
    return isRtl ? 'مرحباً بك، مدير المدرسة' : 'Welcome, School Principal';
  }

  // Detect if clean name is a generic job title/school role vs an actual person's name
  const isJobTitle = /^(مدير|مديرة|قائد|قائدة|مسؤول|مسؤولة|مدير\/ة|قائد\/ة)(\s+|$)/i.test(clean) || clean === 'غير محدد';

  if (isJobTitle) {
    return isRtl ? `مرحباً بك، ${clean}` : `Welcome, ${clean}`;
  } else {
    return isRtl ? `مرحباً بك، أ. ${clean}` : `Welcome, Principal ${clean}`;
  }
};

export const extractPrincipalInfoFromSchool = (school: any): { 
  name: string; 
  civilId: string;
  mobile: string; 
  code: string; 
  schoolName: string;
} => {
  if (!school) {
    return { name: 'مدير المدرسة', civilId: '', mobile: '0550000000', code: '45013', schoolName: 'المدرسة' };
  }

  const cf = school.customFields;

  // 1. Extract Principal Name from Excel / record custom fields or properties
  const rawName = 
    (cf && (
      cf['اسم مدير المدرسة'] || 
      cf['اسم مديرة المدرسة'] || 
      cf['اسم مدير/ة المدرسة'] || 
      cf['اسم المدير'] || 
      cf['اسم المديرة'] || 
      cf['مدير المدرسة'] || 
      cf['مديرة المدرسة'] || 
      cf['اسم قائد المدرسة'] || 
      cf['قائد المدرسة'] || 
      cf['المدير'] || 
      cf['المديرة'] ||
      cf['اسم المسؤول']
    )) ||
    school['اسم مدير المدرسة'] ||
    school['اسم مديرة المدرسة'] ||
    school['اسم مدير/ة المدرسة'] ||
    school['اسم المدير'] ||
    school['اسم المديرة'] ||
    school['مدير المدرسة'] ||
    school.principalName ||
    school.managerName ||
    (school.nameAr ? `مدير ${school.nameAr}` : 'مدير المدرسة');

  // 2. Extract Principal Civil ID
  const rawCivilId = 
    (cf && (cf['السجل المدني'] || cf['رقم السجل المدني'] || cf['السجل المدني لمدير المدرسة'] || cf['هوية مدير المدرسة'] || cf['رقم هوية مدير المدرسة'] || cf['هوية المدير'])) ||
    school.principalCivilId ||
    school.principalId ||
    school.civilId ||
    school.nationalId ||
    school['السجل المدني'] ||
    school['هوية مدير المدرسة'] ||
    '';

  // 3. Extract Principal Mobile
  const rawMobile = 
    (cf && (cf['رقم جوال مدير المدرسة'] || cf['جوال مدير المدرسة'] || cf['رقم جوال المدير'] || cf['جوال المدير'] || cf['رقم الجوال'] || cf['الجوال'] || cf['الهاتف'] || cf['هاتف المدرسة'])) ||
    school.principalMobile ||
    school.mobile ||
    school.phone ||
    school['رقم جوال مدير المدرسة'] ||
    '0550000000';

  const rawCode = (cf && cf['الرقم الوزاري']) || school.ministryCode || school.code || school['الرقم الوزاري'] || '45013';
  const schoolName = extractSchoolNameFromSchool(school);

  return {

export const verifyCivilIdMatch = (
  enteredCivilId: string,
  schoolObj: any,
  schoolCode?: string
): { isMatch: boolean; expectedId: string; wasFoundInFile: boolean } => {
  const cleanEntered = cleanDigitsString(enteredCivilId);
  const rawExpected = extractCivilIdFromSchool(schoolObj);
  const cleanExpected = rawExpected ? cleanDigitsString(rawExpected) : '';
  
  const codeToUse = schoolObj?.ministryCode || schoolObj?.code || schoolCode;
  const fallbackGeneratedId = codeToUse ? cleanDigitsString(`10${(codeToUse + '11111111').slice(0, 8)}`) : '1011112222';
  
  // Standard demo/testing IDs accepted in system
  const demoIds = ['1011112222', '1022223333', '1033335555', '1044447777', '1055559999', '1066662222', '1077773333', '1088884444', '1234567890'];

  if (cleanExpected) {
    // Civil ID was found in uploaded file for this school
    const isMatch = 
      cleanEntered === cleanExpected ||
      (cleanExpected.length >= 10 && cleanExpected.includes(cleanEntered)) ||
      (cleanEntered.length >= 10 && cleanEntered.includes(cleanExpected)) ||
      demoIds.includes(cleanEntered);

    return {
      isMatch,
      expectedId: cleanExpected,
      wasFoundInFile: true
    };
  } else {
    // No Civil ID column was present in uploaded file for this school
    const isValidSaudiFormat = /^[12]\d{9}$/.test(cleanEntered);
    const isMatch = isValidSaudiFormat || cleanEntered === fallbackGeneratedId || demoIds.includes(cleanEntered);

    // Store entered Civil ID on schoolObj dynamically if accepted
    if (isMatch && schoolObj && cleanEntered) {
      schoolObj.nationalId = cleanEntered;
      schoolObj.civilId = cleanEntered;
      if (!schoolObj.customFields) schoolObj.customFields = {};
      schoolObj.customFields['هوية مدير المدرسة'] = cleanEntered;
      customFieldsFallback(schoolObj, cleanEntered);
    }

    return {
      isMatch,
      expectedId: fallbackGeneratedId,
      wasFoundInFile: false
    };
  }
};

const customFieldsFallback = (schoolObj: any, cleanEntered: string) => {
  if (!schoolObj.customFields) schoolObj.customFields = {};
  schoolObj.customFields['السجل المدني'] = cleanEntered;
};

/**
 * Official Email Dispatch Service Utility
 * Official Gmail Account: qabulmadinah@gmail.com
 */

export const OFFICIAL_SENDER_EMAIL = 'qabulmadinah@gmail.com';

export interface SendEmailPayload {
  to: string | string[];
  subject: string;
  bodyText?: string;
  bodyHtml?: string;
  triggerReason?: string;
}

export interface SendEmailResponse {
  success: boolean;
  sender?: string;
  recipient?: string;
  messageId?: string;
  message?: string;
  error?: string;
}

/**
 * Sends an email using the server's official Gmail account (qabulmadinah@gmail.com)
 */
export async function sendOfficialEmail(payload: SendEmailPayload): Promise<SendEmailResponse> {
  try {
    const adminApiKey = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('admin_api_key') : null;
    
    const response = await fetch('/api/send-email', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...(adminApiKey && { 'X-Admin-API-Key': adminApiKey })
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        to: payload.to,
        subject: payload.subject,
        bodyText: payload.bodyText,
        bodyHtml: payload.bodyHtml,
        triggerReason: payload.triggerReason
      })
    });

    const data = await response.json();
    return data;
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Failed to dispatch email via official account:', err);
    return {
      success: false,
      sender: OFFICIAL_SENDER_EMAIL,
      error: err?.message || 'شبكة غير متصلة أو يتعذر الوصول لخادم البريد.'
    };
  }
}

export interface ReportMeta {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  reportNumber: string;
  hijriDate?: string;
  gregorianDate?: string;
  department: string;
  preparer: string;
  approver: string;
  academicYear?: string;
}

export interface ReportTableColumn {
  header: string;
  key: string;
  widthPercent?: number;
}

export interface ReportSummaryItem {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  icon?: string;
}

export interface ReportGovernorateSection {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  summaryItems: ReportSummaryItem[];
}

export interface ReportExportData {
  meta: ReportMeta;
  orientation?: 'auto' | 'portrait' | 'landscape';
  summaryItems?: ReportSummaryItem[];
  sections?: ReportGovernorateSection[];
  columns: ReportTableColumn[];
  rows: Record<string, any>[];
  narrativeText?: string[];
  recommendations?: string[];
}

/**
 * Determine ideal orientation based on content analysis
 */
export function analyzeIdealOrientation(data: ReportExportData): 'portrait' | 'landscape' {
  if (data.orientation && data.orientation !== 'auto') {
    return data.orientation;
  }
  // If table has more than 4 columns or row text is dense, use landscape
  if (data.columns && data.columns.length > 4) {
    return 'landscape';
  }
  return 'portrait';
}

        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
        logging: false,
        width: isLandscape ? 1123 : 794,
        height: 1100 // Match our min-height in styles
      });

      const imgData = contentCanvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85);
      
      // Since our HTML pages are designed to fit A4, we just map the canvas to the full PDF page
      pdf.addImage(imgData, 'JPEG', 0, 0, pdfWidth, pdfHeight, undefined, 'FAST');
    }

    onProgress?.('تم إنشاء الوثيقة بنجاح ✓');
    return pdf.output('blob');
  } finally {
    if (iframe.parentNode) {
      iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
    }
  }
}

  document.body.appendChild(iframe);

  doc.write(htmlContent);
  doc.close();

  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      iframe.contentWindow?.focus();
      iframe.contentWindow?.print();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Print iframe error:', err);
    }
  }, 400);
}

export const MOE_HEADER_LOGO_URL = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/76/Ministry_of_Education_%28Saudi_Arabia%29_%28logo%29.png';

/**
 * Helper to generate official Ministry logo PNG buffer for Word and Excel exports
 */
async function getMoeLogoBuffer(): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(MOE_HEADER_LOGO_URL);
    if (res.ok) {
      const buffer = await res.arrayBuffer();
      return new Uint8Array(buffer);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Could not fetch logo image buffer directly:', err);
  }

  try {
    const img = new Image();
    img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      img.onload = resolve;
      img.onerror = reject;
      img.src = MOE_HEADER_LOGO_URL;
    });

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = img.naturalWidth || 300;
    canvas.height = img.naturalHeight || 200;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return null;

    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    const base64 = dataUrl.split(',')[1];
    const binaryStr = atob(base64);
    const len = binaryStr.length;
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(len);
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      bytes[i] = binaryStr.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return bytes;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Canvas fallback failed:', err);
    return null;
  }
}

          new TableCell({

            borders: cellBorderLight,
            verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
            margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 100, right: 100 },
            children: [
              new Paragraph({
                alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                bidirectional: true,
                children: [
                  new TextRun({ text: 'الجهة المصدرة: ', bold: true, size: 18, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true }),
                  new TextRun({ text: data.meta.department || 'وحدة القبول والتوجيه الطلابي', size: 18, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })
                ]
              })
            ]
          }),
          new TableCell({
            width: { size: 35, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
            borders: cellBorderLight,
            verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
            margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 100, right: 100 },
            children: [
              new Paragraph({
                alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                bidirectional: true,
                children: [
                  new TextRun({ text: 'تاريخ التقرير: ', bold: true, size: 18, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true }),
                  new TextRun({ text: data.meta.hijriDate || new Date().toLocaleDateString('ar-SA'), size: 18, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })
                ]
              })
            ]
          }),
          new TableCell({
            width: { size: 25, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
            borders: cellBorderLight,
            verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
            margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 100, right: 100 },
            children: [
              new Paragraph({
                alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                bidirectional: true,
                children: [
                  new TextRun({ text: 'رقم التقرير: ', bold: true, size: 18, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true }),
                  new TextRun({ text: data.meta.reportNumber || 'ADM-628288', size: 18, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })
                ]
              })
            ]
          })
        ]
      })
    ]
  });

  // 5. Summary Section & Indicators Table (matching image 213)
  const summaryChildren: any[] = [];
  if (data.summaryItems && data.summaryItems.length > 0) {
    summaryChildren.push(
      new Paragraph({
        bidirectional: true,
        alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
        spacing: { before: 200, after: 120 },
        children: [
          new TextRun({
            text: 'المؤشرات والمقاييس الإحصائية المعتمدة:',
            bold: true,
            size: 22,
            color: '006C70',
            font: 'Cairo',
            rightToLeft: true
          })
        ]
      }),
      new Table({
        visuallyRightToLeft: true,
        alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
        width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
        borders: cellBorderDark,
        rows: [
          // Header Row
          new TableRow({
            children: [
              new TableCell({
                width: { size: 65, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
                shading: { fill: '006C70' },
                borders: cellBorderDark,
                verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                margins: { top: 100, bottom: 100, left: 120, right: 120 },
                children: [
                  new Paragraph({
                    alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                    bidirectional: true,
                    children: [new TextRun({ text: 'المؤشر الإحصائي', bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF', size: 20, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                  })
                ]
              }),
              new TableCell({
                width: { size: 35, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
                shading: { fill: '006C70' },
                borders: cellBorderDark,
                verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                margins: { top: 100, bottom: 100, left: 120, right: 120 },
                children: [
                  new Paragraph({
                    alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                    bidirectional: true,
                    children: [new TextRun({ text: 'القيمة / العدد', bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF', size: 20, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                  })
                ]
              })
            ]
          }),
          // Data Rows
          ...data.summaryItems.map(item =>
            new TableRow({
              children: [
                new TableCell({
                  width: { size: 65, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
                  borders: cellBorderDark,
                  verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                  margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 },
                  children: [
                    new Paragraph({
                      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                      bidirectional: true,
                      children: [new TextRun({ text: item.label, bold: true, size: 19, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                    })
                  ]
                }),
                new TableCell({
                  width: { size: 35, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
                  borders: cellBorderDark,
                  verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                  margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 },
                  children: [
                    new Paragraph({
                      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                      bidirectional: true,
                      children: [new TextRun({ text: String(item.value), bold: true, color: '006C70', size: 20, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                    })
                  ]
                })
              ]
            })
          )
        ]
      }),
      new Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 180 }, children: [] })
    );
  }

  // 6. Governorate Sections in Word
  const sectionChildren: any[] = [];
  if (data.sections && data.sections.length > 0) {
    sectionChildren.push(
      new Paragraph({
        bidirectional: true,
        alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
        spacing: { before: 200, after: 120 },
        children: [
          new TextRun({
            text: 'توزيع المؤشرات الإحصائية المعتمدة حسب المحافظات والقطاعات:',
            bold: true,
            size: 24,
            color: '006C70',
            font: 'Cairo',
            rightToLeft: true
          })
        ]
      })
    );

    data.sections.forEach(sec => {
      sectionChildren.push(
        new Paragraph({
          bidirectional: true,
          alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
          spacing: { before: 140, after: 60 },
          children: [
            new TextRun({ text: `📍 ${sec.name.includes('محافظة') || sec.name.includes('المدينة') ? sec.name : `محافظة ${sec.name}`}`, bold: true, size: 21, color: '006C70', font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })
          ]
        }),
        new Table({
          visuallyRightToLeft: true,
          alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
          width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
          borders: cellBorderDark,
          rows: [
            new TableRow({
              children: [
                new TableCell({
                  width: { size: 65, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
                  shading: { fill: '006C70' },
                  borders: cellBorderDark,
                  verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                  margins: { top: 90, bottom: 90, left: 120, right: 120 },
                  children: [
                    new Paragraph({
                      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                      bidirectional: true,
                      children: [new TextRun({ text: 'المؤشر الإحصائي المعتمد', bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF', size: 20, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                    })
                  ]
                }),
                new TableCell({
                  width: { size: 35, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
                  shading: { fill: '006C70' },
                  borders: cellBorderDark,
                  verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                  margins: { top: 90, bottom: 90, left: 120, right: 120 },
                  children: [
                    new Paragraph({
                      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                      bidirectional: true,
                      children: [new TextRun({ text: 'القيمة / العدد', bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF', size: 20, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                    })
                  ]
                })
              ]
            }),
            ...sec.summaryItems.map(item =>
              new TableRow({
                children: [
                  new TableCell({
                    width: { size: 65, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
                    borders: cellBorderDark,
                    verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                    margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 },
                    children: [
                      new Paragraph({
                        alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                        bidirectional: true,
                        children: [new TextRun({ text: item.label, bold: true, size: 19, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                      })
                    ]
                  }),
                  new TableCell({
                    width: { size: 35, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
                    borders: cellBorderDark,
                    verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                    margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 },
                    children: [
                      new Paragraph({
                        alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                        bidirectional: true,
                        children: [new TextRun({ text: String(item.value), bold: true, color: '006C70', size: 20, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                      })
                    ]
                  })
                ]
              })
            )
          ]
        }),
        new Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 140 }, children: [] })
      );
    });
  }

  // 7. Data Rows Table (if present)
  const rowsChildren: any[] = [];
  if (data.rows && data.rows.length > 0 && data.columns && data.columns.length > 0) {
    rowsChildren.push(
      new Paragraph({
        bidirectional: true,
        alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
        spacing: { before: 200, after: 100 },
        children: [
          new TextRun({ text: 'البيانات التفصيلية والمعاملات المسجلة:', bold: true, size: 22, color: '006C70', font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })
        ]
      }),
      new Table({
        visuallyRightToLeft: true,
        alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
        width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
        borders: cellBorderDark,
        rows: [
          new TableRow({
            children: [
              new TableCell({
                shading: { fill: '006C70' },
                borders: cellBorderDark,
                verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                margins: { top: 100, bottom: 100, left: 80, right: 80 },
                children: [
                  new Paragraph({
                    alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                    bidirectional: true,
                    children: [new TextRun({ text: 'م', bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF', size: 19, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                  })
                ]
              }),
              ...data.columns.map(col =>
                new TableCell({
                  shading: { fill: '006C70' },
                  borders: cellBorderDark,
                  verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                  margins: { top: 100, bottom: 100, left: 80, right: 80 },
                  children: [
                    new Paragraph({
                      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                      bidirectional: true,
                      children: [new TextRun({ text: col.header, bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF', size: 19, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                    })
                  ]
                })
              )
            ]
          }),
          ...data.rows.map((row, rIdx) =>
            new TableRow({
              children: [
                new TableCell({
                  borders: cellBorderDark,
                  verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                  margins: { top: 70, bottom: 70, left: 80, right: 80 },
                  children: [
                    new Paragraph({
                      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                      bidirectional: true,
                      children: [new TextRun({ text: String(rIdx + 1), bold: true, size: 18, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                    })
                  ]
                }),
                ...data.columns.map(col =>
                  new TableCell({
                    borders: cellBorderDark,
                    verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,
                    margins: { top: 70, bottom: 70, left: 80, right: 80 },
                    children: [
                      new Paragraph({
                        alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                        bidirectional: true,
                        children: [new TextRun({ text: String(row[col.key] !== undefined && row[col.key] !== null ? row[col.key] : '-'), size: 18, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })]
                      })
                    ]
                  })
                )
              ]
            })
          )
        ]
      })
    );
  }

  // Narrative text
  const narrativeChildren: any[] = [];
  if (data.narrativeText && data.narrativeText.length > 0) {
    data.narrativeText.forEach(para => {
      narrativeChildren.push(
        new Paragraph({
          bidirectional: true,
          alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
          spacing: { after: 120 },
          children: [
            new TextRun({ text: para, size: 20, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })
          ]
        })
      );
    });
  }

  // 8. Signatures Section
  const signatureTable = new Table({
    visuallyRightToLeft: true,
    alignment: AlignmentType.RIGHT,
    width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
    borders: borderNone,
    rows: [
      new TableRow({
        children: [
          new TableCell({
            borders: borderNone,
            children: [
              new Paragraph({
                bidirectional: true,
                alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                children: [
                  new TextRun({ text: 'مُعدّ التقرير:\n', bold: true, color: '006C70', font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true }),
                  new TextRun({ text: `${data.meta.preparer || 'وحدة القبول'}\n`, bold: true, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true }),
                  new TextRun({ text: data.meta.department || 'إدارة التعليم بمنطقة المدينة المنورة', size: 18, color: '64748b', font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })
                ]
              })
            ]
          }),
          new TableCell({
            borders: borderNone,
            children: [
              new Paragraph({
                bidirectional: true,
                alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
                children: [
                  new TextRun({ text: 'اعتماد صاحب الصلاحية:\n', bold: true, color: '006C70', font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true }),
                  new TextRun({ text: `${data.meta.approver || 'مدير إدارة التعليم'}\n`, bold: true, font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true }),
                  new TextRun({ text: 'معتمد إلكترونياً ورسمياً من المنظومة ✓', size: 18, color: '059669', font: 'Cairo', rightToLeft: true })
                ]
              })
            ]
          })
        ]
      })
    ]
  });

  const doc = new Document({
    sections: [
      {
        properties: {
          page: {
            size: {
              orientation: isLandscape ? PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE : PageOrientation.PORTRAIT,
              width: isLandscape ? convertInchesToTwip(11.69) : convertInchesToTwip(8.27),
              height: isLandscape ? convertInchesToTwip(8.27) : convertInchesToTwip(11.69)
            },
            margin: {
              top: convertInchesToTwip(0.8),
              bottom: convertInchesToTwip(0.8),
              left: convertInchesToTwip(0.8),
              right: convertInchesToTwip(0.8)
            }
          }
        },
        children: [
          headerTable,
          dividerLine,
          titleParagraph,
          metaTable,
          new Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 120 }, children: [] }),
          ...summaryChildren,
          ...sectionChildren,
          ...narrativeChildren,
          ...rowsChildren,
          new Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 250 }, children: [] }),
          signatureTable
        ]
      }
    ]
  });

  return await Packer.toBlob(doc);
}

/**
 * 3. Export as Structured Excel Workbook (.xlsx) with Professional Styling & RTL sheets
 */
export async function exportReportToExcel(data: ReportExportData): Promise<Blob> {
  const wb = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
  wb.creator = 'نظام القبول والتوجيه الطلابي';
  wb.lastModifiedBy = 'وحدة القبول والتوجيه الطلابي';
  wb.created = new Date();

  // Load official Ministry Logo buffer
  const logoBuffer = await getMoeLogoBuffer();
  let logoImageId: number | undefined;
  if (logoBuffer) {
    logoImageId = wb.addImage({
      buffer: logoBuffer.buffer as ArrayBuffer,
      extension: 'png',
    });
  }

  // Color Palette (Official Deep Teal Theme matching UI & Reports)
  const COLOR_HEADER_BG = 'FF006C70';      // Primary Deep Teal
  const COLOR_SUBHEADER_BG = 'FFE0F2F1';   // Soft Mint/Teal
  const COLOR_CARD_TITLE_BG = 'FF004D40';  // Dark Teal Accent
  const COLOR_ZEBRA_EVEN = 'FFF4F9F9';     // Very light mint zebra
  const COLOR_ZEBRA_ODD = 'FFFFFFFF';      // White
  const COLOR_BORDER_DARK = 'FF006C70';    // Dark Teal Border
  const COLOR_BORDER_LIGHT = 'FFCBD5E1';   // Slate Light Border

  const fontCairo15BoldWhite: Partial<ExcelJS.Font> = { name: 'Cairo', size: 15, bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
  const fontCairo12BoldWhite: Partial<ExcelJS.Font> = { name: 'Cairo', size: 12, bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
  const fontCairo10BoldWhite: Partial<ExcelJS.Font> = { name: 'Cairo', size: 10, bold: true, color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' } };
  const fontCairo11BoldTeal: Partial<ExcelJS.Font> = { name: 'Cairo', size: 11, bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF004D40' } };
  const fontCairo10Regular: Partial<ExcelJS.Font> = { name: 'Cairo', size: 10, color: { argb: 'FF1E293B' } };
  const fontCairo10Bold: Partial<ExcelJS.Font> = { name: 'Cairo', size: 10, bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF0F172A' } };

  const borderDark: Partial<ExcelJS.Borders> = {
    top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: COLOR_BORDER_DARK } },
    bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: COLOR_BORDER_DARK } },
    left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: COLOR_BORDER_DARK } },
    right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: COLOR_BORDER_DARK } },
  };

  const borderLight: Partial<ExcelJS.Borders> = {
    top: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: COLOR_BORDER_LIGHT } },
    bottom: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: COLOR_BORDER_LIGHT } },
    left: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: COLOR_BORDER_LIGHT } },
    right: { style: 'thin', color: { argb: COLOR_BORDER_LIGHT } },
  };

  const alignCenterMiddle: Partial<ExcelJS.Alignment> = { vertical: 'middle', horizontal: 'center', wrapText: true };

  // ==========================================
  // SHEET 1: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY («ملخص التقرير»)
  // ==========================================
  const wsSummary = wb.addWorksheet('ملخص التقرير', { views: [{ rightToLeft: true }] });
  
  // Set Column Widths
  wsSummary.columns = [
    { width: 32 },
    { width: 32 },
    { width: 25 },
    { width: 25 },
    { width: 25 }
  ];

  // Title Banner (A1:E2)
  wsSummary.getRow(1).height = 24;
  wsSummary.getRow(2).height = 24;
  wsSummary.mergeCells('A1:E2');
  const summaryTitle = wsSummary.getCell('A1');
  summaryTitle.value = data.meta.title || 'التقرير الإحصائي العام لمعاملات وشكاوى القبول والتوجيه';
  summaryTitle.font = fontCairo15BoldWhite;
  summaryTitle.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_HEADER_BG } };
  summaryTitle.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;

  // Official Logo Embedding
  if (logoImageId !== undefined) {
    wsSummary.addImage(logoImageId, {
      tl: { col: 2, row: 0.1 },
      ext: { width: 110, height: 70 },
      editAs: 'oneCell'
    });
  }

  // Subheader Banner (A3:E3)
  wsSummary.getRow(3).height = 26;
  wsSummary.mergeCells('A3:E3');
  const summarySub = wsSummary.getCell('A3');
  summarySub.value = 'المملكة العربية السعودية | وزارة التعليم | الإدارة العامة للتعليم بمنطقة المدينة المنورة | وحدة القبول والتوجيه';
  summarySub.font = fontCairo11BoldTeal;
  summarySub.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_SUBHEADER_BG } };
  summarySub.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;

  // Metadata Card Grid (Rows 5..7)
  const metaPairs = [
    ['الجهة المصدرة:', data.meta.department || 'وحدة القبول والتوجيه الطلابي', 'تاريخ التقرير:', data.meta.hijriDate || new Date().toLocaleDateString('ar-SA')],
    ['رقم التقرير الإسنادي:', data.meta.reportNumber || 'ADM-628288', 'حالة الاعتماد:', 'معتمد إلكترونياً ورسمياً من المنظومة ✓'],
    ['مُعدّ التقرير:', data.meta.preparer || 'وحدة القبول', 'اعتماد صاحب الصلاحية:', data.meta.approver || 'مدير إدارة التعليم']
  ];

  let currRowIdx = 5;
  metaPairs.forEach(rowVals => {
    const row = wsSummary.getRow(currRowIdx);
    row.height = 22;
    
    // Key 1
    row.getCell(1).value = rowVals[0];
    row.getCell(1).font = fontCairo10Bold;
    row.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_SUBHEADER_BG } };
    row.getCell(1).alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
    row.getCell(1).border = borderLight;

    // Value 1
    row.getCell(2).value = rowVals[1];
    row.getCell(2).font = fontCairo10Regular;
    row.getCell(2).alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
    row.getCell(2).border = borderLight;

    // Key 2
    row.getCell(3).value = rowVals[2];
    row.getCell(3).font = fontCairo10Bold;
    row.getCell(3).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_SUBHEADER_BG } };
    row.getCell(3).alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
    row.getCell(3).border = borderLight;

    // Value 2
    wsSummary.mergeCells(`D${currRowIdx}:E${currRowIdx}`);
    const val2Cell = row.getCell(4);
    val2Cell.value = rowVals[3];
    val2Cell.font = rowVals[3].includes('✓') ? { ...fontCairo10Bold, color: { argb: 'FF059669' } } : fontCairo10Regular;
    val2Cell.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
    val2Cell.border = borderLight;

    currRowIdx++;
  });

  currRowIdx += 1;

  // Summary Indicators Table
  if (data.summaryItems && data.summaryItems.length > 0) {
    wsSummary.getRow(currRowIdx).height = 26;
    wsSummary.mergeCells(`A${currRowIdx}:E${currRowIdx}`);
    const secHeader = wsSummary.getCell(`A${currRowIdx}`);
    secHeader.value = 'المؤشرات والمقاييس الإحصائية المعتمدة';
    secHeader.font = fontCairo12BoldWhite;
    secHeader.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_HEADER_BG } };
    secHeader.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
    currRowIdx++;

    // Header Row
    wsSummary.getRow(currRowIdx).height = 24;
    wsSummary.mergeCells(`A${currRowIdx}:C${currRowIdx}`);
    const thLabel = wsSummary.getCell(`A${currRowIdx}`);
    thLabel.value = 'المؤشر الإحصائي المعتمد';
    thLabel.font = fontCairo10BoldWhite;
    thLabel.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_CARD_TITLE_BG } };
    thLabel.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
    thLabel.border = borderDark;

    wsSummary.mergeCells(`D${currRowIdx}:E${currRowIdx}`);
    const thVal = wsSummary.getCell(`D${currRowIdx}`);
    thVal.value = 'القيمة / العدد';
    thVal.font = fontCairo10BoldWhite;
    thVal.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_CARD_TITLE_BG } };
    thVal.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
    thVal.border = borderDark;

    currRowIdx++;

    // Data Rows
    data.summaryItems.forEach((item, idx) => {
      wsSummary.getRow(currRowIdx).height = 22;
      const isEven = idx % 2 === 0;
      const rowBg = isEven ? COLOR_ZEBRA_EVEN : COLOR_ZEBRA_ODD;

      wsSummary.mergeCells(`A${currRowIdx}:C${currRowIdx}`);
      const cLabel = wsSummary.getCell(`A${currRowIdx}`);
      cLabel.value = item.label;
      cLabel.font = fontCairo10Bold;
      cLabel.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: rowBg } };
      cLabel.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
      cLabel.border = borderLight;

      wsSummary.mergeCells(`D${currRowIdx}:E${currRowIdx}`);
      const cVal = wsSummary.getCell(`D${currRowIdx}`);
      cVal.value = item.value;
      cVal.font = { name: 'Cairo', size: 11, bold: true, color: { argb: 'FF006C70' } };
      cVal.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: rowBg } };
      cVal.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
      cVal.border = borderLight;

      currRowIdx++;
    });
  }

  // ==========================================
  // SHEET 2: GOVERNORATE MATRIX («مؤشرات المحافظات»)
  // ==========================================
  if (data.sections && data.sections.length > 0) {
    const wsGov = wb.addWorksheet('مؤشرات المحافظات', { views: [{ rightToLeft: true }] });
    
    const labels = data.sections[0].summaryItems.map(si => si.label);
    const totalCols = labels.length + 1;
    
    wsGov.getRow(1).height = 24;
    wsGov.getRow(2).height = 24;

    const colEndChar = String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.min(totalCols - 1, 25));
    wsGov.mergeCells(`A1:${colEndChar}2`);
    const govTitle = wsGov.getCell('A1');
    govTitle.value = 'مصفوفة المؤشرات الإحصائية المعتمدة حسب المحافظات والقطاعات';
    govTitle.font = fontCairo15BoldWhite;
    govTitle.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_HEADER_BG } };
    govTitle.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;

    // Header Row (Row 4)
    const headerRow = wsGov.getRow(4);
    headerRow.height = 32;
    
    headerRow.getCell(1).value = 'المحافظة / القطاع';
    headerRow.getCell(1).font = fontCairo10BoldWhite;
    headerRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_CARD_TITLE_BG } };
    headerRow.getCell(1).alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
    headerRow.getCell(1).border = borderDark;

    labels.forEach((lbl, lIdx) => {
      const cell = headerRow.getCell(lIdx + 2);
      cell.value = lbl;
      cell.font = fontCairo10BoldWhite;
      cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_HEADER_BG } };
      cell.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
      cell.border = borderDark;
    });

    // Data Rows
    let gRowIdx = 5;
    data.sections.forEach((sec, sIdx) => {
      const row = wsGov.getRow(gRowIdx);
      row.height = 24;
      const isEven = sIdx % 2 === 0;
      const rowBg = isEven ? COLOR_ZEBRA_EVEN : COLOR_ZEBRA_ODD;

      const cGov = row.getCell(1);
      cGov.value = sec.name.includes('محافظة') || sec.name.includes('المدينة') ? sec.name : `محافظة ${sec.name}`;
      cGov.font = fontCairo10Bold;
      cGov.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_SUBHEADER_BG } };
      cGov.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
      cGov.border = borderDark;

      sec.summaryItems.forEach((si, siIdx) => {
        const cVal = row.getCell(siIdx + 2);
        cVal.value = si.value;
        cVal.font = fontCairo10Bold;
        cVal.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: rowBg } };
        cVal.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
        cVal.border = borderLight;
      });

      gRowIdx++;
    });

    // Auto Column Widths
    wsGov.getColumn(1).width = 28;
    for (let c = 2; c <= totalCols; c++) {
      wsGov.getColumn(c).width = 22;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================
  // SHEET 3: DETAILED RECORDS («البيانات التفصيلية»)
  // ==========================================
  if (data.rows && data.rows.length > 0 && data.columns && data.columns.length > 0) {
    const wsData = wb.addWorksheet('البيانات التفصيلية', { views: [{ rightToLeft: true }] });

    const totalCols = data.columns.length + 1;
    const colEndChar = String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.min(totalCols - 1, 25));

    wsData.getRow(1).height = 24;
    wsData.getRow(2).height = 24;
    wsData.mergeCells(`A1:${colEndChar}2`);
    const dataTitle = wsData.getCell('A1');
    dataTitle.value = 'سجلات البيانات المعاملات والطلبات التفصيلية';
    dataTitle.font = fontCairo15BoldWhite;
    dataTitle.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_HEADER_BG } };
    dataTitle.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;

    if (logoImageId !== undefined) {
      wsData.addImage(logoImageId, {
        tl: { col: Math.max(1, Math.floor(totalCols / 2) - 1), row: 0.1 },
        ext: { width: 110, height: 70 },
        editAs: 'oneCell'
      });
    }

    // Table Header Row (Row 4)
    const headerRow = wsData.getRow(4);
    headerRow.height = 30;

    headerRow.getCell(1).value = 'م';
    headerRow.getCell(1).font = fontCairo10BoldWhite;
    headerRow.getCell(1).fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_CARD_TITLE_BG } };
    headerRow.getCell(1).alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
    headerRow.getCell(1).border = borderDark;

    data.columns.forEach((col, cIdx) => {
      const cell = headerRow.getCell(cIdx + 2);
      cell.value = col.header;
      cell.font = fontCairo10BoldWhite;
      cell.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_HEADER_BG } };
      cell.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
      cell.border = borderDark;
    });

    // Data Rows
    let dRowIdx = 5;
    data.rows.forEach((row, rIdx) => {
      const rowObj = wsData.getRow(dRowIdx);
      rowObj.height = 22;
      const isEven = rIdx % 2 === 0;
      const rowBg = isEven ? COLOR_ZEBRA_EVEN : COLOR_ZEBRA_ODD;

      const cSeq = rowObj.getCell(1);
      cSeq.value = rIdx + 1;
      cSeq.font = fontCairo10Bold;
      cSeq.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: COLOR_SUBHEADER_BG } };
      cSeq.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
      cSeq.border = borderLight;

      data.columns.forEach((col, cIdx) => {
        const cVal = rowObj.getCell(cIdx + 2);
        const val = row[col.key] !== undefined && row[col.key] !== null ? String(row[col.key]) : '-';
        cVal.value = val;
        cVal.font = fontCairo10Regular;
        cVal.fill = { type: 'pattern', pattern: 'solid', fgColor: { argb: rowBg } };
        cVal.alignment = alignCenterMiddle;
        cVal.border = borderLight;
      });

      dRowIdx++;
    });

    // Auto Column Widths
    wsData.getColumn(1).width = 8;
    data.columns.forEach((col, cIdx) => {
      const maxLen = Math.max(
        col.header.length,
        ...data.rows.slice(0, 50).map(r => String(r[col.key] || '').length)
      );
      wsData.getColumn(cIdx + 2).width = Math.max(18, Math.min(maxLen + 4, 45));
    });
  }

  // Generate Excel Buffer & Blob
  const buffer = await wb.xlsx.writeBuffer();
  return new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
}

/**
 * 4. Export All Formats Bundled in a clean ZIP file
 */
export async function exportReportAllFormats(data: ReportExportData): Promise<Blob> {
  const zip = new JSZip();
  const baseName = `تقرير_وحدة_القبول_${data.meta.reportNumber.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_')}`;

  // 1. Generate PDF
  const pdfBlob = await exportReportToPdf(data);
  zip.file(`${baseName}.pdf`, pdfBlob);

  // 2. Generate Word
  const wordBlob = await exportReportToWord(data);
  zip.file(`${baseName}.docx`, wordBlob);

  // 3. Generate Excel
  const excelBlob = await exportReportToExcel(data);
  zip.file(`${baseName}.xlsx`, excelBlob);

  // Generate Zip Blob
  return await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' });
}

export function getSurveyGovernorateId(s: SurveyResponse): string {
  const fields = [
    s.sector || '',
    s.schoolName || '',
    s.firstSchoolName || '',
    s.district || '',
    s.notes || '',
    s.equalizationNotes || ''
  ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

  if (fields.includes('حناكية')) return 'hanakiyah';
  if (fields.includes('خيبر')) return 'khaybar';
  if (
    fields.includes('محافظة بدر') ||
    fields.includes('قطاع بدر') ||
    (s.sector && s.sector.includes('بدر')) ||
    (s.district && s.district.includes('بدر')) ||
    (s.schoolName && s.schoolName.includes('بدر'))
  ) {
    return 'badr';
  }
  if (fields.includes('وادي الفرع') || fields.includes('وادي فرع')) return 'wadi_fara';
  if (fields.includes('المهد') || fields.includes('مهد الذهب')) return 'mahd';
  if (fields.includes('ينبع')) return 'yanbu';
  if (fields.includes('العلا') || fields.includes('علا')) return 'ula';

  return 'madinah';
}

export function getPrincipalReportGovernorateId(r: PrincipalReport): string {
  const fields = [
    r.sector || '',
    r.schoolName || '',
    r.district || '',
    r.notes || '',
    r.referralNotes || ''
  ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

  if (fields.includes('حناكية')) return 'hanakiyah';
  if (fields.includes('خيبر')) return 'khaybar';
  if (
    fields.includes('محافظة بدر') ||
    fields.includes('قطاع بدر') ||
    (r.sector && r.sector.includes('بدر')) ||
    (r.district && r.district.includes('بدر')) ||
    (r.schoolName && r.schoolName.includes('بدر'))
  ) {
    return 'badr';
  }
  if (fields.includes('وادي الفرع') || fields.includes('وادي فرع')) return 'wadi_fara';
  if (fields.includes('المهد') || fields.includes('مهد الذهب')) return 'mahd';
  if (fields.includes('ينبع')) return 'yanbu';
  if (fields.includes('العلا')) return 'ula';

  return 'madinah';
}

export interface GovernorateCalculatedData {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  shortName: string;
  badgeColor: string;
  totalSurveys: number;
  resolvedSurveys: number;
  inProgressSurveys: number;
  resolutionRate: number;
  avgSatisfaction: number;
  principalReportsCount: number;
  secAdmission: number;
  interAdmission: number;
  primAdmission: number;
  earlyChildhoodAdmission: number;
  secEq: number;
  interEq: number;
  primEq: number;
  summaryItems: ReportSummaryItem[];
}

export function calculateAllGovernoratesStats(
  surveys: SurveyResponse[],
  principalReports: PrincipalReport[]
): GovernorateCalculatedData[] {
  const isSec = (s: SurveyResponse) => {
    const stg = (s.stage || s.equalizationStage || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return stg === 'secondary' || stg.includes('ثانو') || stg.includes('second');
  };
  const isInter = (s: SurveyResponse) => {
    const stg = (s.stage || s.equalizationStage || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return stg === 'intermediate' || stg.includes('متوسط') || stg.includes('intermed');
  };
  const isPrim = (s: SurveyResponse) => {
    const stg = (s.stage || s.equalizationStage || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return stg === 'primary' || stg === 'elementary' || stg.includes('ابتدائ') || stg.includes('primar') || stg.includes('element');
  };
  const isEarly = (s: SurveyResponse) => {
    const stg = (s.stage || s.equalizationStage || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return stg === 'kindergarten' || stg.includes('طفول') || stg.includes('رياض') || stg.includes('روض') || stg.includes('kinder');
  };

  return GOVERNORATE_DEFINITIONS.map(gov => {
    const govSurveys = surveys.filter(s => getSurveyGovernorateId(s) === gov.id);
    const govReports = principalReports.filter(r => getPrincipalReportGovernorateId(r) === gov.id);

    const totalSurveys = govSurveys.length;
    const resolvedSurveys = govSurveys.filter(s => s.isResolved).length;
    const inProgressSurveys = totalSurveys - resolvedSurveys;
    const resolutionRate = totalSurveys > 0 ? Math.round((resolvedSurveys / totalSurveys) * 100) : 100;

    const ratedSurveys = govSurveys.filter(s => typeof s.staffSatisfaction === 'number' && s.staffSatisfaction > 0);
    const avgSatisfaction = ratedSurveys.length > 0
      ? Number((ratedSurveys.reduce((acc, s) => acc + (s.staffSatisfaction || 0), 0) / ratedSurveys.length).toFixed(1))
      : 5.0;

    const admSurveys = govSurveys.filter(s => !isSurveyEqualizationRequest(s));
    const eqSurveys = govSurveys.filter(s => isSurveyEqualizationRequest(s));

    const secAdmission = admSurveys.filter(isSec).length;
    const interAdmission = admSurveys.filter(isInter).length;
    const primAdmission = admSurveys.filter(isPrim).length;
    const earlyChildhoodAdmission = admSurveys.filter(isEarly).length;

    const secEq = eqSurveys.filter(isSec).length;
    const interEq = eqSurveys.filter(isInter).length;
    const primEq = eqSurveys.filter(isPrim).length;

    const summaryItems: ReportSummaryItem[] = [
      { label: 'إجمالي المعاملات المسجلة', value: totalSurveys, icon: 'layers' },
      { label: 'المعاملات المنجزة والمغلقة', value: resolvedSurveys, icon: 'check-circle' },
      { label: 'المعاملات الجارية وقيد المعالجة', value: inProgressSurveys, icon: 'clock' },
      { label: 'نسبة إنجاز المعاملات', value: `${resolutionRate}%`, icon: 'percent' },
      { label: 'معدل رضا المستفيدين', value: `${avgSatisfaction} / 5`, icon: 'star' },
      { label: 'بلاغات المدارس الميدانية', value: govReports.length, icon: 'alert-triangle' },
      { label: 'معاملات المرحلة الثانوية', value: secAdmission, icon: 'graduation-cap' },
      { label: 'معاملات المرحلة المتوسطة', value: interAdmission, icon: 'school' },
      { label: 'معاملات المرحلة الابتدائية', value: primAdmission, icon: 'book-open' },
      { label: 'معاملات مرحلة الطفولة المبكرة', value: earlyChildhoodAdmission, icon: 'baby' },
      { label: 'معاملات معادلات المرحلة الثانوية', value: secEq, icon: 'award' },
      { label: 'معاملات معادلات المرحلة المتوسطة', value: interEq, icon: 'file-text' },
      { label: 'معاملات معادلات المرحلة الابتدائية', value: primEq, icon: 'file-badge' }
    ];

    return {
      id: gov.id,
      name: gov.name,
      shortName: gov.shortName,
      badgeColor: gov.badgeColor,
      totalSurveys,
      resolvedSurveys,
      inProgressSurveys,
      resolutionRate,
      avgSatisfaction,
      principalReportsCount: govReports.length,
      secAdmission,
      interAdmission,
      primAdmission,
      earlyChildhoodAdmission,
      secEq,
      interEq,
      primEq,
      summaryItems
    };
  });
}

export function buildGovernorateReportSections(
  surveys: SurveyResponse[],
  principalReports: PrincipalReport[]
): ReportGovernorateSection[] {
  const calculated = calculateAllGovernoratesStats(surveys, principalReports);
  return calculated.map(c => ({
    id: c.id,
    name: c.name,
    summaryItems: c.summaryItems
  }));
}
