/**
 * Hijri Date & Time Formatter Utilities
 * Formats dates into Hijri calendar (Umm al-Qura) with day, date, and time in Arabic.
 */

export interface HijriDateTimeResult {
  hijriStr: string;
  timeStr: string;
  fullStr: string;
  dayName: string;
  isAvailable: boolean;
}

export function formatHijriFullDateTime(dateInput?: string | Date | null): HijriDateTimeResult {
  if (!dateInput) {
    return {
      hijriStr: 'غير محدد',
      timeStr: '',
      fullStr: 'لم يتم الإرسال بعد ⏳',
      dayName: '',
      isAvailable: false
    };
  }

  try {
    const d = typeof dateInput === 'string' ? new Date(dateInput) : dateInput;
    if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) {
      return {
        hijriStr: 'غير محدد',
        timeStr: '',
        fullStr: 'لم يتم الإرسال بعد ⏳',
        dayName: '',
        isAvailable: false
      };
    }

    const dayFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { weekday: 'long' });
    const dayName = dayFormatter.format(d);

    const hijriFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA-u-ca-islamic-umalqura', {
      weekday: 'long',
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric'
    });

    const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', {
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      hour12: true
    });

    const hijriStr = hijriFormatter.format(d);
    const timeStr = timeFormatter.format(d);
    const fullStr = `${hijriStr} - الساعة ${timeStr}`;

    return {
      hijriStr,
      timeStr,
      fullStr,
      dayName,
      isAvailable: true
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      hijriStr: 'غير محدد',
      timeStr: '',
      fullStr: 'لم يتم الإرسال بعد ⏳',
      dayName: '',
      isAvailable: false
    };
  }
}

import { TRANSLATIONS } from '../data/mockData';
import { Language } from '../types';

/**
 * Safely retrieves a translation string with fallback support.
 * Prevents crashes if a key is missing or TRANSLATIONS object is corrupted.
 */
export function getSafeTranslation(lang: Language, key: string, fallback?: string): string {
  try {
    const translations = TRANSLATIONS[lang] || TRANSLATIONS['ar'];
    const value = (translations as any)[key];
    
    if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
      return String(value);
    }
    
    if (fallback) return fallback;
    
    // Attempt to get from Arabic as ultimate fallback
    const arFallback = (TRANSLATIONS['ar'] as any)[key];
    if (arFallback !== undefined) return String(arFallback);
    
    return `[${key}]`;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Translation error for key:', key, err);
    return fallback || `[${key}]`;
  }
}

/**
 * High-Performance Async Batch Processor & Web Worker Manager
 * Engineered to process 20,000+ items without UI freeze (60 FPS maintained)
 */

import { SurveyResponse, EmailLog } from '../types';

export interface BatchProcessingOptions {
  newItems: SurveyResponse[];
  existingSurveys: SurveyResponse[];
  adminEmails: string;
  isOnline: boolean;
  onProgress?: (percent: number, processedCount: number, totalCount: number) => void;
}

export interface BatchProcessingResult {
  deduplicatedItems: SurveyResponse[];
  negativeEmailLogs: EmailLog[];
  duplicatesCount: number;
  totalProcessed: number;
}

/**
 * Process a massive array of surveys using Web Worker or Chunked Micro-Tasks
 */
export async function processSurveysInBatchAsync(
  options: BatchProcessingOptions
): Promise<BatchProcessingResult> {
  const { newItems, existingSurveys, adminEmails, isOnline, onProgress } = options;

  if (!newItems || newItems.length === 0) {
    return {
      deduplicatedItems: [],
      negativeEmailLogs: [],
      duplicatesCount: 0,
      totalProcessed: 0,
    };
  }

  // Attempt Web Worker Execution
  try {
    return await executeInWebWorker(options);
  } catch (workerErr) {
    console.warn('Web Worker execution unavailable or restricted, switching to Chunked Async Micro-Tasks:', workerErr);
    return await executeInAsyncChunks(options);
  }
}

/**
 * Web Worker Executor
 */
function executeInWebWorker(options: BatchProcessingOptions): Promise<BatchProcessingResult> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const { newItems, existingSurveys, adminEmails, isOnline, onProgress } = options;
    const existingIds = existingSurveys.map(s => s.id);

    // Create Inline Worker Blob to avoid cross-origin / URL bundle issues
    const workerCode = `
      self.onmessage = function(e) {
        var data = e.data;
        var newItems = data.newItems || [];
        var existingIds = new Set(data.existingIds || []);
        var adminEmailsList = (data.adminEmails || '').split(',').map(function(s){return s.trim();}).filter(Boolean);
        var isOnline = data.isOnline;
        var nowStr = new Date().toISOString();

        var deduplicatedItems = [];
        var negativeEmailLogs = [];
        var duplicatesCount = 0;
        var totalCount = newItems.length;
        var chunkSize = 1500;

        for (var i = 0; i < totalCount; i++) {
          var item = newItems[i];
          if (item && item.id && existingIds.has(item.id)) {
            duplicatesCount++;
          } else {
            if (item && item.id) {
              existingIds.add(item.id);
            }
            deduplicatedItems.push(item);

            var staffSat = Number(item.staffSatisfaction) || 0;
            var receptionSat = Number(item.receptionSatisfaction) || 0;
            if ((staffSat > 0 && staffSat < 3) || (receptionSat > 0 && receptionSat < 3)) {
              for (var k = 0; k < adminEmailsList.length; k++) {
                negativeEmailLogs.push({
                  id: 'EML-WORKER-' + Date.now() + '-' + i + '-' + k,
                  surveyId: item.id,
                  beneficiaryName: item.beneficiaryName || 'مستفيد',
                  recipientEmail: adminEmailsList[k],
                  subject: '⚠️ تنبيه فوري: تقييم سلبي من مستفيد (' + (item.beneficiaryName || 'مستفيد') + ')',
                  sentAt: nowStr,
                  status: isOnline ? 'sent' : 'pending',
                  triggerReason: 'Batch Worker Alert'
                });
              }
            }
          }

          if ((i + 1) % chunkSize === 0 || (i + 1) === totalCount) {
            self.postMessage({
              type: 'PROGRESS',
              processedCount: i + 1,
              totalCount: totalCount,
              percent: Math.min(100, Math.round(((i + 1) / totalCount) * 100))
            });
          }
        }

        self.postMessage({
          type: 'COMPLETE',
          deduplicatedItems: deduplicatedItems,
          negativeEmailLogs: negativeEmailLogs,
          duplicatesCount: duplicatesCount,
          totalProcessed: totalCount
        });
      };
    `;

    const blob = new Blob([workerCode], { type: 'application/javascript' });
    const workerUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const worker = new Worker(workerUrl);

    worker.onmessage = (e) => {
      const msg = e.data;
      if (msg.type === 'PROGRESS') {
        if (onProgress) {
          onProgress(msg.percent, msg.processedCount, msg.totalCount);
        }
      } else if (msg.type === 'COMPLETE') {
        worker.terminate();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(workerUrl);
        resolve({
          deduplicatedItems: msg.deduplicatedItems,
          negativeEmailLogs: msg.negativeEmailLogs,
          duplicatesCount: msg.duplicatesCount,
          totalProcessed: msg.totalProcessed,
        });
      }
    };

    worker.onerror = (err) => {
      worker.terminate();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(workerUrl);
      reject(err);
    };

    worker.postMessage({
      newItems,
      existingIds,
      adminEmails,
      isOnline,
    });
  });
}

/**
 * Fallback: Asynchronous Micro-Chunking Batch Processor (uses setTimeout / requestAnimationFrame)
 * Yields event loop control back to browser every 1,500 items so UI thread never freezes.
 */
function executeInAsyncChunks(options: BatchProcessingOptions): Promise<BatchProcessingResult> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const { newItems, existingSurveys, adminEmails, isOnline, onProgress } = options;
    const existingIdSet = new Set(existingSurveys.map(s => s.id));
    const deduplicatedItems: SurveyResponse[] = [];
    const negativeEmailLogs: EmailLog[] = [];
    let duplicatesCount = 0;
    const totalCount = newItems.length;
    const adminEmailsList = adminEmails.split(',').map(e => e.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const nowStr = new Date().toISOString();

    const chunkSize = 1500;
    let currentIndex = 0;

    function processChunk() {
      const end = Math.min(currentIndex + chunkSize, totalCount);

      for (let i = currentIndex; i < end; i++) {
        const item = newItems[i];
        if (item && item.id && existingIdSet.has(item.id)) {
          duplicatesCount++;
        } else {
          if (item && item.id) {
            existingIdSet.add(item.id);
          }
          deduplicatedItems.push(item);

          const staffSat = Number(item.staffSatisfaction) || 0;
          const receptionSat = Number(item.receptionSatisfaction) || 0;
          if ((staffSat > 0 && staffSat < 3) || (receptionSat > 0 && receptionSat < 3)) {
            adminEmailsList.forEach((email, emailIdx) => {
              negativeEmailLogs.push({
                id: `EML-CHUNK-${Date.now()}-${i}-${emailIdx}`,
                surveyId: item.id,
                beneficiaryName: item.beneficiaryName || 'مستفيد',
                recipientEmail: email,
                subject: `⚠️ تنبيه فوري: تقييم سلبي من مستفيد (${item.beneficiaryName || 'مستفيد'})`,
                sentAt: nowStr,
                status: isOnline ? 'sent' : 'pending',
                triggerReason: `Batch Chunk Alert`
              });
            });
          }
        }
      }

      currentIndex = end;
      const percent = Math.min(100, Math.round((currentIndex / totalCount) * 100));

      if (onProgress) {
        onProgress(percent, currentIndex, totalCount);
      }

      if (currentIndex < totalCount) {
        // Yield control to UI thread
        setTimeout(processChunk, 0);
      } else {
        resolve({
          deduplicatedItems,
          negativeEmailLogs,
          duplicatesCount,
          totalProcessed: totalCount,
        });
      }
    }

    processChunk();
  });
}

import { SurveyResponse } from '../types';

export interface DelayStatusResult {
  isDelayed: boolean; // Delayed past 2 business days
  delayWorkingDays: number;
  elapsedHours: number;
  elapsedDays: number;
  lastActionDateStr: string;
  delayMessage: string;
}

/**
 * Calculates whether a request is delayed by more than 2 business days (>= 2 working days or >= 48 hours)
 * since its last dispatch / referral without being finalized.
 */
export function checkRequestDelayStatus(survey: SurveyResponse): DelayStatusResult {
  // If request is already resolved or staffing confirmed, it is not delayed
  if (survey.isResolved || survey.staffingConfirmedAt || survey.principalConfirmedStaffing) {
    return {
      isDelayed: false,
      delayWorkingDays: 0,
      elapsedHours: 0,
      elapsedDays: 0,
      lastActionDateStr: '',
      delayMessage: ''
    };
  }

  // Find the date of the last relevant dispatch or referral
  const refDateStr = 
    survey.sentToLeadershipAt ||
    survey.sentToPrincipalAt ||
    survey.returnedAt ||
    survey.principalReturnedAt ||
    survey.planningReResolvedAt ||
    survey.vacancyApprovedAt ||
    survey.eqReferredToPlanningAt ||
    survey.referredToPlanningAt ||
    survey.createdAt ||
    survey.submittedAt;

  if (!refDateStr) {
    return {
      isDelayed: false,
      delayWorkingDays: 0,
      elapsedHours: 0,
      elapsedDays: 0,
      lastActionDateStr: '',
      delayMessage: ''
    };
  }

  const startDate = new Date(refDateStr);
  const now = new Date();

  if (isNaN(startDate.getTime())) {
    return {
      isDelayed: false,
      delayWorkingDays: 0,
      elapsedHours: 0,
      elapsedDays: 0,
      lastActionDateStr: '',
      delayMessage: ''
    };
  }

  const diffMs = Math.max(0, now.getTime() - startDate.getTime());
  const elapsedHours = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60));
  const elapsedDays = Math.floor(elapsedHours / 24);

  // Calculate working days (excluding Friday & Saturday in Saudi Arabia)
  let delayWorkingDays = 0;
  const cur = new Date(startDate);
  while (cur < now) {
    cur.setDate(cur.getDate() + 1);
    const day = cur.getDay(); // 0 = Sun, 1 = Mon, ..., 5 = Fri, 6 = Sat
    if (day !== 5 && day !== 6) { // Not Friday, Not Saturday
      delayWorkingDays++;
    }
  }

  // Delayed if elapsed working days >= 2 or elapsed total hours >= 48
  const isDelayed = delayWorkingDays >= 2 || elapsedHours >= 48;

  const delayMessage = isDelayed
    ? `🚨 رسالة طارئة وعاجلة: تأخر الطلب أكثر من يومين عمل عن التسكين (${delayWorkingDays > 0 ? `${delayWorkingDays} أيام عمل / ` : ''}${elapsedHours} ساعة)! يلزم الإجراء الفوري والاتصال بمدير المدرسة.`
    : '';

  return {
    isDelayed,
    delayWorkingDays,
    elapsedHours,
    elapsedDays,
    lastActionDateStr: refDateStr,
    delayMessage
  };
}

/**
 * Returns all active requests that are delayed over 2 business days
 */
export function getDelayedRequests(surveys: SurveyResponse[]): SurveyResponse[] {
  if (!surveys) return [];
  return surveys.filter((s) => checkRequestDelayStatus(s).isDelayed);
}

/**
 * Web Worker for High-Performance Async Data Processing (20,000+ records)
 * Prevents Main-Thread UI Freezing during bulk operations, deduplication, and alert scanning.
 */

export interface WorkerInputMessage {
  type: 'PROCESS_BATCH';
  newItems: any[];
  existingIds: string[];
  adminEmails: string;
  isOnline: boolean;
}

export interface WorkerProgressMessage {
  type: 'PROGRESS';
  processedCount: number;
  totalCount: number;
  percent: number;
}

export interface WorkerCompleteMessage {
  type: 'COMPLETE';
  deduplicatedItems: any[];
  negativeEmailLogs: any[];
  duplicatesCount: number;
  totalProcessed: number;
}

self.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<WorkerInputMessage>) => {
  const { type, newItems, existingIds, adminEmails, isOnline } = event.data;

  if (type === 'PROCESS_BATCH') {
    const existingIdSet = new Set(existingIds || []);
    const deduplicatedItems: any[] = [];
    const negativeEmailLogs: any[] = [];
    let duplicatesCount = 0;
    const totalCount = newItems.length;
    const adminEmailsList = (adminEmails || '').split(',').map(e => e.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const nowStr = new Date().toISOString();

    const chunkSize = 2500; // Process in chunks of 2,500 items to send progress ticks
    let processedCount = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < totalCount; i++) {
      const item = newItems[i];
      if (item && item.id && existingIdSet.has(item.id)) {
        duplicatesCount++;
      } else {
        if (item && item.id) {
          existingIdSet.add(item.id);
        }
        deduplicatedItems.push(item);

        // Check for negative feedback alert
        const staffSat = Number(item.staffSatisfaction) || 0;
        const receptionSat = Number(item.receptionSatisfaction) || 0;
        if ((staffSat > 0 && staffSat < 3) || (receptionSat > 0 && receptionSat < 3)) {
          adminEmailsList.forEach((email, emailIdx) => {
            negativeEmailLogs.push({
              id: `EML-WORKER-${Date.now()}-${i}-${emailIdx}`,
              surveyId: item.id,
              beneficiaryName: item.beneficiaryName || 'مستفيد',
              recipientEmail: email,
              subject: `⚠️ تنبيه فوري: تقييم سلبي من مستفيد (${item.beneficiaryName || 'مستفيد'})`,
              sentAt: nowStr,
              status: isOnline ? 'sent' : 'pending',
              triggerReason: `Batch Worker Alert (Staff: ${staffSat} / Reception: ${receptionSat})`
            });
          });
        }
      }

      processedCount++;

      // Send progress report every chunk or at completion
      if (processedCount % chunkSize === 0 || processedCount === totalCount) {
        const percent = Math.min(100, Math.round((processedCount / totalCount) * 100));
        self.postMessage({
          type: 'PROGRESS',
          processedCount,
          totalCount,
          percent
        } as WorkerProgressMessage);
      }
    }

    self.postMessage({
      type: 'COMPLETE',
      deduplicatedItems,
      negativeEmailLogs,
      duplicatesCount,
      totalProcessed: totalCount
    } as WorkerCompleteMessage);
  }
};

              </button>
            )}

            {/* Principal Session Logout Button */}
            {onPrincipalLogout && principalSession && userRole === 'portal' && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (confirm(isRtl ? `هل تريد بالتأكيد تسجيل الخروج من حساب ${principalSession.schoolName}؟` : 'Are you sure you want to log out from school account?')) {

                  }
                }}
                title={isRtl ? `تسجيل خروج (${principalSession.schoolName})` : 'Logout School Account'}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-black rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer bg-rose-500/20 hover:bg-rose-500/40 border border-rose-400/40 text-rose-200 hover:text-white shadow-xs"
                id="header-principal-logout"
              >
                <LogOut className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">{isRtl ? 'خروج المدرسة' : 'School Logout'}</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

      if (!principalMobile.trim()) {

      }

        return;
      }
      if (!confirmPassword.trim()) {
        setLoginError(isRtl ? 'الرجاء تكرار إدخال الرقم السري للتأكيد.' : 'Please repeat password for confirmation.');

      const hasDigits = /[0-9]/.test(password);
      if (!hasLetters || !hasDigits) {

        return;
      }

      // Persist registered principal account(s) to localStorage
      try {
        const existingRegsRaw = localStorage.getItem('registered_principals_v1');
        const existingRegs = existingRegsRaw ? JSON.parse(existingRegsRaw) : [];
        
        // Use retrievedSchools if available, otherwise just the current one
        const schoolsToRegister = retrievedSchools.length > 0 ? retrievedSchools : [selectedSchoolData || { nameAr: schoolName, ministryCode: schoolCode }];
        
        const newRegistrations = schoolsToRegister.map(s => ({
          schoolCode: (s.ministryCode || s.code || schoolCode).toString().trim(),
          schoolName: (s.nameAr || schoolName).trim(),
          principalName: principalName.trim(),
          mobile: principalMobile.trim(),
          password: password.trim(),
          registeredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          civilId: enteredCivilId // Link all to the same Civil ID
        }));

        // Filter out any old registrations for these schools
        const schoolNamesToReplace = new Set(newRegistrations.map(r => r.schoolName.toLowerCase()));
        const filteredRegs = existingRegs.filter((r: any) => !schoolNamesToReplace.has(r.schoolName.toLowerCase()));
        
        // Add all new registrations
        filteredRegs.push(...newRegistrations);
        localStorage.setItem('registered_principals_v1', JSON.stringify(filteredRegs));
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to persist principal account', err);
      }

      // Set session & persist across inactivity & browser integration
      const newRegisteredSession = {
        schoolCode: schoolCode.trim(),
        schoolName: schoolName.trim(),
        principalName: principalName.trim(),
        mobile: principalMobile.trim()
      };
      setPrincipalSession(newRegisteredSession);
      persistPrincipalSession(newRegisteredSession);

        storeBrowserCredential({
          username: schoolName.trim(),
          password: password.trim(),
          displayName: principalName.trim(),
          role: 'principal'
        });

    } else {

      // Check if registered locally
      let foundReg: any = null;
      try {

        foundReg = existingRegs.find((r: any) => r.schoolName.trim().toLowerCase() === schoolName.trim().toLowerCase());

        // ignore
      }

      if (foundReg) {

          setLoginError(isRtl ? 'عفواً، الرقم السري المدخل غير صحيح!' : 'Incorrect password!');
          return;
        }
      }

      let finalSchoolName = schoolName.trim();
      let finalSchoolCode = foundReg?.schoolCode || schoolCode.trim() || '';
      let finalPrincipalName = foundReg?.principalName || principalName.trim() || '';
      let finalMobile = foundReg?.mobile || principalMobile.trim() || '';

      const matchedReport = principalReports?.find(
        r => r.schoolName.trim().toLowerCase() === schoolName.trim().toLowerCase()
      );

      // Look up in schools list
      const normInput = normalizeArabicText(schoolName);
      const matchedSchoolObj = selectedSchoolData || schools.find(sch => {
        const schCode = String(sch.ministryCode || sch.code || sch.id || '').trim();
        const schNameAr = normalizeArabicText(sch.nameAr);
        return schNameAr === normInput || (schCode && schCode === schoolName.trim());
      });

      if (matchedSchoolObj) {
        finalSchoolName = matchedSchoolObj.nameAr || finalSchoolName;
        const info = extractPrincipalInfoFromSchool(matchedSchoolObj);
        if (info.schoolName) finalSchoolName = info.schoolName;
        if (info.name && (!finalPrincipalName || finalPrincipalName === 'أ. مدير المدرسة' || finalPrincipalName === 'مدير المدرسة')) {
          finalPrincipalName = info.name;
        }
        if (info.code && !finalSchoolCode) {
          finalSchoolCode = info.code;
        }
        if (info.mobile && (!finalMobile || finalMobile === '0554445555' || finalMobile === '0550000000')) {
          finalMobile = info.mobile;
        }
      } else if (matchedReport) {
        finalSchoolCode = matchedReport.schoolCode;
        finalPrincipalName = matchedReport.principalName;
        finalMobile = matchedReport.mobile;
      } else {
        // Find in surveys
        const matchedSurvey = surveys.find(
          s => normalizeArabicText(s.schoolName) === normInput
        );
        if (matchedSurvey && matchedSurvey.schoolCode) {
          finalSchoolCode = matchedSurvey.schoolCode;
          finalPrincipalName = finalPrincipalName || 'أ. مدير المدرسة';
          finalMobile = finalMobile || '0550000000';
        } else {
          // Fallback
          finalSchoolCode = finalSchoolCode || '45013';
          finalPrincipalName = finalPrincipalName || 'أ. مدير المدرسة';
          finalMobile = finalMobile || '0554445555';
        }
      }

      const newLoginSession = {
        schoolCode: finalSchoolCode,
        schoolName: finalSchoolName,
        principalName: finalPrincipalName,
        mobile: finalMobile
      };
      setPrincipalSession(newLoginSession);
      persistPrincipalSession(newLoginSession);
      if (rememberMePrincipal) {
        storeBrowserCredential({
          username: finalSchoolName,
          password: password.trim(),
          displayName: finalPrincipalName || finalSchoolName,
          role: 'principal'
        });
      }
    }

    setView('principal-dashboard');
  };

  // Filtered surveys for logged in principal's school
  const schoolSurveys = useMemo(() => {
    if (!principalSession || !surveys) return [];
    return surveys.filter(s => isMatchingPrincipalSchool(s, principalSession, schools));
  }, [surveys, principalSession, schools]);

  // School Stats calculations
  const schoolStats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = schoolSurveys.length;
    if (total === 0) return { total: 0, avgSatisfaction: 0, resolvedPct: 0, pending: 0, resolved: 0 };

    let totalSatisfaction = 0;
    let resolvedCount = 0;

    schoolSurveys.forEach(s => {
      totalSatisfaction += (s.staffSatisfaction + s.receptionSatisfaction) / 2;
      if (s.isResolved) resolvedCount++;
    });

    return {
      total,
      avgSatisfaction: Number((totalSatisfaction / total).toFixed(1)),
      resolvedPct: Math.round((resolvedCount / total) * 100),
      pending: total - resolvedCount,
      resolved: resolvedCount
    };
  }, [schoolSurveys]);

  // Filtered list by active tab
  const displayedSchoolSurveys = useMemo(() => {
    return schoolSurveys.filter(s => {
      if (principalTab === 'pending') return !s.isResolved;
      if (principalTab === 'resolved') return s.isResolved;
      return true;
    });
  }, [schoolSurveys, principalTab]);

  // Principal's own school reports
  const myReports = useMemo(() => {
    if (!principalSession || !principalReports) return [];
    return principalReports.filter(r => {
      if (r.schoolCode && principalSession.schoolCode && r.schoolCode === principalSession.schoolCode) return true;
      if (r.schoolName && principalSession.schoolName && normalizeArabicText(r.schoolName) === normalizeArabicText(principalSession.schoolName)) return true;
      return false;
    });
  }, [principalReports, principalSession]);

  // Incoming placement requests sent to this principal's school
  const placementRequests = useMemo(() => {
    if (!principalSession || !surveys) return [];

    return surveys.filter((s) => {
      if (!s) return false;
      const matchesSchool = isMatchingPrincipalSchool(s, principalSession, schools);
      if (!matchesSchool) return false;

      // Any request that is either sent/referred to the school or has a placement / registration / transfer / eq nature:
      const isSentOrPlacement = 
        (s as any).sentToSchoolPrincipal || 
        s.vacancyRequestStatus === 'sent_to_school_principal' || 
        (s as any).sentToLeadership || 
        s.vacancyRequestStatus === 'sent_to_leadership' || 
        (s as any).isVacancyRequest || 
        s.vacancyRequestStatus === 'approved' || 
        s.vacancyRequestStatus === 'pending_vacancy' ||
        s.vacancyRequestStatus === 'pending' ||
        s.vacancyRequestStatus === 'staffing_confirmed' || 
        s.vacancyRequestStatus === 'executed' ||
        (s as any).principalConfirmedStaffing ||
        (s as any).isEqualizationRequest ||
        (s as any).isNonFreshStudent ||
        s.serviceType === 'registration' ||
        s.serviceType === 'transfer' ||
        s.serviceType === 'new' ||
        s.problemType === 'vacancies_unavailable' ||
        (s.problemType as string) === 'vacancies_closed' ||
        s.problemType === 'unregistered_desire' ||
        s.problemType === 'unjustified_rejection' ||
        s.problemType === 'new_registration_saudi' ||
        s.problemType === 'new_registration_resident' ||
        s.problemType === 'student_density' ||
        s.problemType === 'distance_from_school' ||
        s.problemType?.startsWith('cert_');

      return isSentOrPlacement;
    });
  }, [surveys, principalSession, schools]);

  // Equivalency Placement Requests (طلبات التسكين وفق المعادلات)
  const equivalencyPlacementRequests = useMemo(() => {
    return placementRequests.filter((s) => isSurveyEqualizationRequest(s));
  }, [placementRequests]);

  // Admissions Placement Requests (طلبات التسكين المرسلة من وحدة القبول - excludes Equivalency Requests)
  const admissionsPlacementRequests = useMemo(() => {
    return placementRequests.filter((s) => !isSurveyEqualizationRequest(s));
  }, [placementRequests]);

  // Active Placement Source List based on active subtab
  const activePlacementSourceList = useMemo(() => {
    if (dashboardSubTab === 'eq-placement-requests') {
      return equivalencyPlacementRequests;
    }
    return admissionsPlacementRequests;
  }, [dashboardSubTab, equivalencyPlacementRequests, admissionsPlacementRequests]);

  // Filtered placement requests according to active placement sub-filter
  const displayedPlacementRequests = useMemo(() => {
    return activePlacementSourceList.filter(s => {
      const isConfirmed = s.principalConfirmedStaffing || s.vacancyRequestStatus === 'staffing_confirmed' || s.vacancyRequestStatus === 'executed';
      const isReturned = (s as any).returnedByPrincipal || s.vacancyRequestStatus === 'returned_no_vacancy';
      if (placementFilter === 'pending') return !isConfirmed && !isReturned;
      if (placementFilter === 'confirmed') return isConfirmed;
      return true;
    });
  }, [activePlacementSourceList, placementFilter]);

  const getProblemName = (key: string, surveyObj?: SurveyResponse) => {
    if (surveyObj) {
      const info = getRequestTypeInfo(surveyObj, isRtl);
      return `${info.label} (${info.subLabel})`;
    }
    switch (key) {
      case 'new_registration_saudi': return isRtl ? 'تسجيل مستجد (سعودي)' : 'New Registration (Saudi)';
      case 'new_registration_resident': return isRtl ? 'تسجيل مستجد (مقيم)' : 'New Registration (Resident)';
      case 'vacancies_unavailable': return isRtl ? 'طلب نقل طالب (طلب شاغر)' : 'Student Transfer (Vacancy)';
      case 'student_density': return isRtl ? 'طلب نقل طالب (كثافة بالفصول)' : 'Student Transfer (Density)';
      case 'unjustified_rejection': return isRtl ? 'معاملة قبول (رفض دون مبرر)' : 'Admission Case (Rejection)';
      case 'cert_primary_eq': return isRtl ? 'طلب معادلة مؤهلات (المرحلة الابتدائية)' : 'Equivalency (Primary)';
      case 'cert_intermediate_eq': return isRtl ? 'طلب معادلة مؤهلات (المرحلة المتوسطة)' : 'Equivalency (Intermediate)';
      case 'cert_secondary_eq': return isRtl ? 'طلب معادلة مؤهلات (المرحلة الثانوية)' : 'Equivalency (Secondary)';
      case 'distance_from_school': return isRtl ? 'طلب نقل طالب (بعد السكن)' : 'Student Transfer (Distance)';
      case 'unregistered_desire': return isRtl ? 'تسجيل مستجد (قبول بالرغبة)' : 'New Registration (Desired)';
      case 'vacancies_closed': return isRtl ? 'طلب نقل طالب (شواغر مغلقة)' : 'Student Transfer (Closed)';
      case 'class_density': return isRtl ? 'طلب نقل طالب (كثافة فصول)' : 'Student Transfer (Density)';
      default: return isRtl ? 'معاملة قبول / أخرى' : 'Admission Case / Other';
    }
  };

  // Handler for Principal clicking "اعتماد التسكين الميداني ✅" (Approve Staffing)
  const handleConfirmPlacement = (survey: SurveyResponse) => {
    const customNote = principalNotesMap[survey.id]?.trim() || (isRtl ? 'تم تسكين الطالب/ة بالمدرسة بنجاح وتأكيد الاعتماد النهائي من مدير/ة المدرسة.' : 'Student placed successfully by school principal.');
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const updatedSurvey: SurveyResponse = {
      ...survey,
      isResolved: true, // Mark resolved and closed upon principal staffing confirmation
      vacancyRequestStatus: 'staffing_confirmed',
      principalConfirmedStaffing: true,
      sentToSchoolPrincipal: true,
      staffingConfirmedAt: now,
      finalStaffingConfirmedAt: now,
      archivedAt: now,
      staffingConfirmedBy: principalSession?.principalName || 'مدير المدرسة',
      staffingConfirmedSchoolName: principalSession?.schoolName || survey.schoolName,
      staffingConfirmedStage: survey.stage,
      staffingConfirmedGrade: survey.grade,
      staffingNote: customNote,
      unresolvedReason: customNote,
      transferAttachmentData: undefined,
      transferAttachmentName: undefined,
      attachmentsPurgedByPrincipal: true,
    };

    if (onUpdateSurvey) {
      onUpdateSurvey(updatedSurvey);
    }
  };

  // Handler for Principal opening return request modal
  const handleReturnPlacement = (survey: SurveyResponse) => {
    setReturnModalSurvey(survey);
    setReturnReasonText('سعة الطاقة الاستيعابية مغلقة من التخطيط المدرسي');
    setReturnReasonError('');
  };

  const handleConfirmReturnPlacement = () => {
    if (!returnModalSurvey) return;
    if (!returnReasonText.trim()) {
      setReturnReasonError(isRtl ? 'الرجاء تدوين سبب تعذر التسكين بوضوح.' : 'Please state return reason clearly.');
      return;
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const reasonClean = returnReasonText.trim();

    const returnCount = ((returnModalSurvey as any).principalReturnCount || 0) + 1;
    const isSecondReturn = returnCount >= 2;
    const updatedSurvey: SurveyResponse = {
      ...returnModalSurvey,
      isResolved: false,
      vacancyRequestStatus: 'returned_no_vacancy',
      returnedByPrincipal: true,
      sentToPlanningOfficer: true, // Automatically appears in Planning Officer account to open vacancy
      sentToLeadership: true, // Automatically appears in School Leadership account to follow up
      principalReturnCount: returnCount,
      isSecondReturnByPrincipal: isSecondReturn,
      principalReturnReason: reasonClean,
      returnedAt: now,
      principalReturnedAt: now,
      notes: isRtl
        ? `🚨 أعيد الطلب من مدير المدرسة (${principalSession?.principalName || 'مدير المدرسة'}) بسبب تعذر التسكين وعدم توفر شاغر بالصف/المرحلة. السبب: (${reasonClean}). ظهرت المعاملة أوتوماتيكياً في حساب مسؤول التخطيط لفتح شاغر وفي حساب القيادة المدرسية لمتابعة التسكين.`
        : `Request returned by principal due to no vacancy: ${reasonClean}. Routed to Planning Officer and School Leadership automatically.`
    };

    if (onUpdateSurvey) {
      onUpdateSurvey(updatedSurvey);
    }

    setReturnModalSurvey(null);

    alert(isRtl
      ? `🚨 تم إعادة الطلب لعدم توفر شاغر بنجاح!\n\n• سبب الإعادة: (${reasonClean})\n• ظهرت المعاملة أوتوماتيكياً في حساب مسؤول التخطيط لفتح شاغر بالمرحلة والصف المطلوبين.\n• ظهرت المعاملة أوتوماتيكياً في حساب القيادة المدرسية لمتابعة التسكين.`
      : `Request returned to Planning Officer and School Leadership due to no vacancy.`);
  };

  // Handle principal report submit handler
  const handleReportSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFormErrorMsg('');
    setFormSuccessMsg('');

    if (!repMobile.trim()) {
      setFormErrorMsg(isRtl ? 'الرجاء إدخال رقم الجوال.' : 'Please enter mobile number.');
      return;
    }

    if (repProblemType === 'vacancies_closed') {
      if (!repClosedVacanciesOption) {
        setFormErrorMsg(isRtl ? 'الرجاء تحديد خيار الشواغر المغلقة (فصول معينة أو جميع الفصول).' : 'Please select closed vacancies option.');
        return;
      }
      if (repClosedVacanciesOption === 'specific' && !repSpecificClosedClassesText.trim()) {
        setFormErrorMsg(isRtl ? 'الرجاء كتابة الفصول المغلقة.' : 'Please enter specific closed classes.');
        return;
      }
    }

    if (repProblemType === 'class_density') {
      if (!repProposedSolution) {
        setFormErrorMsg(isRtl ? 'الرجاء اختيار الحل المقترح من الخيارات المتاحة.' : 'Please select proposed solution.');
        return;
      }
      if (repProposedSolution === 'open_class') {
        if (!repOpenClassSubOption) {
          setFormErrorMsg(isRtl ? 'الرجاء تحديد خيار توفير المعلمين.' : 'Please select teacher provisioning option.');
          return;
        }
        if (repOpenClassSubOption === 'needs_teachers' && !repRequiredSpecialtiesText.trim()) {
          setFormErrorMsg(isRtl ? 'الرجاء كتابة التخصصات المطلوبة لفتح الفصل.' : 'Please enter required specialties.');
          return;
        }
      }
      if (repProposedSolution === 'modify_budget' && !repBudgetProposalText.trim()) {
        setFormErrorMsg(isRtl ? 'الرجاء كتابة مقترح تعديل ميزانية الفصول.' : 'Please write your class budget proposal.');
        return;
      }
    }

    if (onAddPrincipalReport && principalSession) {
      onAddPrincipalReport({
        schoolName: principalSession.schoolName,
        schoolCode: principalSession.schoolCode,
        stage: repStage,
        principalName: principalSession.principalName,
        mobile: repMobile,
        problemType: repProblemType,
        closedVacanciesOption: repProblemType === 'vacancies_closed' ? repClosedVacanciesOption : undefined,
        specificClosedClassesText: (repProblemType === 'vacancies_closed' && repClosedVacanciesOption === 'specific') ? repSpecificClosedClassesText : undefined,
        proposedSolution: repProblemType === 'class_density' ? repProposedSolution : undefined,
        openClassSubOption: (repProblemType === 'class_density' && repProposedSolution === 'open_class') ? repOpenClassSubOption : undefined,
        budgetProposalText: (repProblemType === 'class_density' && repProposedSolution === 'modify_budget') ? repBudgetProposalText : undefined,
        requiredSpecialtiesText: (repProblemType === 'class_density' && repProposedSolution === 'open_class' && repOpenClassSubOption === 'needs_teachers') ? repRequiredSpecialtiesText : undefined
      });

      setFormSuccessMsg(isRtl ? 'تم تسجيل البلاغ والطلب المقترح بنجاح وإرساله لمسئول القبول والتوجيه.' : 'Report submitted successfully to the admission officer.');
      
      // Reset form fields
      setRepMobile('');
      setRepProblemType('vacancies_closed');
      setRepClosedVacanciesOption(undefined);
      setRepSpecificClosedClassesText('');
      setRepProposedSolution(undefined);
      setRepOpenClassSubOption(undefined);
      setRepBudgetProposalText('');
      setRepRequiredSpecialtiesText('');
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        setFormSuccessMsg('');
        setIsReporting(false);
      }, 3000);
    }
  };

  // Filtered surveys based on parent name query - strictly matching guardian name as registered
  const matchedSurveys = useMemo(() => {
    const query = searchName.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    if (!query) return [];
    return surveys.filter(s => {
      const bName = (s.beneficiaryName || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      return bName === query;
    });
  }, [searchName, surveys]);

  // Handle saving evaluation from parent track view
  const handleSaveEval = (survey: SurveyResponse) => {
    const local = evals[survey.id] || {
      staffSatisfaction: survey.staffSatisfaction || 0,
      receptionSatisfaction: survey.receptionSatisfaction || 0,
      generalizeService: (survey as any).generalizeService || 'yes',
      notes: '',
      isResolved: survey.isResolved || false,
    };

    const staffSat = local.staffSatisfaction > 0 ? local.staffSatisfaction : 5;
    const receptionSat = local.receptionSatisfaction > 0 ? local.receptionSatisfaction : 5;
    const genService = local.generalizeService || 'yes';
    const userNotes = (local.notes || '').trim();
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const updatedSurvey: SurveyResponse = {
      ...survey,
      staffSatisfaction: staffSat,
      receptionSatisfaction: receptionSat,
      satisfaction: Math.round((staffSat + receptionSat) / 2),
      generalizeService: genService,
      notes: userNotes || survey.notes,
      isResolved: true,
      beneficiaryEvaluationSubmitted: true,
      evaluationSubmittedAt: nowIso,
      lastUpdatedAt: nowIso
    };

    if (onUpdateSurvey) {
      onUpdateSurvey(updatedSurvey);
    }

    // Direct persistence fallback to localStorage
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem('beneficiary_surveys');
      if (cached) {
        const list = JSON.parse(cached);
        const updatedList = list.map((s: any) => s.id === survey.id ? updatedSurvey : s);
        localStorage.setItem('beneficiary_surveys', JSON.stringify(updatedList));
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }

    // Mark submitted and success in state
    setEvals(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [survey.id]: {
        staffSatisfaction: staffSat,
        receptionSatisfaction: receptionSat,
        generalizeService: genService,
        notes: userNotes,
        isResolved: true,
        submitted: true,
        success: true
      }
    }));

    // Alert user
    alert(isRtl 
      ? '✅ تم حفظ وإرسال تقييمكم بنجاح! تم فتح وعرض بيانات التسكين والمدرسة المعتمدة أدناه.' 
      : '✅ Your evaluation has been submitted successfully! Placement details are unlocked below.');

    // Clear success banner animation after 4 seconds (keeping submitted: true)
    setTimeout(() => {
      setEvals(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        [survey.id]: {
          ...(prev[survey.id] || local),
          submitted: true,
          success: false
        }
      }));
    }, 4000);
  };


  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-[1600px] mx-auto px-2 sm:px-4 lg:px-6 py-2 sm:py-6 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center min-h-[calc(100vh-140px)]" id="portal-root">
      
      {/* VIEW 1: ROLE SELECTION LAUNCHPAD */}
      {view === 'selection' && (
        <div
          key="portal-selection"
          className="my-auto space-y-4 sm:space-y-6 portal-responsive-container w-full animate-fade-in"
        >
            {/* Header Title */}
            <div className="text-center max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-2 sm:space-y-3 pt-2 sm:pt-4 mb-3 sm:mb-6">
              <h1 className={`clamp-portal-title font-black tracking-tight leading-tight transition-colors ${
                isDark ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-800'
              }`}>
                {t.portalTitle}
              </h1>
              <p className={`clamp-portal-subtitle font-bold max-w-3xl mx-auto leading-relaxed transition-colors ${
                isDark ? 'text-teal-300' : 'text-slate-600'
              }`}>
                {t.portalSubtitle}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Selection Grid (Fully Responsive 4x1 PC/Laptop, 2x2 iPad, 1x4 Mobile) */}
            <div className="portal-responsive-grid">
              
              {/* Card 1: Educational Schools Map (خارطة المدارس التعليمية) */}
              <motion.div
                onClick={() => window.open('https://mapedumadinah.com/', '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')}
                className={`group relative rounded-2xl portal-card-padding cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden shadow-sm border h-full ${
                  isDark
                    ? 'glass-card-dark hover:bg-[#074738] hover:border-[#0d624e] hover:shadow-xl'
                    : 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:bg-[#074738] hover:border-[#0d624e] hover:shadow-xl'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Decorative background glow */}
                <div className={`absolute top-0 right-0 w-28 h-28 rounded-full blur-3xl transition-colors duration-150 ${
                  isDark ? 'bg-cyan-500/10 group-hover:bg-emerald-500/20' : 'bg-cyan-500/5 group-hover:bg-emerald-500/20'
                }`} />
                
                <div className="space-y-3 sm:space-y-4">
                  {/* Icon and Title in same box/row */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className={`glass-icon-container p-2.5 sm:p-3 shrink-0 transition-colors duration-150 ${
                      isDark
                        ? 'glass-icon-dark-blue group-hover:bg-[#0d624e] group-hover:border-emerald-400 group-hover:text-white'
                        : 'p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl shadow-md border bg-cyan-600 border-cyan-500 text-white group-hover:bg-[#0d624e] group-hover:border-emerald-400'
                    }`}>
                      <Map className="clamp-card-icon" />
                    </div>
                    <h3 className={`clamp-card-title font-black transition-colors duration-150 leading-snug group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-800'
                    }`}>
                      {st('roleMap', isRtl ? 'خارطة المدارس التعليمية' : 'Educational Schools Map')}
                    </h3>
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:space-y-2">
                    <p className={`clamp-card-badge font-bold leading-relaxed transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-cyan-300' : 'text-cyan-600'
                    }`}>
                      {st('roleMapIndependent', isRtl ? 'رابط خارجي مستقل' : 'Independent External Link')}
                    </p>
                    <p className={`clamp-card-desc font-medium leading-relaxed transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-teal-200/70' : 'text-slate-500'
                    }`}>
                      {st('roleMapDesc', isRtl 
                        ? 'بوابة مخصصة للمستفيدين لمعرفة المدارس القريبة من المدرسة المرغوبة او المستهدفة بالمسافة للتسجيل أو النقل'
                        : 'A portal dedicated to beneficiaries to find schools near their desired or target school by distance for registration or transfer')}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 pt-4 clamp-card-action font-black transition-colors duration-150 mt-auto group-hover:!text-white ${
                  isDark ? 'text-cyan-300' : 'text-cyan-600'
                }`}>
                  <span>{st('roleMapAction', isRtl ? 'زيارة الخارطة الآن' : 'Visit Map Now')}</span>
                  {isRtl ? <ArrowLeft className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" /> : <ArrowRight className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />}
                </div>
              </motion.div>

              {/* Card 2: Parent Beneficiary (ولي أمر) */}
              <motion.div
                onClick={() => setView('parent-choices')}
                className={`group relative rounded-2xl portal-card-padding cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden shadow-sm border h-full ${
                  isDark
                    ? 'glass-card-dark hover:bg-[#074738] hover:border-[#0d624e] hover:shadow-xl'
                    : 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:bg-[#074738] hover:border-[#0d624e] hover:shadow-xl'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Decorative background glow */}
                <div className={`absolute top-0 right-0 w-28 h-28 rounded-full blur-3xl transition-colors duration-150 ${
                  isDark ? 'bg-blue-500/10 group-hover:bg-emerald-500/20' : 'bg-blue-500/5 group-hover:bg-emerald-500/20'
                }`} />
                
                <div className="space-y-3 sm:space-y-4">
                  {/* Icon and Title in same box/row */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className={`glass-icon-container p-2.5 sm:p-3 shrink-0 transition-colors duration-150 ${
                      isDark
                        ? 'glass-icon-dark-blue group-hover:bg-[#0d624e] group-hover:border-emerald-400 group-hover:text-white'
                        : 'p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl shadow-md border bg-blue-600 border-blue-500 text-white group-hover:bg-[#0d624e] group-hover:border-emerald-400'
                    }`}>
                      <Users className="clamp-card-icon" />
                    </div>
                    <h3 className={`clamp-card-title font-black transition-colors duration-150 leading-snug group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-800'
                    }`}>
                      {st('roleParent', isRtl ? 'مستفيد ولي أمر' : 'Parent Beneficiary')}
                    </h3>
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:space-y-2">
                    <p className={`clamp-card-badge font-bold leading-relaxed transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-teal-300' : 'text-blue-600'
                    }`}>
                      {isRtl ? 'دخول مباشر بدون حساب' : 'Direct access without registration'}
                    </p>
                    <p className={`clamp-card-desc font-medium leading-relaxed transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:!text-white ${

                        ? 'glass-icon-dark-emerald group-hover:bg-[#0d624e] group-hover:border-emerald-400 group-hover:text-white'
                        : 'p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl shadow-md border bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-500 text-white group-hover:bg-[#0d624e] group-hover:border-emerald-400'

                    </p>
                    <p className={`clamp-card-desc font-medium leading-relaxed transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-teal-200/70' : 'text-slate-500'
                    }`}>
                      {st('rolePrincipalDesc', isRtl 
                        ? 'بوابة مخصصة لمدراء المدارس للإبلاغ عن الشواغر المتاحة وتحديث بيانات الفصول الدراسية وتأكيد رغبات القبول'
                        : 'Dedicated portal for school principals to report available vacancies, update class data, and confirm admission desires')}
                    </p>

                </div>

                <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 pt-4 clamp-card-action font-black transition-colors duration-150 mt-auto group-hover:!text-white ${

                }`}>
                  <span>{principalSession ? (isRtl ? 'دخول لوحة المدرسة' : 'Enter School Dashboard') : (isRtl ? 'تسجيل الدخول للمدرسة' : 'School Login')}</span>
                  {isRtl ? <ArrowLeft className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" /> : <ArrowRight className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />}
                </div>
              </motion.div>

              {/* Card 4: Department Staff (منسوبي الإدارة) */}
              <motion.div
                onClick={() => {

                    setView('admin-login');
                    setAdminAuthMode('login');
                    setLoginError('');
                  }
                }}
                className={`group relative rounded-2xl portal-card-padding cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden shadow-sm border h-full ${
                  isDark
                    ? 'glass-card-dark hover:bg-[#074738] hover:border-[#0d624e] hover:shadow-xl'
                    : 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:bg-[#074738] hover:border-[#0d624e] hover:shadow-xl'
                }`}

                {/* Decorative background glow */}
                <div className={`absolute top-0 right-0 w-28 h-28 rounded-full blur-3xl transition-colors duration-150 ${
                  isDark ? 'bg-indigo-500/10 group-hover:bg-emerald-500/20' : 'bg-indigo-500/5 group-hover:bg-emerald-500/20'
                }`} />
                
                <div className="space-y-3 sm:space-y-4">
                  {/* Icon and Title in same box/row */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className={`glass-icon-container p-2.5 sm:p-3 shrink-0 transition-colors duration-150 ${
                      isDark
                        ? 'glass-icon-dark-indigo group-hover:bg-[#0d624e] group-hover:border-emerald-400 group-hover:text-white'
                        : 'p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl shadow-md border bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-500 text-white group-hover:bg-[#0d624e] group-hover:border-emerald-400'
                    }`}>
                      <ShieldCheck className="clamp-card-icon" />
                    </div>
                    <h3 className={`clamp-card-title font-black transition-colors duration-150 leading-snug group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-800'
                    }`}>
                      {isRtl ? 'منسوبي الإدارة' : 'Department Staff'}
                    </h3>
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:space-y-2">
                    <p className={`clamp-card-badge font-bold leading-relaxed transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-indigo-300' : 'text-indigo-600'
                    }`}>
                      {getPersistedOfficerSession().isAuthenticated 
                        ? (isRtl ? '✓ جلسة نشطة: استئناف لوحة التحكم' : '✓ Active Session: Open Dashboard')
                        : (isRtl ? 'بوابة إدارة وحوكمة الأنظمة والتحليلات' : 'Administrative governance & analytics')}
                    </p>
                    <p className={`clamp-card-desc font-medium leading-relaxed transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-teal-200/70' : 'text-slate-500'
                    }`}>
                      {isRtl
                        ? 'بوابة الدخول للمصرح لهم من منسوبي الإدارة العامة للتعليم بمنطقة المدينة المنورة'
                        : 'Entry portal for authorized staff of the General Administration of Education in Madinah Region'}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 pt-4 clamp-card-action font-black transition-colors duration-150 mt-auto group-hover:!text-white ${
                  isDark ? 'text-indigo-300' : 'text-indigo-600'
                }`}>
                  <span>{isRtl ? 'تسجيل الدخول لمنسوبي الإدارة' : 'Department Staff Login'}</span>
                  {isRtl ? <ArrowLeft className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" /> : <ArrowRight className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />}
                </div>
              </motion.div>

              {/* Card 5: Inquiries & Communication (الاستفسارات والتواصل) */}
              <motion.div
                onClick={() => {
                  if (onOpenInquiries) {
                    onOpenInquiries();
                  }
                }}
                className={`group relative rounded-2xl portal-card-padding cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden shadow-sm border h-full ${
                  isDark
                    ? 'glass-card-dark hover:bg-[#074738] hover:border-[#0d624e] hover:shadow-xl'
                    : 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:bg-[#074738] hover:border-[#0d624e] hover:shadow-xl'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Decorative background glow */}
                <div className={`absolute top-0 right-0 w-28 h-28 rounded-full blur-3xl transition-colors duration-150 ${
                  isDark ? 'bg-amber-500/10 group-hover:bg-emerald-500/20' : 'bg-amber-500/5 group-hover:bg-emerald-500/20'
                }`} />
                
                <div className="space-y-3 sm:space-y-4">
                  {/* Icon and Title in same box/row */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className={`glass-icon-container p-2.5 sm:p-3 shrink-0 transition-colors duration-150 ${
                      isDark
                        ? 'glass-icon-dark-emerald group-hover:bg-[#0d624e] group-hover:border-emerald-400 group-hover:text-white'
                        : 'p-2.5 sm:p-3 rounded-xl shadow-md border bg-teal-600 border-teal-500 text-white group-hover:bg-[#0d624e] group-hover:border-emerald-400'
                    }`}>
                      <HelpCircle className="clamp-card-icon" />
                    </div>
                    <h3 className={`clamp-card-title font-black transition-colors duration-150 leading-snug group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-800'
                    }`}>
                      {isRtl ? 'الاستفسارات والتواصل' : 'Inquiries & Contact'}
                    </h3>
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:space-y-2">
                    <p className={`clamp-card-badge font-bold leading-relaxed transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-amber-300' : 'text-amber-600'
                    }`}>
                      {isRtl ? 'تقديم استفسار ومتابعة وتقييم' : 'Submit & Track Inquiry'}
                    </p>
                    <p className={`clamp-card-desc font-medium leading-relaxed transition-colors duration-150 group-hover:!text-white ${
                      isDark ? 'text-teal-200/70' : 'text-slate-500'
                    }`}>
                      {isRtl
                        ? 'خدمة الاستفسار المباشر للمستفيدين ومتابعة الاستفسار بالاسم فقط'
                        : 'Direct inquiry service for beneficiaries and tracking by name only'}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 pt-4 clamp-card-action font-black transition-colors duration-150 mt-auto group-hover:!text-white ${
                  isDark ? 'text-amber-300' : 'text-teal-600'
                }`}>
                  <span>{isRtl ? 'فتح نافذة الاستفسارات' : 'Open Inquiries'}</span>
                  {isRtl ? <ArrowLeft className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" /> : <ArrowRight className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />}
                </div>
              </motion.div>

            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* VIEW: ADMIN LOGIN (منسوبي الإدارة) */}
        {view === 'admin-login' && (
          <motion.div
            key="portal-admin-login"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }}
            className="my-auto space-y-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto px-4 w-full"
          >
            <div className={`p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border ${
              isDark ? 'bg-[#092538] border-indigo-800/40' : 'bg-white border-indigo-100'
            }`}>
              {/* Tab Switcher (Login / Register) */}
              <div className="flex p-1 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#0b2336] border dark:border-teal-800/20 mb-8 max-w-xs mx-auto">
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setAdminAuthMode('login');
                    setLoginError('');
                  }}
                  className={`flex-1 py-2 text-[11px] font-black rounded-lg transition-all ${
                    adminAuthMode === 'login'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md'
                      : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-teal-400 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-teal-900/30'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isRtl ? 'تسجيل دخول' : 'Login'}
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setAdminAuthMode('register');
                    setLoginError('');
                  }}
                  className={`flex-1 py-2 text-[11px] font-black rounded-lg transition-all ${
                    adminAuthMode === 'register'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md'
                      : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-teal-400 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-teal-900/30'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isRtl ? 'تسجيل جديد' : 'New Registration'}
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="text-center space-y-3 mb-8">
                <div className="inline-flex p-4 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20 text-white mb-2">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-8 h-8" />
                </div>
                <h2 className={`text-2xl font-black ${isDark ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-800'}`}>
                  {adminAuthMode === 'login' 
                    ? (isRtl ? 'بوابة تسجيل دخول منسوبي الإدارة' : 'Department Staff Login')
                    : (isRtl ? 'تسجيل منسوب جديد في الإدارة' : 'Staff Registration Portal')
                  }
                </h2>
                <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${isDark ? 'text-teal-300' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
                  {adminAuthMode === 'login'
                    ? (isRtl ? 'يرجى إدخال السجل المدني وكلمة السر للمتابعة' : 'Enter your Civil ID and password to continue')
                    : (isRtl ? 'سجل حسابك كمنسوب إدارة لاستخدام صلاحياتك المخصصة' : 'Register your staff account to access your assigned tools')
                  }
                </p>
              </div>

              {adminAuthMode === 'login' ? (
                <div className="space-y-6">

                  <form
                    method="post"
                    action="#"
                    autoComplete="on"
                    className="space-y-5"
                    onSubmit={async (e) => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      const nationalId = (adminUsernameInput || '')
                        .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d).toString())
                        .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d).toString())
                        .trim();
                      const password = (adminPasswordInput || '').trim();

                      if (!nationalId) {
                        setLoginError(isRtl ? 'الرجاء إدخال رقم السجل المدني / اسم المستخدم' : 'Please enter Civil ID / Username');
                        return;
                      }
                      if (!password) {
                        setLoginError(isRtl ? 'الرجاء إدخال كلمة المرور' : 'Please enter password');
                        return;
                      }

                      // 1. Guaranteed Super Admin Login Check (سالم محمد الترجمي - السجل المدني: 1068575628 أو الجوال: 0553512200)
                      if ((nationalId === '1068575628' || nationalId === '0553512200' || nationalId.toLowerCase() === 'admin') && password === 'salim123321rs&1') {
                        setLoginError('');
                        persistOfficerSession('emp_1');
                        localStorage.setItem('admin_api_key', 'salim_admin_key_2026');
                        if (rememberMeAdmin) {
                          await storeBrowserCredential({
                            username: nationalId,
                            password: password,
                            displayName: 'سالم محمد الترجمي',
                            role: 'officer'
                          });
                        }
                        onSelectRole('admin');
                        return;
                      }

                      // 2. Check Officer Users in localStorage (v4/v3)
                      try {
                        const officersRaw = localStorage.getItem('officer_users_v4') || localStorage.getItem('officer_users_v3');
                        if (officersRaw) {
                          const officersList = JSON.parse(officersRaw);
                          if (Array.isArray(officersList)) {
                            const matchedOfficer = officersList.find((o: any) => {
                              const oNat = (o.nationalId || '').toString().trim();
                              const oUser = (o.id || '').toString().trim().toLowerCase();
                              const oMob = (o.mobile || '').toString().trim();
                              const oPass = (o.password || '').toString().trim();
                              return (oNat === nationalId || oUser === nationalId.toLowerCase() || oMob === nationalId) &&
                                     (oPass === password || (oNat === '1068575628' && password === 'salim123321rs&1'));
                            });
                            if (matchedOfficer) {
                              setLoginError('');
                              const offId = matchedOfficer.id || 'emp_1';
                              persistOfficerSession(offId);
                              if (matchedOfficer.nationalId === '1068575628' || matchedOfficer.id === 'emp_1') {
                                localStorage.setItem('admin_api_key', 'salim_admin_key_2026');
                              } else {
                                localStorage.removeItem('admin_api_key');
                              }
                              if (rememberMeAdmin) {
                                await storeBrowserCredential({
                                  username: nationalId,
                                  password: password,
                                  displayName: matchedOfficer.name || 'منسوب إدارة',
                                  role: 'officer'
                                });
                              }
                              onSelectRole('admin');
                              return;
                            }
                          }
                        }
                      } catch (err) {
                        console.error('Officer list parsing error', err);
                      }

                      // 3. Check Registered Admins in localStorage
                      try {
                        const regAdminsRaw = localStorage.getItem('registered_admins_v1');
                        if (regAdminsRaw) {
                          const regAdmins = JSON.parse(regAdminsRaw);
                          const matchedAdmin = regAdmins.find((a: any) => a.nationalId === nationalId && a.password === password);
                          if (matchedAdmin) {
                            setLoginError('');
                            const offId = matchedAdmin.id || 'emp_custom';
                            persistOfficerSession(offId);
                            if (rememberMeAdmin) {
                              await storeBrowserCredential({
                                username: nationalId,
                                password: password,
                                displayName: matchedAdmin.name || 'منسوب إدارة',
                                role: 'officer'
                              });
                            }
                            onSelectRole('admin');
                            return;
                          }
                        }
                      } catch (err) {
                        console.error('Login parsing error', err);
                      }

                      setLoginError(isRtl ? 'خطأ في السجل المدني أو كلمة المرور!' : 'Incorrect Civil ID or password!');
                    }}
                  >
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      <label htmlFor="admin-username" className={`block text-xs font-black ${isDark ? 'text-teal-400' : 'text-slate-700'}`}>
                        {isRtl ? 'اسم المستخدم / رقم السجل المدني:' : 'Username / Civil ID:'}
                      </label>
                      <div className="relative">
                        <User className="absolute top-3.5 right-3.5 w-4.5 h-4.5 text-slate-400" />
                        <input
                          id="admin-username"
                          name="username"
                          autoComplete="username"
                          type="text"
                          value={adminUsernameInput}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            setAdminUsernameInput(e.target.value);
                            setLoginError('');
                          }}
                          placeholder={isRtl ? 'أدخل رقم السجل المدني...' : 'Enter Civil ID...'}
                          className={`w-full pr-11 pl-4 py-3 rounded-xl outline-none border transition-all text-sm font-bold ${
                            isDark ? 'bg-[#0b2336] border-teal-800/40 text-white focus:border-indigo-400' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500'
                          }`}
                          required
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      <label htmlFor="admin-password" className={`block text-xs font-black ${isDark ? 'text-teal-400' : 'text-slate-700'}`}>
                        {isRtl ? 'كلمة المرور:' : 'Password:'}
                      </label>
                      <div className="relative">
                        <Lock className="absolute top-3.5 right-3.5 w-4.5 h-4.5 text-slate-400" />
                        <input
                          id="admin-password"
                          name="password"
                          autoComplete="current-password"
                          type={showAdminPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                          value={adminPasswordInput}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            setAdminPasswordInput(e.target.value);
                            setLoginError('');
                          }}
                          placeholder={isRtl ? 'أدخل كلمة السر الخاصة بك...' : 'Enter your password...'}
                          className={`w-full pr-11 pl-11 py-3 rounded-xl outline-none border transition-all text-sm font-bold ${
                            isDark ? 'bg-[#0b2336] border-teal-800/40 text-white focus:border-indigo-400' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500'
                          }`}
                          required
                        />
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setShowAdminPassword(!showAdminPassword)}
                          className="absolute inset-y-0 left-3 flex items-center text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          {showAdminPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Remember me & Persistent Session Checkbox */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold pt-1">
                      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none text-slate-700 dark:text-teal-300">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={rememberMeAdmin}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            setRememberMeAdmin(e.target.checked);
                            setKeepLoggedInEnabled(e.target.checked);
                          }}
                          className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500 border-slate-300 cursor-pointer"
                        />
                        <span>{isRtl ? 'حفظ تسجيل الدخول في المتصفح والبقاء متصلاً دائماً' : 'Save login in browser & stay connected'}</span>
                      </label>
                    </div>

                    {/* Browser Password Integration Notice */}
                    <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-2.5 ${
                      isDark ? 'bg-indigo-950/40 border-indigo-800/40 text-indigo-200' : 'bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-200 text-indigo-900'
                    }`}>
                      <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span>{isRtl ? 'يدعم التطبيق التكامل المباشر مع متصفحك (Google Password Manager / Apple / Edge) للحفظ التلقائي وتفادي انقطاع الجلسة عند عدم النشاط.' : 'Direct integration with your browser password manager for permanent stay-logged-in access.'}</span>
                    </div>

                    {loginError && (
                      <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-100 text-rose-600 text-[11px] font-black flex items-center gap-2 animate-shake">
                        <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                        <span>{loginError}</span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="w-full py-3.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-black text-sm rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-[0.98] cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <LogIn className="w-5 h-5" />
                      <span>{isRtl ? 'تسجيل الدخول للنظام' : 'Sign In to System'}</span>
                    </button>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setView('selection')}
                      className={`w-full py-3 border text-xs font-black rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${
                        isDark ? 'border-indigo-800/40 text-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-900/20' : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isRtl ? 'العودة للاختيار' : 'Back to Selection'}
                    </button>
                  </form>
                </div>
              ) : (
                /* ADMIN REGISTRATION FORM */
                <div className="space-y-5">
                  {/* Step 1: Unit & ID */}
                  {!isAdminDataConfirmed && (
                    <>
                      <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        <label className={`block text-xs font-black ${isDark ? 'text-teal-400' : 'text-slate-700'}`}>
                          {isRtl ? '1. اختر الإدارة / القسم / الوحدة التابع لها:' : '1. Select Department / Unit / Section:'}
                        </label>
                        <select
                          value={selectedAdminUnit}
                          onChange={(e) => setSelectedAdminUnit(e.target.value)}
                          className={`w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl outline-none border transition-all text-sm font-bold appearance-none cursor-pointer ${
                            isDark ? 'bg-[#0b2336] border-teal-800/40 text-white focus:border-indigo-400' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <option value="">{isRtl ? '-- اختر الجهة التابع لها --' : '-- Select Unit --'}</option>
                          {ADMIN_UNITS.map((unit, idx) => (
                            <option key={idx} value={unit}>{unit}</option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        <label className={`block text-xs font-black ${isDark ? 'text-teal-400' : 'text-slate-700'}`}>
                          {isRtl ? '2. رقم السجل المدني للمنسوب (10 أرقام):' : '2. Staff Civil ID (10 digits):'}
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={enteredCivilId}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const val = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 10);
                            setEnteredCivilId(val);
                            setAdminRetrievalStatus('idle');
                            setLoginError('');
                          }}
                          placeholder={isRtl ? 'أدخل رقم السجل المدني...' : 'Enter Civil ID...'}
                          className={`w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl outline-none border transition-all text-sm font-bold ${
                            isDark ? 'bg-[#0b2336] border-teal-800/40 text-white focus:border-indigo-400' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500'
                          }`}
                        />
                      </div>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (!selectedAdminUnit || !enteredCivilId || enteredCivilId.length < 10) {
                            setLoginError(isRtl ? 'يرجى اختيار الجهة وإدخال رقم السجل المدني كاملاً!' : 'Select unit and enter valid Civil ID!');
                            return;
                          }
                          setIsAdminRetrieving(true);
                          setLoginError('');
                          setTimeout(() => {
                            // تنظيف وتحويل أرقام السجل المدني للإنجليزية
                            const cleanEnteredId = (enteredCivilId || '')
                              .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d).toString())
                              .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d).toString())
                              .trim();

                            // تجميع كافة منسوبي الإدارة من التخزين المحلي وملفات الإكسل المرفوعة
                            let allOfficersList: any[] = [];
                            
                            // 1. القائمة الأحدث المرفوعة من ملفات الإكسل (v4)
                            try {
                              const raw4 = localStorage.getItem('officer_users_v4');
                              if (raw4) {
                                const p4 = JSON.parse(raw4);
                                if (Array.isArray(p4)) allOfficersList.push(...p4);
                              }
                            } catch {}

                            // 2. القائمة السابقة (v3)
                            try {
                              const raw3 = localStorage.getItem('officer_users_v3');
                              if (raw3) {
                                const p3 = JSON.parse(raw3);
                                if (Array.isArray(p3)) {
                                  p3.forEach((o: any) => {
                                    if (!allOfficersList.some(x => String(x.nationalId).trim() === String(o.nationalId).trim())) {
                                      allOfficersList.push(o);
                                    }
                                  });
                                }
                              }
                            } catch {}

                            // 3. المنسوبون التجريبيون المعتمدون
                            DEMO_OFFICERS.forEach(d => {
                              if (!allOfficersList.some(x => String(x.nationalId).trim() === String(d.nationalId).trim())) {
                                allOfficersList.push(d);
                              }
                            });

                            // 4. المسؤولون الرسميون
                            OFFICIAL_ADMINS.forEach(d => {
                              if (!allOfficersList.some(x => String(x.nationalId).trim() === String(d.nationalId).trim())) {
                                allOfficersList.push(d);
                              }
                            });

                            // البحث الدقيق والشامل بالسجل المدني أو الجوال أو المعرف
                            const match = allOfficersList.find((a: any) => {
                              const aNat = String(a.nationalId || '').trim();
                              const aMob = String(a.mobile || '').trim();
                              const aId = String(a.id || '').trim();
                              return aNat === cleanEnteredId || aMob === cleanEnteredId || aId === cleanEnteredId;
                            });

                            if (match) {
                              const roleTitleMap: Record<string, string> = {
                                admin: 'مدير النظام (أدمن - كامل الصلاحيات)',
                                director: 'مدير الإدارة',
                                manager_admission_unit: 'مدير وحدة القبول',
                                supervisor: 'مشرف وحدة القبول والتوجيه',
                                tech_support_supervisor: 'مشرف القبول دعم فني',
                                equivalency_supervisor: 'مشرف القبول معادلة الشهادات',
                                planning_vacancy_supervisor: 'مشرف التخطيط فتح الشواغر',
                                school_planning: 'مشرف التخطيط المدرسي',
                                school_leadership: 'مشرف القيادة المدرسية',
                                primary_school_supervisor: 'مشرف الإدارة المدرسية (ابتدائي)',
                                intermediate_school_supervisor: 'مشرف الإدارة المدرسية (متوسط)',
                                secondary_school_supervisor: 'مشرف الإدارة المدرسية (ثانوي)',
                                early_childhood_official: 'مسؤول الطفولة المبكرة',
                                kindergarten_official: 'مسؤول رياض الأطفال',
                              };

                              const roleText = match.roleDescription || match.tasks || roleTitleMap[match.role] || (match.role === 'admin' ? 'مدير النظام' : 'مشرف معتمد');
