                      ) : (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-black border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/30">
                          <AlertCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                          غير مسجل
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* School Name */}
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <School className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-teal-600 shrink-0" />
                        <span>{school.displayName}</span>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Ministry Code */}
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-mono font-black text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400">
                      {school.displayCode || '—'}
                    </td>

                    {/* Stage & Sector */}
                    <td className="p-3.5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                      <div className="space-y-0.5">
                        <div className="font-bold">
                          {school.stage === 'Secondary' ? 'ثانوي' : school.stage === 'Intermediate' ? 'متوسط' : school.stage === 'Kindergarten' ? 'رياض أطفال' : school.stage === 'All' ? 'مجمع' : 'ابتدائي'}
                          {' • '}
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{school.gender === 'girls' ? 'بنات' : 'بنين'}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold">{school.district || (school as any).sector || school.customFields?.['القطاع'] || 'المدينة المنورة'}</div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Mobile */}
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                      {school.principalMobile}
                    </td>

                    {/* Match Status Badge */}
                    <td className="p-3.5 text-center">
                      {school.hasValidCivilId ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 font-black text-[10px]">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                          مطابق للسجل
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 font-black text-[10px]">
                          <AlertCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                          ينقصه الهوية
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Actions */}
                    <td className="p-3.5 text-center">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => openEditModal(school)}
                          className="p-1.5 text-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-50 dark:hover:bg-teal-950/60 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer"
                          title="تعديل بيانات المدير والمدرسة"
                        >
                          <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                        
                        {onDeleteSchool && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => {
                              if (!isSystemAdmin(activeOfficer)) {
                                alert('عذراً، حذف المدارس مقتصر حصرياً على مدير النظام (الأدمن) أ. سالم محمد الترجمي.');
                                return;
                              }
                              if (confirm(`هل أنت متأكد من حذف مدرسة (${school.displayName})؟`)) {
                                onDeleteSchool(school.id);
                                showToast('تم حذف المدرسة بنجاح', 'info');
                              }
                            }}
                            className="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/60 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer"
                            title="حذف المدرسة"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
                })
              ) : (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={9} className="p-12 text-center text-slate-400">
                    <div className="space-y-3 max-w-sm mx-auto">
                      <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
                        <Search className="w-6 h-6" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-sm font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">لم يتم العثور على أي نتائج تطابق البحث</div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">يمكنك تعديل كلمات البحث أو رفع ملف إكسل جديد يحتوي على بيانات مديري المدارس.</p>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* Pagination Bar Controls */}
        {filteredSchools.length > pageSize && (
          <div className="p-4 border-t dark:border-teal-800/20 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
            <div className="font-bold text-slate-500">
              عرض {(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1} - {Math.min(currentPage * pageSize, filteredSchools.length)} من أصل {filteredSchools.length} مدرسة
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold">
              <button
                disabled={currentPage === 1}
                onClick={() => setCurrentPage(p => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border dark:border-teal-800/40 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                السابق
              </button>
              <span className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800/40 font-mono">
                صفحة {currentPage} من {totalPages}
              </span>
              <button
                disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
                onClick={() => setCurrentPage(p => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border dark:border-teal-800/40 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                التالي
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 5. UPLOAD & PREVIEW EXCEL MODAL */}
      {showUploadModal && parsedData && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className={`w-full max-w-4xl rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto ${
            isDark ? 'bg-[#081e2b] text-white border border-teal-800/40' : 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xl'
          }`}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-4 dark:border-teal-800/30">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-600 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <FileSpreadsheet className="w-6 h-6" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    معاينة واستيراد ملف إكسل مديري المدارس
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">
                    الملف: <span className="font-mono text-emerald-600">{parsedData.fileName}</span>
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setShowUploadModal(false)}
                className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 rounded-xl"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Stats Overview of Uploaded File */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border ${isDark ? 'bg-slate-900/60 border-teal-800/30' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'}`}>
                <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">إجمالي الصفوف المقروءة</div>
                <div className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono mt-1">{parsedData.totalRows} مدرسة</div>
              </div>
              <div className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border ${isDark ? 'bg-emerald-950/30 border-emerald-800/40' : 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200'}`}>
                <div className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">صفوف مكتملة بالسجل المدني</div>
                <div className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-600 font-mono mt-1">{parsedData.validWithId} مدير</div>
              </div>
              <div className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border ${isDark ? 'bg-slate-900/60 border-teal-800/30' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'}`}>
                <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">عمود السجل المدني المكتشف تلقائياً</div>
                <div className="text-xs font-black text-teal-600 font-mono mt-2 truncate">
                  {parsedData.detectedIdColumn || 'السجل المدني (تطابق تلقائي)'}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Import Mode Selector */}
            {isSystemAdmin(activeOfficer) ? (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-xs font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">اختر طريقة حفظ البيانات في النظام:</label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <label className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border cursor-pointer flex items-start gap-3 transition-all ${
                  importMode === 'merge' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/20' : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-teal-800/30'
                }`}>
                  <input 
                    type="radio" 
                    name="importMode" 
                    checked={importMode === 'merge'} 
                    onChange={() => setImportMode('merge')} 
                    className="mt-1 accent-emerald-600"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">دمج وتحديث المدارس الحالية (موصى به)</div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 mt-0.5">تحديث بيانات المدراء للمدارس الموجودة وإضافة أي مدارس جديدة بالملف.</p>
                  </div>
                </label>

                <label className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border cursor-pointer flex items-start gap-3 transition-all ${
                  importMode === 'replace' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/20' : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-teal-800/30'
                }`}>
                  <input 
                    type="radio" 
                    name="importMode" 
                    checked={importMode === 'replace'} 
                    onChange={() => setImportMode('replace')} 
                    className="mt-1 accent-emerald-600"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">استبدال كامل السجلات بالملف الجديد (الأدمن فقط)</div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 mt-0.5">مسح الدليل الحالي واعتماد المدارس والمدراء الموجودين في هذا الملف فقط.</p>
                  </div>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>
            ) : (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/50 text-xs font-bold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">
              🔒 يتم تلقائياً دمج وتحديث المدارس والبيانات السابقة وحمايتها من الحذف (الحذف والاستبدال محصور بحساب الأدمن فقط).
            </div>
            )}

            {/* Preview Table of First 15 Rows */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="text-xs font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">معاينة أول 10 صفوف من الملف:</div>
              <div className="border border-slate-200 dark:border-teal-800/30 rounded-xl overflow-x-auto max-h-52 overflow-y-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-right text-xs">
                  <thead className={`sticky top-0 ${isDark ? 'bg-slate-950' : 'bg-slate-100'} font-black text-[11px]`}>
                    <tr>
                      <th className="p-2.5">اسم المدرسة</th>
                      <th className="p-2.5">الرقم الوزاري</th>
                      <th className="p-2.5">اسم المدير</th>
                      <th className="p-2.5">السجل المدني</th>
                      <th className="p-2.5">الجوال</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-teal-800/10">
                    {parsedData.rows.slice(0, 10).map((r, i) => (
                      <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-900/50">
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-bold">{r.nameAr}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-mono text-teal-600">{r.ministryCode}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5">{r.principalName}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5">
                          {r.principalCivilId ? (
                            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                              {r.principalCivilId}
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-amber-500 text-[10px]">غير موجود</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-mono">{r.principalMobile || '—'}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Actions */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t dark:border-teal-800/30">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowUploadModal(false)}
                className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border ${
                  isDark ? 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200'
                }`}
              >
                إلغاء
              </button>
              
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCommitImport}
                className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-900/20 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>اعتماد وحفظ البيانات في النظام ({parsedData.totalRows} مدرسة)</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* CONFIRM CLEAR ALL PRINCIPALS DATA MODAL */}
      {showClearConfirmModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className={`rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-5 border shadow-2xl ${
            isDark ? 'bg-[#081e2b] border-teal-800/40 text-white' : 'bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-900'
          }`}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b pb-4 border-rose-100 dark:border-rose-900/30">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60 text-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                <Trash2 className="w-6 h-6" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-black text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  تأكيد حذف بيانات مديري المدارس الحالية
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 mt-0.5">
                  تفريغ كافة سجلات مديري المدارس والربط بالسجل المدني
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed font-bold">
              هل أنت متأكد من رغبتك في حذف وتفريغ جميع بيانات مديري المدارس والربط بالسجل المدني الحالية؟ سيتم مسح كافة السجلات المتاحة حالياً ({schools.length} سجل).
            </p>

            <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/30 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 font-bold">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>ملاحظة: يمكنك إعادة رفع البيانات في أي وقت بملف جديد عبر خيار "رفع ملف الإكسل".</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowClearConfirmModal(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                إلغاء التراجع
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  (onUpdateSchools as any)([], true);
                  setShowClearConfirmModal(false);
                  showToast('🗑️ تم حذف جميع بيانات مديري المدارس الحالية بنجاح', 'success');
                }}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>نعم، حذف البيانات الحالية</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 6. ADD / EDIT PRINCIPAL & SCHOOL MODAL */}
      {(showAddModal || editingSchool) && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className={`w-full max-w-xl rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto ${
            isDark ? 'bg-[#081e2b] text-white border border-teal-800/40' : 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xl'
          }`}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-4 dark:border-teal-800/30">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-teal-50 dark:bg-teal-950/60 text-teal-600 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Edit3 className="w-5 h-5" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    {editingSchool ? 'تعديل بيانات المدرسة والمدير' : 'إضافة مدرسة ومدير جديد للدليل'}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">
                    تأكد من إدخال رقم السجل المدني (10 أرقام) لتمكينه من الدخول والتسجيل الفوري.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowAddModal(false);
                  setEditingSchool(null);
                }}
                className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 rounded-xl"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSaveSchoolForm} className="space-y-4 text-xs font-bold">
              {/* Row 1: School Name & Code */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">اسم المدرسة <span className="text-rose-500">*</span></label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={formData.nameAr}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, nameAr: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="مثال: مدرسة أحد الابتدائية"
                    className={`w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl border outline-none ${
                      isDark ? 'bg-slate-900 border-teal-800/40 text-white' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-900'
                    }`}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">الرقم الوزاري للمدرسة <span className="text-rose-500">*</span></label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={formData.ministryCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, ministryCode: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="مثال: 1001"
                    className={`w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl border font-mono outline-none ${
                      isDark ? 'bg-slate-900 border-teal-800/40 text-white' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-900'
                    }`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Row 2: Principal Name & Civil ID (Crucial!) */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                    <span>اسم مدير / مديرة المدرسة</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.principalName}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, principalName: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="مثال: أ. سالم بن محمد الترجمي"
                    className={`w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl border outline-none ${
                      isDark ? 'bg-slate-900 border-emerald-800/40 text-white' : 'bg-white border-emerald-200 text-slate-900'
                    }`}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <CreditCard className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                    <span>السجل المدني (10 أرقام)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.principalCivilId}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, principalCivilId: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 10) })}
                    placeholder="10 أرقام (مثال: 1052889670)"
                    className={`w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl border font-mono outline-none ${
                      isDark ? 'bg-slate-900 border-emerald-800/40 text-white' : 'bg-white border-emerald-200 text-slate-900'
                    }`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Row 3: Mobile & Stage */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">رقم جوال المدير</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.principalMobile}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, principalMobile: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="مثال: 0551112222"
                    className={`w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl border font-mono outline-none ${

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t dark:border-teal-800/30">

                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setShowAddModal(false);
                    setEditingSchool(null);
                  }}

                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-700 text-white rounded-xl font-black shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {editingSchool ? 'حفظ التعديلات' : 'إضافة وحفظ في الدليل'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { SchoolItem } from '../types';
import { Search, Building2, Check, ChevronDown, X, Sparkles, Hash } from 'lucide-react';
import { normalizeArabicText, matchesSearchQuery } from './Dashboard';

export { normalizeArabicText };

interface SchoolSelectDropdownProps {
  schools: SchoolItem[];
  value: string;
  onChange: (schoolName: string, ministryCode?: string, schoolObj?: SchoolItem) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  isDark?: boolean;
  isRtl?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  id?: string;
  label?: string;
  helperText?: string;
  name?: string;
  autoComplete?: string;
}

export const SchoolSelectDropdown: React.FC<SchoolSelectDropdownProps> = ({
  schools,
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder,
  isDark = false,
  isRtl = true,
  required = false,
  error,
  id = 'school-search-select',
  label,
  helperText,
  name,
  autoComplete
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(value || '');
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSearchQuery(value || '');
  }, [value]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  // Filter with ultra-high sensitivity matching
  const filteredSchools = schools.filter((school) => {
    return matchesSearchQuery(
      [
        school.nameAr,
        school.nameEn,
        school.ministryCode,
        (school as any).code,
        school.district,
        school.stage,
        school.gender === 'boys' ? 'بنين' : school.gender === 'girls' ? 'بنات' : 'مشترك'
      ],
      searchQuery
    );
  });

  const handleSelect = (school: SchoolItem) => {
    const codeToUse = school.ministryCode || (school as any).code;
    setSearchQuery(school.nameAr);
    onChange(school.nameAr, codeToUse, school);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setSearchQuery(val);
    const matched = schools.find(s => s.nameAr.trim().toLowerCase() === val.trim().toLowerCase());
    onChange(val, matched ? (matched.ministryCode || (matched as any).code) : undefined, matched);
    if (!isOpen) setIsOpen(true);
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    onChange('');
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full" ref={containerRef} id={id}>
      {label && (
        <label className={`block text-xs font-black mb-1.5 ${isDark ? 'text-teal-200' : 'text-slate-700'}`}>
          {label} {required && <span className="text-red-500">*</span>}
        </label>
      )}

      <div className="relative">
        <div className={`absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex items-center gap-1.5 pointer-events-none ${
          isRtl ? 'right-3.5' : 'left-3.5'
        }`}>
          <Building2 className={`w-4 h-4 ${isDark ? 'text-teal-400' : 'text-teal-600'}`} />
        </div>

        <input
          type="text"
          name={name}
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={handleInputChange}
          onFocus={() => setIsOpen(true)}
          placeholder={placeholder || (isRtl ? 'ابحث باسم المدرسة أو الرقم الوزاري (تحسس عالي)...' : 'Search school name or ministerial code...')}
          className={`w-full py-2.5 px-10 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold transition-all outline-none border ${
            error
              ? 'border-red-500 ring-2 ring-red-500/20'
              : isOpen
              ? isDark
                ? 'border-teal-500 ring-2 ring-teal-500/30 bg-slate-900 text-white'
                : 'border-teal-600 ring-2 ring-teal-600/20 bg-white text-slate-900'
              : isDark
              ? 'border-teal-800/60 bg-teal-950/30 text-teal-100 hover:border-teal-700'
              : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-900 hover:border-slate-300'
          }`}
        />

        <div className={`absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex items-center gap-1 ${
          isRtl ? 'left-3' : 'right-3'
        }`}>
          {searchQuery && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClear}
              className={`p-1 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-200/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all ${
                isDark ? 'text-slate-400' : 'text-slate-500'
              }`}
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
            className={`p-1 rounded-md ${isDark ? 'text-teal-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}
          >
            <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 transition-transform duration-200 ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-red-500">{error}</p>}
      {helperText && !error && (
        <p className={`mt-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${isDark ? 'text-teal-300/80' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
          {helperText}
        </p>
      )}

      {/* High-Sensitivity Filtered Dropdown Menu */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div
          className={`absolute z-50 mt-1.5 w-full rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border max-h-64 overflow-y-auto backdrop-blur-md transition-all ${
            isDark
              ? 'bg-slate-900/95 border-teal-800/80 text-teal-100 divide-y divide-teal-900/40'
              : 'bg-white/98 border-teal-200 text-slate-800 divide-y divide-slate-100'
          }`}
        >
          <div className={`p-2 sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-between border-b text-[10px] font-black ${
            isDark ? 'bg-slate-900 text-teal-300 border-teal-800/60' : 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200'
          }`}>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Search className="w-3 h-3 text-teal-500" />
              {isRtl ? `نتائج البحث الذكي السريع (${filteredSchools.length} مدرسة)` : `Smart Results (${filteredSchools.length})`}
            </span>
            <span className="text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 font-extrabold flex items-center gap-0.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
              {isRtl ? 'مطابقة عالية التحسس' : 'High Sensitivity Match'}
            </span>
          </div>

          {filteredSchools.length > 0 ? (
            filteredSchools.map((school) => {
              const isSelected = value && value.trim().toLowerCase() === school.nameAr.trim().toLowerCase();
              return (
                <button
                  key={school.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(school)}
                  className={`w-full text-start p-3 transition-colors flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                    isSelected
                      ? isDark
                        ? 'bg-teal-900/60 text-white font-black'
                        : 'bg-teal-50 text-teal-900 font-black'
                      : isDark
                      ? 'hover:bg-teal-950/80 text-teal-100'
                      : 'hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="font-black text-xs">{school.nameAr}</span>
                      {(school.ministryCode || (school as any).code) && (
                        <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-mono font-bold ${
                          isDark ? 'bg-teal-950 text-teal-300 border border-teal-800/60' : 'bg-teal-100/80 text-teal-900 border border-teal-200'
                        }`}>
                          <Hash className="w-2.5 h-2.5 opacity-70" />
                          {school.ministryCode || (school as any).code}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-teal-300/70 font-bold">
                      {school.stage && (
                        <span>
                          {school.stage === 'Elementary' ? (isRtl ? 'الابتدائية' : 'Elementary')
                            : school.stage === 'Intermediate' ? (isRtl ? 'المتوسطة' : 'Intermediate')
                            : school.stage === 'Secondary' ? (isRtl ? 'الثانوية' : 'Secondary')
                            : school.stage === 'Kindergarten' ? (isRtl ? 'رياض الأطفال' : 'Kindergarten')
                            : school.stage}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {school.gender && (
                        <span>• {school.gender === 'boys' ? (isRtl ? 'بنين' : 'Boys') : school.gender === 'girls' ? (isRtl ? 'بنات' : 'Girls') : (isRtl ? 'مشترك' : 'Both')}</span>
                      )}
                      {school.district && <span>• {school.district}</span>}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {isSelected && <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 shrink-0 ms-2" />}
                </button>
              );
            })
          ) : (
            <div className="p-4 text-center">
              <p className={`text-xs font-bold ${isDark ? 'text-teal-300' : 'text-slate-600'}`}>
                {isRtl ? `لم نجد مدرسة بالمطابقة المباشرة لـ: "${searchQuery}"` : `No direct school match for: "${searchQuery}"`}
              </p>
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    onChange(searchQuery);
                    setIsOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className="mt-2.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition-all inline-flex items-center gap-1 shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isRtl ? `اعتماد الاسم المدخل ("${searchQuery}")` : `Use custom name ("${searchQuery}")`}</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  FileText,
  Download,
  Printer,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  FileCode,
  Archive,
  Eye,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  X,
  Sparkles,
  LayoutTemplate,
  Sliders,
  Maximize2,
  Layers,
  Clock,
  Percent,
  Star,
  AlertTriangle,
  GraduationCap,
  School,
  BookOpen,
  Baby,
  Award,
  FileCheck,
  FileBadge
} from 'lucide-react';
import { saveAs } from 'file-saver';
import {
  ReportExportData,
  analyzeIdealOrientation,
  exportReportToPdf,
  exportReportToWord,
  exportReportToExcel,
  exportReportAllFormats,
  printReportDirectly
} from '../utils/reportExporter';
import { getPortraitKlicheSvg, getLandscapeKlicheSvg } from '../utils/klicheAssets';

interface OfficialReportModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  reportData: ReportExportData;
  isDark?: boolean;
  isRtl?: boolean;
}

export const OfficialReportModal: React.FC<OfficialReportModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  reportData,
  isDark = false,
  isRtl = true
}) => {
  const [selectedFormat, setSelectedFormat] = useState<'pdf' | 'word' | 'excel'>('pdf');
  const [orientationMode, setOrientationMode] = useState<'auto' | 'portrait' | 'landscape'>('auto');
  const [statusState, setStatusState] = useState<'idle' | 'loading' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState<string>('');
  const [previewTab, setPreviewTab] = useState<'visual' | 'data'>('visual');
  const [selectedSectionFilter, setSelectedSectionFilter] = useState<string>('all');

  const previewContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Compute effective orientation
  const effectiveOrientation =
    orientationMode === 'auto'
      ? analyzeIdealOrientation({ ...reportData, orientation: 'auto' })
      : orientationMode;

  const isLandscape = effectiveOrientation === 'landscape';

  // Handler for exporting
  const handleExport = async (format: 'pdf' | 'word' | 'excel' | 'all') => {
    try {
      setStatusState('loading');
      setStatusMessage('جارٍ إعداد وتجهيز التقرير الرسمي...');

      const currentData: ReportExportData = {
        ...reportData,
        orientation: orientationMode
      };

      const safeReportNum = reportData.meta.reportNumber.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
      const baseFilename = `تقرير_وحدة_القبول_${safeReportNum}`;

      if (format === 'pdf') {
        const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('EXPORT_TIMEOUT')), 15000);
        });

        try {
          const blob = await Promise.race([
            exportReportToPdf(currentData, null, (progressMsg) => {
              setStatusMessage(progressMsg);
            }),
            timeoutPromise
          ]);
          saveAs(blob, `${baseFilename}.pdf`);
          setStatusState('success');
          setStatusMessage('تم استخراج وتحميل ملف PDF عالي الجودة بنجاح ✓');
        } catch (pdfErr: any) {
          console.warn('Direct PDF canvas generation took longer than threshold or had an issue, fallback to instant print:', pdfErr);
          setStatusMessage('جارٍ فتح نافذة الطباعة والحفظ الفوري كـ PDF...');
          printReportDirectly(currentData);
          setStatusState('success');
          setStatusMessage('تم فتح نافذة الطباعة الرسمية والحفظ كـ PDF بنجاح ✓');
        }
      } else if (format === 'word') {
        const blob = await exportReportToWord(currentData);
        saveAs(blob, `${baseFilename}.docx`);
        setStatusState('success');
        setStatusMessage('تم إنشاء وتحميل مستند Word (.docx) بنجاح.');
      } else if (format === 'excel') {
        const blob = await exportReportToExcel(currentData);
        saveAs(blob, `${baseFilename}.xlsx`);
        setStatusState('success');
        setStatusMessage('تم إنشاء وتحميل جدول Excel (.xlsx) بنجاح.');
      } else if (format === 'all') {
        const blob = await exportReportAllFormats(currentData);
        saveAs(blob, `${baseFilename}_حزمة_شاملة.zip`);
        setStatusState('success');
        setStatusMessage('تم تجميع وتصدير كافة الصيغ (PDF, Word, Excel) في ملف ZIP بنجاح.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Report export error:', err);
      setStatusState('error');
      setStatusMessage(
        format === 'excel'
          ? 'تعذر إنشاء ملف Excel، حاول مرة أخرى.'
          : format === 'word'
          ? 'تعذر إنشاء ملف Word، حاول مرة أخرى.'
          : 'حدث خطأ أثناء استخراج التقرير، يرجى المحاولة لاحقاً.'
      );
    }
  };

  // Direct vector print / save as PDF via native browser dialog
  const handlePrint = () => {
    try {
      const currentData: ReportExportData = {
        ...reportData,
        orientation: orientationMode
      };
      printReportDirectly(currentData);
      setStatusState('success');
      setStatusMessage('تم فتح نافذة الطباعة الرسمية / الحفظ كـ PDF بنجاح ✓');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Print error:', err);
      setStatusState('error');
      setStatusMessage('تعذر تشغيل نافذة الطباعة، يرجى المحاولة لاحقاً.');
    }
  };

  const klicheSvg = isLandscape ? getLandscapeKlicheSvg() : getPortraitKlicheSvg();

  const getSummaryItemIcon = (label: string, iconKey?: string) => {
    if (iconKey === 'layers' || label.includes('إجمالي')) {
      return <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'check-circle' || label.includes('المنجزة')) {
      return <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'clock' || label.includes('الجارية')) {
      return <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'percent' || label.includes('نسبة')) {
      return <Percent className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-teal-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'star' || label.includes('رضا')) {
      return <Star className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'alert-triangle' || label.includes('بلاغات')) {
      return <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'graduation-cap' || (label.includes('المرحلة الثانوية') && !label.includes('معادلات'))) {
      return <GraduationCap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'school' || (label.includes('المرحلة المتوسطة') && !label.includes('معادلات'))) {
      return <School className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'book-open' || (label.includes('المرحلة الابتدائية') && !label.includes('معادلات'))) {
      return <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'baby' || label.includes('الطفولة المبكرة') || label.includes('رياض الأطفال')) {
      return <Baby className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-pink-500 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'award' || label.includes('معادلات المرحلة الثانوية')) {
      return <Award className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'file-text' || label.includes('معادلات المرحلة المتوسطة')) {
      return <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    if (iconKey === 'file-badge' || label.includes('معادلات المرحلة الابتدائية')) {
      return <FileBadge className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-teal-600 shrink-0" />;
    }
    return <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-teal-600 shrink-0" />;
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md animate-fade-in overflow-y-auto" dir="rtl">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-teal-800/30 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-6xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
        
        {/* Header Bar */}
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#218caa] via-[#2883a4] to-[#3078a6] p-5 sm:p-6 text-white flex items-center justify-between shadow-md shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-white/10 rounded-2xl border border-white/20">
              <FileText className="w-6 h-6 text-teal-200" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-teal-500/30 text-teal-100 border border-teal-400/30 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                  وحدة القبول - إدارة التعليم بمنطقة المدينة المنورة
                </span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black mt-1">
                منظومة إخراج التقارير الرسمية المعتمدة
              </h2>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 text-white/80 hover:text-white bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer"
            title="إغلاق النافذة"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body Grid: Settings Panel on Left/Right & Live Preview */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
          
          {/* Options Sidebar (4 cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-4 p-5 sm:p-6 border-b lg:border-b-0 lg:border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-slate-900/50 space-y-6">
            
            {/* Section: خيارات استخراج التقرير */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
                <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-[#218caa]" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-teal-200">
                  خيارات استخراج التقرير
                </h3>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
                حدد التنسيق والاتجاه المناسب لمخرجات التقرير الرسمي لوحدة القبول.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                اتجاه التقرير والكليشة الرسمية:
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOrientationMode('auto')}
                  className={`px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all border text-center cursor-pointer ${
                    orientationMode === 'auto'
                      ? 'bg-[#218caa] text-white border-[#218caa] shadow-sm'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-teal-500'
                  }`}
                >
                  تلقائي وفق المحتوى
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOrientationMode('portrait')}
                  className={`px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all border text-center cursor-pointer ${
                    orientationMode === 'portrait'
                      ? 'bg-[#218caa] text-white border-[#218caa] shadow-sm'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-teal-500'
                  }`}
                >
                  رأسي (Portrait)
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOrientationMode('landscape')}
                  className={`px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all border text-center cursor-pointer ${
                    orientationMode === 'landscape'
                      ? 'bg-[#218caa] text-white border-[#218caa] shadow-sm'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-teal-500'
                  }`}
                >
                  أفقي (Landscape)
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-teal-700 dark:text-teal-300 font-medium">
                {effectiveOrientation === 'landscape'
                  ? 'تم اعتماد الكليشة الأفقية (مناسبة للجداول الواسعة والمؤشرات متعددة الحقول).'

            </div>

            {/* 2. Format Selection Tabs */}
            <div className="space-y-2">

              </label>

                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedFormat('excel')}

                    selectedFormat === 'excel'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-500 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 ring-2 ring-emerald-400/20 font-black'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-50'

                >

                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Direct Export Action Buttons */}
            <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                أزرار الاستخراج والتصدير الفوري:
              </label>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleExport(selectedFormat)}
                disabled={statusState === 'loading'}
                className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#006C70] to-[#218caa] hover:from-[#005558] hover:to-[#1b738e] text-white font-black text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-2xl shadow-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-75"
              >
                {statusState === 'loading' ? (
                  <>

                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-white shrink-0" />

                        ? 'تصدير Word قابل للتحرير 📝'
                        : 'تصدير Excel تحليلي 📊'}
                    </span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>

              {/* Instant Browser Print / Save Vector PDF */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handlePrint}
                disabled={statusState === 'loading'}
                className="w-full py-2.5 px-3 bg-emerald-600/15 hover:bg-emerald-600/25 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200 border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                title="طباعة فورية متوافقة مع كل الطابعات أو الحفظ كـ PDF متجهي فائق الدقة"
              >
                <Printer className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                <span>طباعة رسمية مباشرة / حفظ PDF فوري 🖨️</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-600 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">فوري ⚡</span>
              </button>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleExport('pdf')}
                  disabled={statusState === 'loading'}
                  className="py-2 px-2 bg-rose-600/10 hover:bg-rose-600/20 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-300/40 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-bold transition-all text-center cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  تصدير PDF ⚡
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleExport('word')}
                  disabled={statusState === 'loading'}
                  className="py-2 px-2 bg-blue-600/10 hover:bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-300/40 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-bold transition-all text-center cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  تصدير Word
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleExport('excel')}
                  disabled={statusState === 'loading'}
                  className="py-2 px-2 bg-emerald-600/10 hover:bg-emerald-600/20 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300/40 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-bold transition-all text-center cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  تصدير Excel
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Export All Formats ZIP */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleExport('all')}
                disabled={statusState === 'loading'}
                className="w-full py-2.5 px-3 bg-amber-500/15 hover:bg-amber-500/25 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 border border-amber-400/40 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Archive className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0" />

              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Status Feedback Banner */}
            {statusState !== 'idle' && (

                className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl text-xs flex items-center gap-2.5 border transition-all ${

                    ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800'
                    : statusState === 'success'

                    : 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800'

              <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 text-teal-950 dark:text-teal-100">
                <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#218caa]" />
                <span>ضمانات الجودة والمطابقة:</span>
              </div>
              <ul className="list-disc pr-4 space-y-1 text-teal-800 dark:text-teal-300">
                <li>اللغة العربية باتجاه كامل وحقيقي RTL دون أي تشويه للأحرف أو الأرقام.</li>
                <li>استخدام الكليشة الرسمية المعتمدة لوحدة القبول بنسبة أبعادها الأصلية.</li>
                <li>بداية المحتوى أسفل الخط الفاصل لضمان عدم تغطية أي شعار رسمي.</li>
              </ul>
            </div>

          </div>

          {/* Live Preview Panel (8 cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-8 p-5 sm:p-6 bg-slate-200/60 dark:bg-slate-950/70 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Eye className="w-4 h-4 text-[#218caa]" />
                <h4 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                  معاينة التقرير الرسمي ({effectiveOrientation === 'landscape' ? 'صفحة أفقية' : 'صفحة رأسية'})
                </h4>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                {reportData.rows.length} سجلات مطابقة
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Document Stage */}
            <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4 overflow-x-auto">
              <div
                ref={previewContainerRef}
                className="bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xl rounded-sm border border-slate-300 transition-all origin-top scale-[0.85] sm:scale-100"
                style={{
                  width: isLandscape ? '960px' : '680px',
                  minHeight: isLandscape ? '680px' : '960px',
                  padding: '24px 32px 32px 32px',
                  boxSizing: 'border-box',
                  fontFamily: "'Cairo', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif"
                }}
              >
                {/* Official Kliche Header */}
                <div
                  className="w-full mb-4"
                  dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: klicheSvg }}
                />

                {/* Safe Content Zone: Starts below the separator line */}
                <div className="w-full text-right" dir="rtl">
                  
                  {/* Meta Bar */}
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b-2 border-slate-100 pb-3 mb-4">
                    <div>
                      <h1 className="text-lg font-black text-[#006C70] mb-0.5">
                        {reportData.meta.title}
                      </h1>
                      {reportData.meta.subtitle && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">
                          {reportData.meta.subtitle}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-left text-[10px] text-slate-600 font-mono space-y-0.5">

                      <div><strong className="text-slate-800">الجهة:</strong> {reportData.meta.department}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Overall Summary Metric Cards (shown when not viewing a single specific governorate) */}
                  {reportData.summaryItems && reportData.summaryItems.length > 0 && selectedSectionFilter === 'all' && (

                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#006C70]"></span>

                        {reportData.summaryItems.map((item, idx) => (

                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 mb-1 w-full">
                              {getSummaryItemIcon(item.label, item.icon)}
                              <span className="text-[9.5px] sm:text-[10px] text-slate-600 font-bold leading-tight line-clamp-1">{item.label}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-[#006C70] mt-0.5">{item.value}</div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Governorate Sections (مقسم إلى أجزاء تشمل جميع الأيقونات الـ 13) */}
                  {reportData.sections && reportData.sections.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mb-5 space-y-3">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-y border-slate-200 py-2.5 bg-slate-50/70 px-3 rounded-xl">
                        <div className="text-xs font-black text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#006C70]"></span>
                          <span>التقرير مقسم حسب المحافظات (13 مؤشر لكل محافظة):</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setSelectedSectionFilter('all')}
                            className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[10.5px] font-bold rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                              selectedSectionFilter === 'all'
                                ? 'bg-[#006C70] text-white shadow-xs'
                                : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'
                            }`}
                          >
                            عرض جميع المحافظات (8)
                          </button>
                          {reportData.sections.map(sec => (
                            <button
                              key={sec.id}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setSelectedSectionFilter(sec.id)}
                              className={`px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                                selectedSectionFilter === sec.id
                                  ? 'bg-[#006C70] text-white shadow-xs'
                                  : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {sec.name}
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Stacked Cards for each governorate section */}
                      <div className="space-y-3.5">
                        {reportData.sections
                          .filter(sec => selectedSectionFilter === 'all' || sec.id === selectedSectionFilter)
                          .map(sec => (
                            <div key={sec.id} className="border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white shadow-xs">
                              <div className="bg-[#006C70] text-white px-3.5 py-2 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-black">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                  <span>📍</span>
                                  <span>{sec.name}</span>
                                </div>
                                <span className="text-[9.5px] font-bold bg-white/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                                  13 مؤشر إحصائي معتمد
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              <div className="p-2.5 bg-slate-50/50 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-7 gap-2">
                                {sec.summaryItems.map((item, idx) => (
                                  <div key={idx} className="bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-lg p-2 text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-between hover:border-teal-500/60 transition-all">
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 mb-1 w-full">
                                      {getSummaryItemIcon(item.label, item.icon)}
                                      <span className="text-[9px] sm:text-[9.5px] text-slate-600 font-bold leading-tight line-clamp-1">{item.label}</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-[#006C70] mt-0.5">{item.value}</div>
                                  </div>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Narrative Text */}
                  {reportData.narrativeText && reportData.narrativeText.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mb-4 bg-slate-50/50 p-3 rounded-lg border-r-4 border-[#006C70] text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed space-y-1">
                      {reportData.narrativeText.map((p, idx) => (
                        <p key={idx}>{p}</p>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Data Table */}
                  {reportData.rows && reportData.rows.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="overflow-x-auto mb-4 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg">
                      <table className="w-full text-[11px] text-right border-collapse">
                        <thead>
                          <tr className="bg-[#006C70] text-white">
                            <th className="p-2 border border-[#004d4f] text-center w-8">م</th>
                            {reportData.columns.map((c, i) => (
                              <th key={i} className="p-2 border border-[#004d4f] font-bold">
                                {c.header}
                              </th>
                            ))}
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                          {reportData.rows.slice(0, 15).map((row, rIdx) => (
                            <tr key={rIdx} className={rIdx % 2 === 0 ? 'bg-white' : 'bg-slate-50'}>
                              <td className="p-1.5 border border-slate-200 text-center font-bold text-slate-400">
                                {rIdx + 1}
                              </td>
                              {reportData.columns.map((col, cIdx) => (
                                <td key={cIdx} className="p-1.5 border border-slate-200 text-slate-800">
                                  {row[col.key] !== undefined && row[col.key] !== null ? String(row[col.key]) : '-'}
                                </td>
                              ))}
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                      {reportData.rows.length > 15 && (
                        <div className="p-1.5 text-center text-[10px] text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 border-t border-slate-200 font-medium">
                          عرض أول 15 سجل في المعاينة (يتم تصدير كافة السجلات البالغ عددها {reportData.rows.length} في الملف النهائي)
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Signatures */}
                  <div className="mt-6 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-center text-xs">
                    <div className="p-2.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg">
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#006C70] mb-0.5">مُعدّ التقرير:</div>
                      <div className="font-black text-slate-800">{reportData.meta.preparer}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">{reportData.meta.department}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-2.5 bg-emerald-50/60 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg">
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#006C70] mb-0.5">اعتماد صاحب الصلاحية:</div>
                      <div className="font-black text-slate-800">{reportData.meta.approver}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-700 font-bold">معتمد إلكترونياً ورسمياً ✓</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

  survey: SurveyResponse | null;
  schools: SchoolItem[];
  onUpdateSurvey: (survey: SurveyResponse) => void;
  activeOfficer: OfficerUser;
  onClaimSurvey?: (survey: SurveyResponse) => void;
  onSendToPrincipal?: (survey: SurveyResponse) => void;
  onSendToPlanning?: (survey: SurveyResponse) => void;
  onSendToLeadership?: (survey: SurveyResponse) => void;
  isDark?: boolean;
}

// Stage normalization helper
const normalizeStage = (stage?: string): string => {
  if (!stage) return '';
  const s = stage.toLowerCase();
  if (s.includes('kindergarten') || s.includes('روضة') || s.includes('رياض') || s.includes('طفولة')) return 'kindergarten';
  if (s.includes('elementary') || s.includes('primary') || s.includes('ابتدائي') || s.includes('ابتدائية')) return 'elementary';
  if (s.includes('intermediate') || s.includes('middle') || s.includes('متوسط') || s.includes('متوسطة')) return 'intermediate';
  if (s.includes('secondary') || s.includes('high') || s.includes('ثانوي') || s.includes('ثانوية')) return 'secondary';
  return s;
};

// Gender normalization helper
const normalizeGender = (gender?: string): string => {
  if (!gender) return '';
  const g = gender.toLowerCase();
  if (g.includes('boy') || g.includes('بنين')) return 'boys';
  if (g.includes('girl') || g.includes('بنات')) return 'girls';
  if (g.includes('both') || g.includes('مشترك') || g.includes('مختلط') || g.includes('طفولة')) return 'both';
  return g;
};

export const RegistrationReviewModal: React.FC<RegistrationReviewModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  survey,
  schools,
  onUpdateSurvey,
  activeOfficer,
  onClaimSurvey,
  onSendToPrincipal,
  onSendToPlanning,
  onSendToLeadership,
  isDark = false
}) => {
  if (!isOpen || !survey) return null;

  // Beneficiary's 3 Desires
  const desire1 = (survey.firstSchoolName || survey.schoolName || '').trim();
  const desire2 = (survey.secondSchoolName || '').trim();
  const desire3 = (survey.thirdSchoolName || '').trim();

  // Local state for selecting school with capacity
  const [selectedSchoolName, setSelectedSchoolName] = useState<string>(
    survey.assignedRegistrationSchool || survey.schoolName || ''
  );
  const [selectedSchoolCode, setSelectedSchoolCode] = useState<string>(
    survey.assignedRegistrationSchoolCode || survey.schoolCode || ''
  );
  const [capacityNotes, setCapacityNotes] = useState<string>(
    survey.assignedRegistrationSchoolNotes || ''
  );
  const [saveSuccessMsg, setSaveSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Filters for finding alternative available schools when desired schools are unavailable
  const [filterRegion, setFilterRegion] = useState<string>('all');
  const [filterGender, setFilterGender] = useState<string>('all');
  const [filterStage, setFilterStage] = useState<string>(() => {
    const studentStage = normalizeStage(survey.stage);
    return studentStage || 'all';
  });

  // Sync state when survey changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (survey) {
      setSelectedSchoolName(survey.assignedRegistrationSchool || survey.schoolName || '');
      setSelectedSchoolCode(survey.assignedRegistrationSchoolCode || survey.schoolCode || '');
      setCapacityNotes(survey.assignedRegistrationSchoolNotes || '');
      setSaveSuccessMsg(null);

      const studentStage = normalizeStage(survey.stage);
      if (studentStage) setFilterStage(studentStage);
    }
  }, [survey]);

  // Unique list of regions / governorates / sectors from schools
  const allRegions = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    schools.forEach(sch => {
      if (sch.district && sch.district.trim()) set.add(sch.district.trim());
      if (sch.customFields && sch.customFields['المنطقة']) set.add(String(sch.customFields['المنطقة']).trim());
      if (sch.customFields && sch.customFields['المحافظة']) set.add(String(sch.customFields['المحافظة']).trim());
      if (sch.customFields && sch.customFields['القطاع']) set.add(String(sch.customFields['القطاع']).trim());
      if (sch.customFields && sch.customFields['مكتب التعليم']) set.add(String(sch.customFields['مكتب التعليم']).trim());
    });
    const standardSectors = [
      'منطقة المدينة المنورة (المقر الرئيسي)',
      'القطاع الشمالي',
      'القطاع الجنوبي',
      'القطاع الشرقي',
      'القطاع الغربي',
      'القطاع الوسط',
      'محافظة ينبع',
      'محافظة بدر',
      'محافظة خيبر',
      'محافظة الحناكية',
      'محافظة مهد الذهب',
      'محافظة وادي الفرع',
      'محافظة العلا'
    ];
    standardSectors.forEach(s => set.add(s));
    return Array.from(set).filter(Boolean);
  }, [schools]);

  // Filtered alternative schools matching the 3 filters (Region, Gender, Stage)
  const filteredAlternativeSchools = useMemo(() => {
    return schools.filter(school => {
      // Filter by Region/Governorate
      if (filterRegion && filterRegion !== 'all') {
        const matchRegion = 
          school.district?.includes(filterRegion) ||
          school.customFields?.['المنطقة']?.includes(filterRegion) ||
          school.customFields?.['المحافظة']?.includes(filterRegion) ||
          school.customFields?.['القطاع']?.includes(filterRegion) ||
          school.customFields?.['مكتب التعليم']?.includes(filterRegion) ||
          school.nameAr?.includes(filterRegion);
        if (!matchRegion) return false;
      }

      // Filter by Gender
      if (filterGender && filterGender !== 'all') {
        const g = normalizeGender(school.gender || school.customFields?.['الجنس']);
        if (filterGender === 'boys' && g !== 'boys' && g !== 'both') return false;
        if (filterGender === 'girls' && g !== 'girls' && g !== 'both') return false;
        if (filterGender === 'both' && g !== 'both') return false;
      }

      // Filter by Stage
      if (filterStage && filterStage !== 'all') {
        const st = normalizeStage(school.stage || school.customFields?.['المرحلة']);
        if (st !== filterStage && st !== 'all') return false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [schools, filterRegion, filterGender, filterStage]);

  // Quick Select Desire Handler
  const handleSelectDesire = (schoolName: string, desireNum: number) => {
    if (!schoolName) return;
    setSelectedSchoolName(schoolName);
    const matched = schools.find(s => s.nameAr.trim().toLowerCase() === schoolName.trim().toLowerCase());
    const code = matched ? (matched.ministryCode || (matched as any).code || '') : '';
    setSelectedSchoolCode(code);
    const label = desireNum === 1 ? 'الرغبة الأولى' : desireNum === 2 ? 'الرغبة الثانية' : 'الرغبة الثالثة';
    setCapacityNotes(`تم التسكين على (${label}) بناءً على رغبة المستفيد وتوفر إمكانية التسجيل.`);
  };

  // Alternative School Selected Handler
  const handleSelectAlternativeSchool = (schoolName: string, schoolCode?: string) => {
    if (!schoolName) return;
    setSelectedSchoolName(schoolName);
    if (schoolCode) setSelectedSchoolCode(schoolCode);
    setCapacityNotes(`تم التسكين في مدرسة بديلة متاحة (${schoolName}) لعدم توفر تسجيل بالمدارس المطلوبة من قبل المستفيد.`);
  };

  const handleSaveAssignedSchool = () => {
    if (!selectedSchoolName.trim()) {
      alert('يرجى تحديد المدرسة التي بها إمكانية للتسجيل أولاً.');
      return;
    }

    const updated: SurveyResponse = {
      ...survey,
      assignedRegistrationSchool: selectedSchoolName.trim(),
      assignedRegistrationSchoolCode: selectedSchoolCode.trim(),
      assignedRegistrationSchoolNotes: capacityNotes.trim(),
      assignedRegistrationSchoolAt: new Date().toISOString(),
